lines.note: Warning the player

lines.text: Some Mr. Gutsies have taken up positions at this location and are defending it. Unclear why, but more arrive on a regular basis.
lines.note: Warning to the player

lines.text: Heard this place was teeming with all sorts of Mutations. Most folks either died or they up and ran from there, so I don't know more.
lines.note: Warning to the player

lines.text: A trader said this place stank and was full of weird noises. Hard to say exactly what it was, but it's had some Mutations breeding there before.
lines.note: Warning to the player

lines.text: Have you ever wanted to see a place packed full of assorted Mutations? Well, here's your chance.
lines.note: Warning to the player

lines.text: This place is packed with Protectrons. Nobody could tell me how many were there, or why, but there were a lot.
lines.note: Warning to the player

lines.text: Hunters reported seeing tracks for a bunch of Protectrons around this place. No scat though, turns out that most robots don't do that. Most.
lines.note: Warning to the player

lines.text: What do you call it when a bunch of ancient Protectrons gather in one predetermined location?
lines.note: Set up for a dad joke

lines.text: Planned mobsolescence! Yeah? Right? Uh. Anyway, just... keep an eye out.
lines.note: mob + obsolescence, a joke. He's proud of himself. Not understanding the player's reaction, he just quickly shifts gears

lines.text: Bunch of Rad Ants in this area. Be warned. Also, while you're out there, ponder on this...
lines.note: Set up for a dad joke

lines.text: Ever wonder why everybody started calling these things "Rad Ants"? Because we already had "Mut-Ants"!
lines.note: Dad joke

lines.text: I really don't know how you get Rad Ants. But this place has a ton of them.
lines.note: said with humor, as if the player knows how you get Rad Ants

lines.text: I hate just Rad Ants. I know this place is utterly crawling with them. Makes me shudder just thinking about it. One might say I'm antsy about it all.
lines.note: Dad joke at the end

lines.text: This place is a Radroach hotel and every room is at capacity. I'd suggest bringing your best squishin' boots.
lines.note: Grossed out

lines.text: Radroaches have infested this place. I just think of that sound of crinkling paper wings... crispy crackly little creepy legs. Ugh. Yuck. Be warned.
lines.note: Grossed out

lines.text: It's a Radroach party and you're definitely invited. You might even be the main course.
Radscorpions. They make for great tattoos, but that's about it. Sad day for you: there's a bunch at this place.
lines.note: Set up for a quick dad joke

lines.text: Er, the actual giant beasts and not a bunch of tattoos. So I guess it's an even sadder day.
Trader friend saw some Radscorpion burrows around this place. Lots of them. Either it's one very confused Radscorpion, or a pack of them.
lines.note: Warning to the player

lines.text: Tons of Radscorpions here, I heard. Tons. It's unusual, so they're also probably more aggressive than normal. Just be warned.
lines.note: Warning to player

lines.text: I heard this place is hopping with huge Rad Toads. Get it?! Hopping?! Look. You get what Beckett's got on tap.
lines.note: Dad jokes

lines.text: Some traders said they heard a bunch of Rad Toad croaks. Like... Ribbit. Riiiibit. Ribbit. Ribbit. Riiiibit.
lines.note: Set up for a dad joke.

lines.text: Gotta be some sort of Morse Toad right?
lines.note: It's a play on the phase "Morse Code

lines.text: I heard a giant Rad Toad went to this place recently. I figure, it was either going there to spawn, or it was going to robbit! Rob it! Get it? Ha!
lines.note: Dad joke. He's so pleased with himself. Robbit = Ribbit

lines.text: Damn raiders. They got scared out of their last joint, and now they've taken hold of this place. Give them a proper Beckett salute, will ya?
lines.note: He hates raiders.

lines.text: Heard some locals got chased away by raiders after most of their stuff was stolen. Typical punk shit. You know what to do.
lines.note: He hates raiders.

lines.text: Heard a bunch of raider scum took this place over not too long ago. Should mean they aren't entrenched yet. Take advantage of that and wipe em out.
lines.note: He hates raiders.

lines.text: Some raiders used to be there, but they got chased out by a giant swarm of rats. I would have paid to watch that! Anyway, the rats are still there.
lines.note: He hates raiders.

lines.text: Trader passed by who specializes in dried rat meats, said she came up to this place and filled up her stock right away. She could rat-tire... retire!
lines.note: Had to pop in a dad joke in the end.

lines.text: This place is packed with tons of rats. Probably has been picked pretty clean by now, but you never know.
lines.note: General casual warning

lines.text: Folks saw some Robobrains here. Not sure how many. The tracks sort of merged together and hid their numbers.
lines.note: Casual warning

lines.text: Expect to encounter some Robobrains here. I heard they travel in a line. I bet it's more of a Robotrain when they do that.
lines.note: The dad jokes continue

lines.text: Some Robobrains claimed this place after their last spot got flooded recently. I heard they got completely brainwashed.
lines.note: Dad joke

lines.text: Military bots are patrolling this location heavily, I heard. Unclear why, exactly, probably some ancient glitch in their programming.
lines.note: Word of caution

lines.text: Trader said she was followed by a bunch of military robots shouting orders at her. Attention! Left! Left Right Left! That sort of thing.
lines.note: He's thinking this is an amusing scene in his head

lines.text: Then they proclaimed that it was time to train and started shooting. She lost them in this place, so they're probably still there.
lines.note: End of his story

lines.text: What do you call it when someone enters a place packed with military robots and then they get killed?
lines.note: Dad joke setup

lines.text: Their pla-tomb! Get it? Platoon? Ok. Look, humor is all I have going for me sometimes.
lines.note: Dad joke

lines.text: Trader saw a conga line of robots heading towards this place. Not sure what their intention is, but I'd assume they're hostile.
Dunno why, but a bunch of robots have been gathering at this place for a while. Heard they attacked a trader that approached. Just be warned.
Scavengers have been trying to get into this place for a while. Lots of robots in here, and they're very aggressive.
lines.note: Casual warning

lines.text: Is there a robot equivalent of huddling together for warmth? Maybe huddling for power conservation? Well, maybe that's what they're doing...
lines.note: He wonders.

lines.text: Heard some Blood Eagles were shredded here recently by a mob of Scorched. Wish I could have seen that!
lines.note: He hates the blood eagles

lines.text: Haven't heard anything unusual about this particular place, but I would expect it to be full of Scorched. Kinda normal for this area.
lines.note: He shrugs, could be.

lines.text: Haven't heard squat about this place, so I'm guessing it's full of Scorched again. It seems to get overrun frequently.
lines.note: He isn't sure

lines.text: Couple Sentry Bots were spotted in this area, not sure what they're up to. I heard it's best not to anthropormorphize them anyway. They hate that.
lines.note: Dad joke

lines.text: Some Sentry Bots ran a group of Blood Eagles out of there and took over. Bet it would have been fun to watch. The bots are still there, of course.
lines.note: Amused thinking of the blood eagles getting chased out.

lines.text: Heard about some Sentry Bots in that area. Unclear how many, but definitely several. Just be warned.
Heard there was more than one Sheepsquatch at this place. Be warned... if you start counting them, you just might start to nod off.
lines.note: Counting sheep joke. He's pleased with himself.

lines.text: There's a couple Sheepsquatch at this place, maybe a lot. If you head in, be prepared for a bleat down. Get it? Like a... beat down! Ha!
lines.note: Pun on the phrase "beat down" --- he is pleased with his terrible jokes

lines.text: Some hunter said she heard noises like bunch of Sheepsquatch were gathering there. She didn't linger long. She only shears what she wants to shear.
lines.note: dad joke in the end. play on "She only hears what she wants to hear.

lines.text: Sounds like there's Snally Gasters there. Hate those things.
I've heard a lot of chatter lately about this. From the sounds of it, I'd guess Snally Gasters.
From what I can gather, place has Snally Gasters. Don't get swallowed up.
Stingwings decided this was their new breeding pit for the season, I guess. There are probably tons there now.
lines.note: He's sorry you have to go there.

lines.text: Couple Settlers nearly got killed at this place, said a massive swarm of Stingwings chased them away. They're pretty lucky, all things considered.
lines.note: Empathetic with the Settlers

lines.text: This place is teeming with Stingwings. Not my favorite. They're too fast for me, especially when they're riled up. And these apparently are.
I heard that a group of Super Mutants trashed the place recently. I bet they're still around. Traders have been just avoiding it.
lines.note: Passing along a warning

lines.text: Tons of Super Mutants at this place. I asked Grahm about it, he said to just leave them be. Said they had nice things, but wouldn't trade with him.
lines.note: Grahm is said like Grom

lines.text: Place is packed with Super Mutants. Here's a tactic you could try: in your deepest, gnarliest voice shout: "I got a treat for you!
lines.note: Amused at the idea in his head

lines.text: Then toss in some explosives, handfuls of rotten meat, diseased Brahmin, whatever you have lying around.
May as well be neighborly, right? Before you destroy them, I mean.
Heads up: a couple of traders warned me that this place was covered in swamp creatures.
lines.note: General warning

lines.text: Try to stay safe, but keep an eye out for swamp creatures. I heard the place was pretty much flooded with them.
lines.note: General warning

lines.text: Couple traders said this place had a bunch of swamp creatures in it. I don't even know what they mean by that. But... be aware, I guess?
lines.note: General warning

lines.text: Heard this place was full of bloated, giant ticks. Just a huge nest of them skittering around with their tiny sucker mouths.
lines.note: He hates these things.

lines.text: I heard there are a bunch of Ticks at this spot. They're probably starving, and will latch on to the first thing with blood that they see.
How much do you like to pop Ticks? Well, if your answer is: "It's my favorite thing ever!" then you're going to love this place.
lines.note: He's kind of grossed out, honestly.

lines.text: If I said this place was overrun with packs of dogs, do you imagine tiny fluffy yippy dogs? I do! Unfortunately, these are mean, disease-ridden ones.
lines.note: Sorry to burst your bubble, he thought

lines.text: Heard from a trader that this place is overrun with aggressive dogs. Not a single one of them is cute and cuddly even in the slightest, don't worry.
lines.note: Warning but in a funny way, sort of

lines.text: Some folks ran into a pack of hyper-aggressive dogs in this spot. They only got away because the dogs were distracted by some bunnies.
lines.note: He'll continue...

lines.text: The people survived, but the bunnies were less fortunate. Go on and avenge them.
lines.note: He says that semi-jokingly

lines.text: Some hunters found a strangely large amount of fresh wolf scat around this place. Either the wolves are gathering here...
lines.note: Set up for something weird

lines.text: Or somebody is purposefully dropping off wolf uh, chips, here. You can solve that mystery on your own, and just fill me in later. Actually... don't.
lines.note: On second thought...

lines.text: An ex-raider stopped by, said she led some raiders that were chasing her into this place so they'd get mauled by wolves. It worked. But, well...
lines.note: Telling a story

lines.text: Now a few more wolves have joined that pack, and the place is a bit rougher than before. Just be warned. They like the taste of human now, too.
Traders said there's been a lot of wolf noises in this area lately, so let's assume it's just a pack of angry, rabid wolves.
lines.note: And not anything weird.

lines.text: Seems like there's a family of Yao Guai here. Can't even tell you how many because nobody could get that close.
lines.note: He wishes he had more info

lines.text: Traders heard tons of grunts and strange noises coming from this place lately...
lines.note: Setup for a joke

lines.text: Probably just Yao Guai. But could be *rutting* Yao Guai. So... brace yourself.
lines.note: Emphasis on the "rutting

lines.text: And do not go in there smelling like another Yao Guai. You get me?
lines.note: Dire warning

lines.text: Ever wanted a giant hug from a terribly hostile teddy bear covered in blood and scabs? If so, then this is your place! Yao Guai! Everywhere!
lines.note: He's almost excited for some reason.

lines.text: I wish I knew, friend. Last person I know who went there never came back. She was a skilled hunter, too. Probably got swarmed.
lines.note: Sincerely wishes he knew more

lines.text: Honestly, I don't know what's at this spot exactly... could be a group of all sorts of things, too. I really don't know.
lines.note: Warning, but vague

lines.text: Nobody knows for sure. There's probably something there... but... people have just been avoiding it for a while. So I don't know.
lines.note: Wishes he knew more

topics.prompt: Where do I need to go?

lines.text: You need to go to this cabin right here. Three separate sources confirmed it -- folks that I trust.
lines.note: He is pretty confident that this is the right info.

lines.text: Check inside this cabin, or... maybe around it.
lines.note: He's pretty sure anyway.

lines.text: It's not a big place that you need to check. Just this cabin and the surrounding area. Shouldn't take long.
lines.note: Said matter-of-factly

lines.text: I heard it's in a campsite of some kind. Doubt you'll get any charred marshmallows out of it, though... too bad.
lines.note: He started to think about the marshmallows and sort of drifted away

lines.text: You're going to a campsite, friend. I mean, I guess you're always camping in a way, right? But this is more like... a regular camp.
lines.note: NPC muses about the fact that they are, in fact, in a camp

lines.text: You'll need to go to this particular camp. I went there once, long ago. Not for any good reasons, either.
lines.note: NPC is remorseful about something that they won't explain

lines.text: Caves. I was told, check the caves. I asked a couple others who have been up there lately, and one particular cave stands out.
lines.note: He is pretty confident that this is the right info.

lines.text: Someone mentioned this one cave in particular. Seems like a reasonable place to start.
lines.note: He is pretty confident that this is the right info.

lines.text: Once I hid in this cave here, you know, trying to shake the gang off my trail. Overlaps a bit with what I heard folks talking about. Try there first?
lines.note: He is only sort of confident that this is the right info.

lines.text: It's in an old Civic Building. I went there once, long ago. Made a mess of the place...
lines.note: He regrets those days

lines.text: Friend of a friend confirmed that it's in this old Civic Building.
Trader stopped by and chatted up a storm about this old Civic Building. Sounds like a damn mess.
lines.note: NPC tells the player they have to go here.

lines.text: I keep hearing people talk about this old communications building. Sounds like the place to start.
lines.note: Telling the player where to go to find the thing.

lines.text: Gotta head to an old communications building, I think I figured out which one from a couple different sources. Must be your lucky day.
lines.note: Telling the player where to go.

lines.text: Seems like you need to check out this particular building. Old comm ops place.
lines.note: Comm ops = communications operations building.

lines.text: It's an old compound, bunker, that kind of thing.
Everybody I talked to said to check out this specific compound.
lines.note: Telling the player where to go.

lines.text: From the folks I spoke with, seems like you should go here and search this compound. At least check there first.
lines.note: Telling the player where to go.

lines.text: Time for some dam action, am I right? Well, this is for you, my friend.
lines.note: He tries to be funny.

lines.text: Dam. You.
lines.note: He tries to sound like Grahm the Super Mutant with just these too words. Said gruffly.

lines.text: That was my best impression of Grahm telling a joke where you need to go to a dam. Oh, and yeah, that's where you're going.
lines.note: He tries to be funny.

lines.text: Finally. It's time for some dam activity around here!
lines.note: He tries to be funny. It's a pun, since you're going to a dam.

lines.text: Heard you should check out this factory in particular.
I've been in this particular factory before... for reasons I won't go into right now. I'd say it's worth checking out. It's a good hiding place.
lines.note: Feels bad about his past

lines.text: Thirty hobos agreed: this factory is the spot. Ok, maybe it wasn't thirty, and maybe they weren't all hobos. But it felt like it, and smelled like it.
lines.note: He tries to be funny.

lines.text: I've got a real good feeling about this farm. Just... check it out first.
lines.note: He knows something about it but isn't explaining.

lines.text: Check out the farm. Heard a few traders talk about it, seems legit to me.
lines.note: Telling the player to go there to find an item or kill something/someone

lines.text: I overheard some traders talk about this farm in particular. Seems to be worth a quick look-see.
lines.note: Could have what the player is looking for

lines.text: You need to go to this house, I promise.
lines.note: Leans in and promises at the end

lines.text: Trader passed this house by recently, confirmed what I heard from someone else. So start there first.
lines.note: Verified target

lines.text: This is an easy one. Should be a small house. That's all. I even got you an address.
lines.note: Proud of himself

lines.text: Heard a trader talk about this particular lookout tower. It's a small space, so it shouldn't take you long to check it out.
lines.note: Suggesting the option to the player

lines.text: It's at this lookout tower. A while ago, I was up at the top of a lookout tower, hopped up on chems, looking across Appalachia and thinking...
lines.note: he says this in a serious way, but it's a set up for a joke

lines.text: Wow, I'm going to be sick. And I was. All down the side of the tower. I don't know if it was this one... but... anyway. Uh. That's all I got.
lines.note: He tries to be funny.

lines.text: Check out this Lookout Tower. Seems to match up with a couple stories I heard recently, anyway.
lines.note: It's a good guess, he figures.

lines.text: A trader was talking about this medical facility, and it sounded like the place you ought to start looking.
lines.note: He's pretty sure this is true

lines.text: This medical facility really jumps out as a good place to start looking. Matches up with a couple rumors I heard.
lines.note: He's pretty sure this is true

lines.text: Heard some scavengers talk about this particular medical facility. You should start here.
lines.note: He's pretty sure this is true

lines.text: A trader kept talking about this mine. Seems promising, so let's start there, okay?
lines.note: He's pretty confident that this is a solid choice.

lines.text: Out of all the possible locations in this area, you really ought to try this mine first. I used to use it for my own purposes back in the day.
lines.note: He's pretty confident that this is a solid choice.

lines.text: It may be risky, but this mine is a pretty good possibility. Try there first?
lines.note: He's somewhat confident that this is a good choice.

lines.text: How long has it been since you were at the park? Well, everything I heard indicates that's where to look. Try to have some fun, will ya?
lines.note: He's trying to be fun about it.

lines.text: Check out the park, I suppose. No other place really sticks out as a good option. Maybe you'll see some squirrels while you're there, eh?
lines.note: He's trying to be fun about it.

lines.text: I heard there were some odd things going on at the park lately. I dunno. Could be exactly what we're looking for.
lines.note: He's somewhat confident that this is a good choice.

lines.text: I heard there have been unusual occurrences at this power substation lately. It's a bit of a leap, but probably worth checking out first.
lines.note: He's somewhat confident that this is a good choice.

lines.text: I had this list of potential places, right. Now, I've crossed off almost every place on it... except for this one power substation.
lines.note: He's sorta confident that this is a okay choice.

lines.text: Grahm told me about this power substation specifically. I trust him, and so should you.
lines.note: He's very confident that this is a good choice.

lines.text: Go to this research facility. Guaranteed. Someone tried to sell me that information, can you believe it? I bought it. I don't care.
lines.note: He's very confident that this is a good choice.

lines.text: According to every bit of gossip I've overheard lately, you should absolutely check out this research facility.
lines.note: He's somewhat confident that this is a good choice.

lines.text: I remember scavenging this particular research facility for chems and scrap, and... I did find that stuff... but also, well...
lines.note: Feels bad about his past, sorta

lines.text: I also recall that it was not a bad spot for all sorts of suspicious purposes. It's kind of a long shot in a way, but may as well, right?
lines.note: He's somewhat confident that this is a good choice.

lines.text: Seems quite likely that this resort is where we want to start. Can you believe a couple junkies recommended a resort to me? This world...
lines.note: He's somewhat confident that this is a good choice. "This world, (I swear)...

lines.text: I eliminated several potential locations, but this resort sticks out. Start there first, okay?
lines.note: He's somewhat confident that this is a good choice.

lines.text: As a last... resort... you ought to check this place out. Surprise! It's a resort. Chems ruined my sense of humor.
lines.note: He's trying to be humorous.

lines.text: Heard from a trader about this place. Some old restaurant. Seemed like a good place to start looking.
lines.note: Then he starts to wonder after he says this...

lines.text: I wonder what it would be like to eat there back in the old times? People would travel there, go inside, sit down, and someone brings them food?
Seems so... odd to me. I heard they started to set these places up again in Crater and Foundation. Maybe I should go there, just to see it.
I was able to pull in a few favors on this one to narrow down the location. Sounds like you should check out this restaurant.
Try this old restaurant first. You'll know if it isn't it pretty quickly.
lines.note: Pretty confident

lines.text: This old school seems to be where to go. Trust me. Heard it from a couple traders, and almost a third of them wouldn't lie.
lines.note: Sort of joking

lines.text: I heard from a nearly trustworthy source that this school might be interesting. Figured it's possibly safe enough for you to explore.
lines.note: Sort of joking

lines.text: Go to this school here. Can you believe that people used to send kids to these dumps? I can't even imagine why.
lines.note: Sort of joking

lines.text: You should check out this old store first. A couple traders confirmed this spot for me and I didn't even need to pay them. With caps anyway.
lines.note: Innuendo it up. What did he pay them with??? The world will never know.

lines.text: Go to this store and start there. If nothing else, there might be some junk to scavenge.
lines.note: explaining a mission/favor you are asking the player to do

lines.text: Heard a bum and a Brahmin trader discussing this store loudly and drunkenly. I mean... to be clear, this was one of dozens of discussions they had.
lines.note: Sort of joking

lines.text: I hope those two love birds are still together, somewhere.
lines.note: Sort of joking

lines.text: Couldn't pull a ton of information from this. I just know that you need to search this town... it's a start, right?
lines.note: Sort of joking

lines.text: So, look. Check out this town. You should be able to track down more information when you're in there. Sorry I couldn't pinpoint it closer.
lines.note: Seriously wishes he could have more info

lines.text: Go to this town and look around. I bet you'll be able to narrow it down pretty fast. Traders really didn't know much more this time.
lines.note: Wishes he knew more

lines.text: I eliminated several possible locations except for the train yard. Start there. If nothing else, you got to see a train.
lines.note: Sort of joking

lines.text: I asked a buddy who asked an old hunter friend, who asked a former solider she knows, who asked a farmer that just arrived from the east...
And the farmer said that she heard a trader say that he thinks this train yard might be worth checking out. So... seems like a start to me.
lines.note: Sort of joking

lines.text: Found a guy willing to tell me what's up with this train yard in exchange for a lot of booze. I won't go into specifics, but you need to start here.
lines.note: Sort of joking

lines.text: This tunnel has a lot of strange stories. Trader swears he saw a ghost there. Farmer says she definitely heard odd animal noises.
lines.note: Jokingly, sort of

lines.text: A drunk guy swears he dropped his best booze there. Grahm said he saw lights there once. All I can say is that it seems active and could be the spot.
lines.note: Jokingly, sort of

lines.text: I saw some folks with a map of this area the other day, and this tunnel was circled. Heavily. From their conversation, it seems like our place too.
lines.note: He is pretty excited that he overheard this info

lines.text: Believe it or not, it's hard to ask folks about tunnels without them becoming awfully crude relatively fast. Annoying, right?
lines.note: Setting up a joke...

lines.text: Anyway, I think it's a good place to start. Just poke your head inside and see for yourself though, you know?
This was a hard one to pinpoint. I was able to eliminate a bunch of nearby locales... but I think it's just going to be in the wilderness.
lines.note: He wishes he had better info

lines.text: Heard a couple folks referencing some distances to landmarks but... there's nothing really nearby except wilderness. Worth a try?
lines.note: He wishes he had better info

lines.text: I asked a couple hunters that I know, and they thought this area of the wilderness seemed promising.
lines.note: It's the best he could do.

lines.text: It's... sort of near... this spot, I guess? I mean, the description I got was really vague.
lines.note: sincere, trying to be helpful, but you really don't know much

lines.text: The information I have about this place is pieced together from a drunk and a chem fiend's dazed conversation. So... I can maybe get you close.
lines.note: sincere, trying to be helpful, but you really don't know much

lines.text: I have a vague idea but... nobody wanted to spill the beans about this place. I don't know if they didn't know or if they didn't want me to know.
lines.note: sincere, trying to be helpful, but you really don't know much

topics.prompt: What am I supposed to do?

lines.text: Some folks have been searching but, well, they need a professional at this point.
lines.note: Offering a player a rescue mission to help a person out. They fear the worst.

lines.text: It's always tense to look for somebody in need, but I think it's worth the effort.
lines.note: Asking the player to rescue someone.

lines.text: Gotta hurry on this one, don't know how much time we have left. You know what I mean?
lines.note: The person could die if they aren't found soon.

lines.text: All I know is that this is a hostile situation, you should be prepared for anything. I know you always are, but... still.
lines.note: Offering the player a quest to kill an unknown target.

lines.text: I know you can handle anything, but... this could be especially dangerous.
lines.note: Offering the player a quest to kill an unknown target.

lines.text: If I had more info, believe me, I'd tell you. I don't like putting you in a risky situation, but... I've seen you work. You can handle it.
lines.note: Offering the player a quest to kill an unknown target.

lines.text: You should expect to find an Angler there for sure. Could be more.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's an Angler there. That much I know.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Expect to encounter an Angler there, that's one thing I can tell you for sure.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: An Assaultron is known to be around there. My favorite.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: You shouldn't be surprised to encounter some robots there, in fact, I'd expect you to run into an Assaultron in particular.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's an Assaultron there, and you need to destroy it.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a giant Bloatfly up there. Nasty fella.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Big ol' Bloatfly is up there. Your job is to smash it. That's all. Smash.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: What will you find there, you might ask? A big Bloatfly. A giant one. Huge. Okay, I don't know how big it is. But big enough for a reputation.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: It's a Bloodbug. You will be doing everybody a big favor by squashing this thing.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Your target is a Bloodbug. Kill it before it does more damage, or... worse... breeds.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: It's a Bloodbug. I know, you're leaping with joy. "Yes, finally! A disgusting giant bug full of blood and gnarly bits that I can squish!
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Piece of crap Blood Eagle punk needs to be taught a lesson. I'm not fooling around. The lesson is death, you get me?
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: I need you to kill a Blood Eagle scumbag. The whole thing makes me so mad that I can barely talk about it. Just trust me on this.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Heard that some Blood Eagle scumbag is attempting to form a new group, and that needs to be ended. Immediately. Violently. Permanently. Got it?
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: I need you to thoroughly destroy a Cave Cricket. Watch out, it might have a nest. I don't know for sure.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Expect to find a Cave Cricket. With their gnarly long legs... and... those eyes. I hate the eyes. Yeah, just crush it, will you?
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a Cave Cricket there. You know what to do. Smash it! Then get the hell out!
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a Deathclaw there for sure. I heard it was a big one too. Not sure exactly how big...
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: How do you feel about Deathclaws? Well. There's one here, and it's pissed.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Expect to run into a Deathclaw. It will know you're there before you see it, probably.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Believe it or not, there's an Eyebot there. Probably broken since it's so aggressive. It just needs to be destroyed.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Be on the lookout for an Eyebot. See what I did there? SEE? Hah! I can't stop myself!
lines.note: What a jokester. Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Brace yourself. It's... it's terrible. The worst. You should expect to find the toughest thing... the.. monster... the terrifying...
lines.note: Trying to sell this as a serious enemy

lines.text: Eyebot. It's an Eyebot. It's probably broken and sort of messed up. Just destroy it, will you?
lines.note: Casual, as if this is below asking the player to do. This comes after a long setup.

lines.text: Get this: it's a Fog Crawler. Bet you weren't expecting that, huh?
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: You should know that there's a Fog Crawler there. There could be more.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Word is, there's a Fog Crawler there, and it's pissed.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Supposedly there's a mean feral ghoul there for sure. Could be more, you know how they are.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: I need you to put down a Feral Ghoul. It's caused too much grief already.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Normally, nobody cares about specific Feral Ghouls, but there's one here with a bit of a reputation... and it needs to be put down.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: The Grafton Monster is there. You know what that means. You need to be prepared.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Brace yourself. It's the Grafton Monster. So, prepare accordingly.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Look. I'm not going to beat around the bush here. It's the Grafton Monster, and it's serious.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: You wanna know what you will find there, right? It's a damn Gulper.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Expect to find a Gulper there. Maybe more. You know how those damn things are.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a Gulper there that has caused some serious harm. You need to squash it. Okay?
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a particular Honey Beast there that's being a pain. It needs to stop.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a Honey Beast out there that has become hyper aggressive, and it needs to be destroyed.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: You need to get in there and kill this aggressive Honey Beast. You're probably going to get stung in the process, and I'm sorry about that.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There are some giant insects that need to be squashed. Immediately.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There are giant insects there, and you're the exterminator. Got it?
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: They said there was a Giant Insect there, but... could there be more? Probably. People tend to see one and just flee. You know?
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Time to be a patriot, my friend. There's a Liberator there, and it needs to be destroyed.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Sounded like there's a Liberator there. Try to find it and destroy it. There could be more, so keep an eye out.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: You need to destroy a Liberator. Maybe its friends too, if you see any.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: You should know that there's a Mega Sloth there. I have a feeling you would find out before it sees you, though.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Word is, there's a Mega Sloth there. I figure you'd probably notice it long before it sees you, but hey. Just passing along the intel.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a Mega Sloth there that's been causing trouble, and honestly it just needs to be put down. It's sad, but... yeah. It's necessary.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: You should expect to find an angry Mirelurk, or that's the rumor. Could be more though. You should be on the lookout.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: It's crab season, my friend, and you are needed to crush a big old Mirelurk.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Bring along some seasoning because it's a Mirelurk. A delicious Mirelurk.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a Mole Miner there, likely more. You know the drill. Hah! The drill! You're welcome.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: I heard there's a Mole Miner there. Could there be more? Yes. Could there be other aggressive things there? Still yes.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a particularly troublesome Mole Miner that needs to be exterminated. I think you can handle it with your eyes closed, personally.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there. He'd wink if he could.

lines.text: There's a particularly vile Mole Rat that needs to be destroyed. It's lingered long enough, and now it's too aggressive.
lines.note: friendly, sincere, sharing the intel you have with the player so they are informed about the favor/mission you are sending them on

lines.text: Heard there was a vicious Mole Rat there, and honestly... we need to eliminate it before it breeds.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a Mole Rat with your name on it. Well, I bet it has a name like SQUEAAAAKERRR but regardless, you need to kill it.
lines.note: SQUEAAAAKERR is just some squeaky mole type sound. Make it something funny.

lines.text: Heard that some freaky Mothman Cultist is starting a new branch of... you know, I don't even care. The freaky shit just needs to end. Permanently.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a Mothman Cultist who has caused all sorts of trouble lately. I don't care why. It needs to end.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a brand new Mothman Cultist in the area trying to stir up some shit, and we need to take care of it before it becomes a new thing.
lines.note: Emphasis on the "Thing" -- it's going to become "A Thing".... Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: You need to find a particular Mr. Gutsy and turn it into a Mr. Deadsy.
lines.note: Jokingly. Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a Mr. Gutsy there that needs to be destroyed. Now.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: You need to terminate a Mr. Gutsy that has been terrorizing folks and maiming wildlife for a while.
lines.note: friendly, sincere, sharing the intel you have with the player so they are informed about the favor/mission you are sending them on

lines.text: There's a hyper-aggressive Mutation there. Folks have been complaining about this thing for a while. It's time to end it.
lines.note: friendly, sincere, sharing the intel you have with the player so they are informed about the favor/mission you are sending them on

lines.text: Expect to find a Mutation there. I only have a report of just the one... but it's hard to say for sure.
lines.note: friendly, sincere, sharing the intel you have with the player so they are informed about the favor/mission you are sending them on

lines.text: There's a hostile Mutation that needs to be exterminated. Pretty straight-forward.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a rogue Protectron and it needs to be terminated.
lines.note: friendly, sincere, sharing the intel you have with the player so they are informed about the favor/mission you are sending them on

lines.text: Apparently there's an aggressive Protectron that is causing all sorts of trouble for folks in that area.
lines.note: friendly, sincere, sharing the intel you have with the player so they are informed about the favor/mission you are sending them on

lines.text: It's a Protectron, and an obnoxious one at that. Heard it has been terrorizing wildlife. Shredded some bunnies in front of a trader. Just... why?
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: You need to squish a Rad Ant. It's a nasty one though, don't be fooled.
lines.note: friendly, sincere, sharing the intel you have with the player so they are informed about the favor/mission you are sending them on

lines.text: Heard a particularly nasty Rad Ant is starting to build a nest. You need to stop it. Fast.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a Rad Ant that's starting to build a colony. Nobody wants this, not even crazed cultists. You need to stop it, fast.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: You need to smash a Radroach. I know what you're thinking... "Is that all, Beckett?" But listen. They're... awful. Have you heard their wings flap?
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: It's like... shuffling crispy papers. Just... just kill it, okay?
It's a Radroach. A big one. I don't want to see evidence that you killed it. I just want to know it's gone. Got it?
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: You're needed to kill a Radroach. This is a high priority mission. If this thing starts a new colony, we'll be swarmed. Swarmed!
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a hotshot Raider punk who's starting to cause serious grief. You need to end this now.
lines.note: Beckett hates Raiders. Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a raider who's trying to spin up a new gang, and that has to stop. Now.
lines.note: Beckett hates Raiders. Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Rumor has it, a new gang is forming around a vile, unpredictable raider punk. You need to end this shit before it starts.
lines.note: Beckett hates Raiders. Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: Don't laugh. It's a Radrat. Look, it's... it's a mean one? I don't know. Just kill it, okay?
lines.note: Attempting to say this with a straight face. Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: It's big. It's bad. It's terrible... it's a... wait for it...
lines.note: Trying to hype it up.

lines.text: It's a mean Radrat. Okay. Look, just... just kill it, okay? Do it for me?
lines.note: Attempting to say this with a straight face. Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: You are needed to kill a... Radrat. Look. I know. It's a rat. I... I know. But these things carry diseases and... stuff. Just take care of it, okay?
lines.note: Attempting to say this with a straight face. Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a mad Robobrain that needs to be shut down. I always feel bad for them, you know? Just... be kind. Rewind.
lines.note: Genuinely feels sorry for the thing, but also said with humor. Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a Robobrain causing all sorts of trouble. Part of me wants to know why, what caused it to meltdown, all that jazz.
lines.note: With humor. Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: But honestly, who has the time for repairs at this point? Just shut it down permanently.
lines.note: Matter-of-factly. Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: It's a messed up Robobrain. I always wonder if it's the brain that goes bad or the robotic part... It's hyper aggressive so just shut it down fast.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a Robot that has glitched out and is attacking everything. Even bunny rabbits. Which seals its fate right? Gotta shut it down.
lines.note: Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a killer Robot on the loose! Lock your windows! Bolt your beds! Staple your fridge! Ahhh!
lines.note: Amused, he knows this is absurd

lines.text: No, wait. Just go destroy it. That other stuff is too much hassle.
lines.note: Amused. Jokingly.  Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: There's a raging Robot that needs to be shut down! I'd say it's a rabid Robot but that's not a thing. But it kinda is, you know?
lines.note: Jokingly. Telling the player what they might encounter there.

lines.text: So there's a Scorchbeast that is even more annoying than a regular Scorchbeast, if you can imagine that. You need to take it down.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Some traders saw a strange Scorchbeast that was acting differently than normal ones. Even more aggressive than usual. Might be sick. Should be dead.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: It's Scorchbeast killing time. You're looking for one particularly gnarly one. Very aggressive.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Ever hear of a Scorched with a bad reputation? Well, now you have. This one has been evading its fate for a while. But it's time to end it.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: There's one particular Scorched that has been almost... leading the others. That could just be how it looks, but... better to just kill it. You know?
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: There's a particular Scorched that has been harassing folks and wildlife lately. Very aggressive. Find it and put it out of its misery, okay?
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: There's a Radscorpion that needs to be smashed. I feel like that should be enough information, really.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Heard from some scavengers that there's a particularly nasty Radscorpion that has been causing some grief. Go squash it, hero.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: There's a big gnarly Radscorpion that needs to be squished. And the boot that needs to do it is yours. Got it?
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: You need to shut down a Sentry Bot. I know, it's risky... but, well, this is sort of urgent.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Heard there was a Sentry Bot that was just out of control. Who knows what else is wrong with it, if anything, but it needs to get terminated.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Apparently there's a Sentry Bot that is following people, following wildlife... running over bunnies. What is it with these rogue robots and bunnies?
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Anyway, it needs to be shut down. Fast.
Nobody saw it, but they heard it. The raging call, wild... chilling. One woman recognized the noise: a Sheepsquatch. It needs to be put down. Now.
Someone heard a Sheepsquatch, so we know for sure that's there. Might be alone. Those things are unpredictable.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Heard it's a Sheepsquatch. Heard as in... I heard... there's just one. Probably.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. Concerned. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Snallygasters freak me out, you know? They look like a chicken frozen in mid-explosion. Yeesh. Just kill the dang thing.
lines.note: He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Imagine this. You and a dead Snallygaster. Pretty nice, right? Well, let's make that a reality.
lines.note: He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: I've heard if you let a Snallygaster alone to stew by itself, it goes a bit.. haywire. Starts going mad. Sounds like this is what we have here.
lines.note: He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Heard there's a giant Stingwing there. Probably laying eggs or guarding them. Who knows. It's hyper-aggressive though, so go swat it.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Heard someone call this thing twenty names before I figured out what they were talking about. It's a Stingwing. That's all. Just kill it, won't you?
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: It's a Stingwing, and it's a mean one. We don't need more like it, so you need to kill it fast.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Some Super Mutant has been racking up quite the kill count and nobody has been able to track him down. Until now.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: There's a raging Super Mutant that's caused all sorts of trouble. Heard it ate someone's pack Brahmin in front of them. Find it and end it.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Heard there's a Super Mutant that's targeting folks while they sleep. It's just a terror, you know? It needs to stop.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Lurking out there, somewhere, is a creature of the swamp... something disgusting, sweaty, and downright stinky. And you need to kill it.
lines.note: Starts off ominous. turns into Good humor. NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: If there's one thing we don't need more of, it's swamp creatures. So find this one and destroy it. Okay?
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Seems like you're going after some kind of swamp creature. Just find it and kill it. No big deal. I know you can handle it.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: It's a TICK! I hate them. I just... look. Kill it. Don't tell me about it. We'll just nod at each other and that's it. I don't need to know.
lines.note: Shuddering. He hates these things. NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Here's the deal. It's a Tick. You're thinking, hey Beckett, why would you need me to kill a random Tick? Well, look. Here's why.
lines.note: Shuddering. He hates these things. NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: A, they carry diseases. B, have you seen the way they bloat up? C, their legs. Their legs. D, I'm already getting shivers. Just kill it, please?
lines.note: He's listing these out (a, b, c, d). He hates these things. NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: It's a Tick. There could be more, but there's definitely one. I bet it's just full of eggs. Just bursting... oh, I'm going to be sick. Just kill it?
lines.note: Shuddering. He hates these things. NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: There's a giant, mega Toad. A Radtoad. Whatever you want to call it. It's causing harm at this point. Just go squish it, okay?
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: Heard a Radtoad was disrupting the local wildlife. Thing is big enough to eat a Brahmin. For safety, it needs to be put down. Got it?
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: It's a Radtoad. Usually I don't care about these things, but, well. This one is causing grief and it just needs to go.
lines.note: NPC is friendly and good natured. He is telling the player what they need to kill.

lines.text: There's a vicious dog that needs to get put down. I hate doing it too, but... it needs to happen. This one has lost its mind.
lines.note: The NPC is telling the player that they need to kill this creature. NPC is good natured and friendly. Feels bad for the dog.

lines.text: Heard there's a dog, mean as can be... just viciously attacking anything that comes near it. It has to be destroyed.
lines.note: The NPC is telling the player that they need to kill this creature. NPC is good natured and friendly.

lines.text: It's a Vicious Dog and it's terrorizing folks, wildlife, even other vicious dogs. You know? It's a nasty one, and we need it to be destroyed.
lines.note: The NPC is telling the player that they need to kill this creature. NPC is good natured and friendly. Sad for the dog.

lines.text: It's a Wolf. A big mean one, too. I'd normally say let wildlife be wildlife, but not when it's causing such harm to folks. Find it and destroy it.
lines.note: The NPC is telling the player that they need to kill this creature. NPC is good natured and friendly.

lines.text: It's a huge, nasty wolf. Heard a rumor it's another one of the Beast of Beckley's pups. Dunno if that's true. Regardless, it needs to be destroyed.
lines.note: The NPC is telling the player that they need to kill this creature. NPC is good natured and friendly.

lines.text: Hmm? Uh. Kill the wolf. No? Not enough?
lines.note: He says it haltingly, as if he's trying to talk to someone who's out of it.

lines.text: I just figured you were in a hurry and wanted the info fast. Suit yourself. Anyway, be on guard for a wolf. It's killed before, and will kill again.
lines.note: Giving out the info in expanded terms

lines.text: There's a giant, angry Yao Guai that needs to be destroyed. Heard it's way beyond the point where we could lure it away with honey.
lines.note: The NPC is telling the player that they need to kill this creature. NPC is good natured and friendly.

lines.text: It's a mean Yao Guai. Could be more. Hard to pull good details from the reports due to all the screaming and flailing.
lines.note: The NPC is telling the player that they need to kill this creature. NPC is good natured and friendly.

lines.text: It's a gnarly, strong Yao Guai. No idea why it's so aggressive, quite honestly. Could be protecting something. But it's killed, so it needs to die.
lines.note: The NPC is telling the player that they need to kill this creature. NPC is good natured and friendly.

lines.text: Just got some news about a stolen weapon stashed somewhere nearby. You wanna go grab it?
I heard a rumor that there's a nifty weapon hidden in a cache nearby. It's yours if you want it.
I'm going to tell you where you can find a stolen weapon. You can sell it or keep it, and we both walk away with some caps. You good?
I recieved a tip-off about a nasty weapon that's just dying to be found. You in or what?
How would you feel if I told you that there's some poor lonely weapon out there, scared and alone, just waiting to be found by a certain someone?
lines.note: Said in an amused but also slightly flirty way.

lines.text: Not sure how long this tip will be good for, but I heard about a weapon that you might want to swipe before someone else does.
Someone from the old gang is hiding a weapon nearby, and I want you to grab it before they return. Sound good?
I love how you look in literally anything, you know that. But... hey, who doesn't like to have more armor, am I right?
I heard about some stashed armor nearby, and uh, thought it might look good on you too.
lines.note: Being funny. maybe a little sarcasm

lines.text: I just got a tip about some schnazzy armor just waiting to be stol... I mean, found. Sound like a plan?
lines.note: cutting off saying "stolen

lines.text: I've received hot news about some armor just sitting there begging to get claimed. I assume you're in?
Someone I trust told me about a stash of stolen equipment -- probably armor. I think you should go grab it. They don't deserve to keep it.
Trader stopped by while you were out, told me that some armor was yanked right off his pack brahmin. He didn't want to go back for it, but you could.
Not gonna tell you how I know this, but I know where you can pick up some free armor. I mean, you gotta work for it, but it's basically free.
I got a red hot tip on a valuable piece of junk. It's yours if you want it.
lines.note: Said jokingly.

lines.text: I have an interesting prospect for you. A highly valuable item just moments away, ready to be picked up. You in?
I know you once said you love finding and picking up bits of garbage all across Appalachia. Well, today's your lucky day, my friend.
lines.note: being silly while offering a quest

lines.text: I heard about a cache that might appeal to you. Got time?
I had some chem fiend stumble by and talk about a stash of "good shit" nearby. Could be garbage, could be legit. Want to go for it?
lines.note: fun line to play with - offering quest

lines.text: I have it on good authority that some raiders have a fat stash of junk nearby. Perhaps you should relieve them of their burden?
lines.note: have fun with the line - offering quest

lines.text: A group of Settlers passing through said they left some stuff nearby. Wanna pick through it?
Someone slipped a job in my pocket while I was snoozing. Something about a target that needs killing. You in?
Got a bounty. It involves you, a target, some acts of brutality and lots of gratuitous violence. Sound like something you want to be a part of?
lines.note: offering quest - being a little silly

lines.text: An old friend of mine heard you love laying waste to anything that crosses your path... so, can I just give you the details and let you do your thing?
lines.note: Friendly, admiring the player, genuine respect

lines.text: A "situation" popped up earlier today, and you're just the person I need to handle something quickly, confidentially and destructively. Okay?
lines.note: kind of sinister - offering a target to kill
