lines.text: What's the plan?
There is so much sky to process.
The amount of dirt is endless. Endless.
Another bird. Adding to current tally. Bird count increased.
There's so much to see, so much to experience!
That's sweet of you, A.T.H.E.N.A.
We'll be waiting.
I must continually collect more things for trades, so I will only visit sometimes.
I wanted you to have the initial selection. This is a thank you.
I like that she has a hobby. We should probably encourage it.
Confirmed. I find things and we exchange them for approximately appropriate but entirely arbitrary values of things called "caps" -- it is fair!
We know what trading is, yes. Do you have things to trade, A.T.H.E.N.A.?

topics.prompt: Meet anyone interesting?

lines.text: Interesting. Yes. I walked with one named Grahm for some time. He taught me about trading. Do you know 'trading'?

topics.prompt: Not getting into any trouble, are you?

lines.text: Trouble. What is trouble? I was in trouble when I was in Sugar Grove. So no. I am not getting into 'trouble'.

topics.prompt: Have you been adventuring?

lines.text: Adventuring. That word makes sense. Yes, I have been adventuring.
Hello, Subject Daguerre.
I'm... pretty surprised to see you again, A.T.H.E.N.A.
A.T.H.E.N.A. is that you?
Hey. We've got a, uh, visitor.
lines.note: A little nervous and confused. This is a robot that almost killed you, but now it's come to visit, ostensibly in peace.

lines.text: There is so much sky to process.
The amount of dirt is endless. Endless.
Another bird. Adding to current tally. Bird count increased.
This freedom you have granted me. Does the word "gratitude" apply here?
The practice of trade is filled with fascinating rituals. One customer enjoyed it so much, she requested a chronicle of our exchange. She called it a "receipt.
And greetings to you as well, friend. I have seen many things now... thanks to you.
Don't mind me... not here to cause any trouble.
Hard to sleep at night sometimes, but not because of regrets. It's because of the ants.
Best to look on the bright side. Unless that side is a nuke blast. Don't look at those.
Not looking for a fight, friends.
World doesn't need any more angry robots, that's for sure.
Not trying to start anything, just wanted to stop by...
Just wanted to see how you folks were doing, that's all.
I was in the neighborhood, so to speak...
Picked up some things while I was out... since you've got dibs, well, I brought them by.
I'm glad we've set all that stuff behind us. It's good to move on, right?
Could always be worse, always... probably, anyway.
Just a friendly visit from your old pal, Emerson...
Not trying to start anything, just wanted to stop by...
Just wanted to see how you folks were doing, that's all.
I was in the neighborhood, so to speak...
Picked up some things while I was out... since you've got dibs, well, I brought them by.
I'm glad we've set all that stuff behind us. It's good to move on, right?
Could always be worse, always... probably, anyway.
Thanks, Emerson. I appreciate it, I do.
lines.note: Grateful but distanced. She doesn't feel like he can be trusted anymore, but he did do a kindness.

lines.text: We have some questions for you, though...
lines.note: She gestures to the player.

lines.text: Why can't you just tell me everything that happened?
lines.note: She is genuinely upset by the fact that he can't or won't tell her.

lines.text: Because I have to finish my job, too. I had one more task to do here in Appalachia, and... I'm close. Let me clean up my own messes.
lines.note: He can't tell her what it is.

lines.text: I have to go. I'll drop off some more Emergence Kits soon. Just please, stop looking into this. There's a Robobrain on your trail, focus on that.
lines.note: He seems nervous and anxious.

lines.text: I brought another Emergence Kit... it's well past its expiration, but, well... everything is. Should be fine.
lines.note: He is trying to appear calm and decent, they parted poorly last time and this is his peace offering.

topics.prompt: Enough, Emerson. Why should we trust anything you say?

lines.text: I'm a different man now. It's been decades. I've been eating out of trash cans. I barely remember anything from back then.
lines.note: Pleading, indignant a bit... he's different now.

lines.text: I have been trying to help when and where I can. I promise, I have. I've diverted the robots when possible... I just couldn't destroy them myself.
lines.note: He admits it.

lines.text: I came here to Appalachia because I knew the ship was running out of fuel, and I knew it its auto-pilot would steer it here.
lines.note: Worried, nervous, he is actually a bit scared of the player.

topics.prompt: Is the serum causing these headaches?

lines.text: I honestly am not sure. It's possible. When we first used the serum on Robobrains, some of them had terrible hostile outbursts...
lines.note: Remembering back to those days...

lines.text: Most of those Robobrains were put down, but... you should adjust your scanner to make sure you pick them up too. Just in case...
lines.note: Friendly tip... quiet. He's embarrassed.

topics.prompt: We know you made the deal with Arktos Pharma. Why?

lines.text: It was my job. I was told to do that. I don't remember the reasons why anymore. And what does it matter, anyway? It's done. It's over.
lines.note: He's not lying, but he isn't saying the whole truth.

lines.text: I presumed Sofia might be in need of another kit.
I can only guess how hard this has all been...
I'm only looking to help where I can.
Hey there. Look who decided to grace us with his presence?
lines.note: A little suspicious, but mostly earnest.

lines.text: Look who's here. Bearing more gifts.
lines.note: Emerson's back and you're ready to grill him for information. You suspect his gift might be dangerous.

lines.text: Everybody's gotta earn a living somehow, Sofia...
Are these for sale? Seriously?
I just wanted to stop by with some peace offerings. That's all.
I'm not here to make any trouble.
Oh... this is awkward.
Stay positive... just... stay positive.
We all do what we have to do...
I should build a place like this.
Just keep doing what you're doing.
Don't mind me. I come in peace. Just trying to earn a living.
I have managed to collect a few interesting bits and baubles. You're welcome to peruse if you'd like.
You did... so much for Sofia.
lines.note: Grateful, but you're too proud to say "thank you.

topics.prompt: Get lost, kid.

lines.text: Wait! You wouldn't just be getting rid of me. I also have an alter ego!

topics.prompt: Do you mean a pet?

lines.text: Oh! I'd like a pet someday, like a rabbit in a hat, or a cat! But I mean myself and my alter ego.

topics.prompt: We? I only see you.

lines.text: Well, that would be an illusion! I'm actually two people. Myself, and my alter ego.

topics.prompt: Welcome aboard, both of you.

lines.text: On behalf of both myself and the Inspector, thank you!

topics.prompt: Great, that kind of imagination is welcome here.

lines.text: Thanks! I try to read plenty of books. Not all of them have pictures either. Maybe someday I'll show you!

topics.prompt: I'm totally going to regret this.

lines.text: That's not a "yes," but that doesn't sound like a "no" either! I'll go get my stuff.
lines.note: trying to convince herself the player wants her in camp

topics.prompt: Of course you can.

lines.text: Thanks! Not everyone has room for both me and my alter ego.

topics.prompt: Alter ego?

I really like to read books. They're a magic spell that takes you to another place.
Whenever I see a word I don't know, I write down what I think it means. It's like an investigation.
I like all types of books, not just comic ones. School books, joke books, books on holotape. They're all pretty great.
If there's a crime afoot, my detective skills will find it!
My name? The Inspector! My mission? To uncover my past!
You've given away your last bottlecap, Commie-Kazi! The Inspector is here to restore the free market!
lines.note: Cutting this line, it's way too similar to Maul's

lines.text: The Inspector tried to cast a spell once to make my imaginary friend real. But I guess there's some things that even superheroes can't do.
Mornings give me the eye crispies.
I brushed and flossed today. It's important to build good habits, even when you aren't feeling super.
Rain, rain, go away, come again another day.
lines.condition: GetCurrentWeatherHasKeyword: s_wt_StormMistyRainy, GetCurrentWeatherHasKeyword: s_wt_StormRain, GetCurrentWeatherHasKeyword: MTR_Weather_MistyRainy, GetCurrentWeatherHasKeyword: MTR_Weather_Rain

lines.text: Another Inspector? But who is the real one! Find out, on this special Hubris Comics presentation of The Inspector vs. The Inspector!
Grognak is the muscle. The Shroud and the Mistress are the spies. And Manta Man does ... I don't know, fish man stuff.
But only the Inspector can solve the case!
I may be a magician detective, but I still have plenty of attack spells. Water balloons, motor oil, paint bombs, the works.
Wanna play the Unstoppables Board Game? It'd be good to brush up on our crime fighting techniques.
We should have the other Unstoppables over for the holidays. That and making Christmas albums is just what superheroes do.
I like cats. They're good at sneaky stuff. But if you need a magician's assistant, it's best to go with a rabbit.
You should talk to the Inspector sometime. She's way more interesting than I am.
Know any good card tricks? If so you should teach the Inspector. She'd really like that.
I like to cook for fun. But right now I can only make teas.
I like making simple fern flower tea. Why? Because it has "simple" right in the name!
I really like tea, and so does the Inspector. But sometimes she drinks a Nuka-Cola, to keep her eyes and spirits up.
I made a pumpkin soup the other day! Minus the pumpkin. I guess it was just soup.
I wonder if you can ask Yasmin to help me with my cooking. I heard she's the greatest chef in the whole whole whole whole whole wide world!
If it gets really hot, we could have a water balloon fight. But I don't throw so good.
Hi there! My name's Daphne. Would it be okay if we set up shop here?
I go by many names. The Enchantress of Appalachia! The Wizard of the Wasteland! The Inspector of the Uninspected! And sometimes Daphne.
lines.note: Inspector until the end, then Daphne

items.description: Help extend The Brotherhood's reach with your own initiate for your C.A.M.P.

lines: Can be purchased with certain bundles from the Atom Shop.

topics.prompt: Who are you?

lines.text: Don't worry, I'm not here to cause trouble!
I didn't even know Knight-Errant was a rank until they told me about you. Is that above or below a Knight?
Crap, should I be saluting? I should be saluting, right?
Initiate Del Lawson, at your service. I'm with the Brotherhood at Fort Atlas.
I'm on assignment to set up a forward supply and maintenance operation. I was on the lookout for a good location and saw what you've built here.
I should salute. Sir! I should salute, sir.
Sir!
I should salute. Ma'am! I should salute, ma'am.
Ma'am!

topics.prompt: What are you doing here?

lines.text: I'm here under orders from Paladin Rahmani.
I'm here under orders from Knight Shin.

topics.prompt: I don't appreciate uninvited guests.

lines.text: Sorry, sorry! I'm not here to cause any trouble. I'm on assignment.

topics.prompt: What's your take on Shin and Rahmani?

lines.text: Paladin Rahmani and Knight Shin, you mean. Come on, you're an Initiate! You could get in trouble being so casual. Anyway...
lines.condition: GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst", GetQuestCompleted: BS01_MQ08_Defense "The Best Defense", GetValue: BS01_AV_IsInitiate
lines.note: very much in the mode of trying to get the class delinquent to behave even though the teacher's not around

lines.text: I guess you're asking about the Paladin cutting off communication with the rest of the Brotherhood, back in California.
lines.condition: GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst", GetQuestCompleted: BS01_MQ08_Defense "The Best Defense", GetValue: BS01_AV_IsInitiate

lines.text: Is it weird if I'm not bothered by it? I know a lot of people are upset - Knight Shin sure is - but I only know the Brotherhood here.
lines.condition: GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst", GetQuestCompleted: BS01_MQ08_Defense "The Best Defense", GetValue: BS01_AV_IsInitiate

lines.text: Paladin Rahmani, she's... well, you've met her! It's like she always has a plan, and is always looking out for us.
lines.condition: GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst", GetQuestCompleted: BS01_MQ08_Defense "The Best Defense", GetValue: BS01_AV_IsInitiate

lines.text: She says the Brotherhood needs to be different, to protect people. I trust her.
lines.condition: GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst", GetQuestCompleted: BS01_MQ08_Defense "The Best Defense", GetValue: BS01_AV_IsInitiate

topics.prompt: Do you have any other family?

lines.text: Not that I know about, but it's not impossible I've got some more distant relatives out there somewhere.
I had a brother. He died before I was born, fighting in the war.
He'd of been... 44 now? Mom and Dad didn't talk about him much. Too painful.
I'm glad Paladin Rahmani's still leading us. Knight Shin... he's a good man, but everything's black and white for him.
Threats get eliminated. Potential threats get eliminated. I feel like he doesn't really see the point in helping people.
He'll be happier back in California. I hope he makes it.
Honestly, I'm really glad Paladin Rahmani is still in charge, but...
I wish there had been another way. Knight Shin might not've been my favorite, but there should've been a peaceful resolution.
Maybe that's na�ve of me. I just hope it's the last time something like this happens.
This isn't how I wanted it to work out. Knight Shin's not a bad man, but I worry about the Brotherhood under his leadership.
I trusted Paladin Rahmani's vision for us. I want to help people! I don't think Knight Shin cares much about it.
Still... You can't deny he's effective. When you go into combat, you couldn't ask for someone better by your side.
The falling out was one thing. Forcing Paladin Rahmani out would've been another.
But killing her? That was... I'm really trying to understand. How could that have been necessary?
There's no going back, though. We've got to trust him. I hope maybe Scribe Valdez will temper his harsher instincts.

topics.prompt: What were your parents like?

lines.text: Pretty normal, I guess? I was born a couple of years after the bombs.
Mom and Dad were already living in a little settlement with other survivors by then.
Dad farmed; Mom was a mechanic. We had it better than a lot of folks in the Wasteland.
They loved each other, so much. They liked making little gifts for each other, and for me. Right up until the end.
I guess maybe they were a little smothering? They didn't plan on having a kid, but once I showed up they were thrilled.
Very protective. Especially Mom. They always worried about me, tried to keep me out of any kind of danger.
Heck, I wasn't even allowed to talk to the traders who passed through town sometimes.

topics.prompt: Let's change the subject.

lines.text: No problem!

topics.prompt: How are you feeling, Initiate? After everything that's happened with the Brotherhood?

lines.text: Permission to speak freely, sir?
lines.condition: GetValue: Lawson_AskedAboutBoSEnding_AV, GetIsSex, GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst"

lines.text: Permission to speak freely, ma'am?
lines.condition: GetValue: Lawson_AskedAboutBoSEnding_AV, GetIsSex, GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst"

lines.text: I think I've said everything I feel comfortable saying. Can we talk about something else?

topics.prompt: I had some other questions.

lines.text: Okay, sure!

topics.prompt: If it's not too upsetting, what happened to your parents?

lines.text: It's all right, I don't mind. It's been a few years since.
It was just old age and health catching up, really. I guess it hits harder now than before the war.
They were pretty up there when they had me. Mom was old enough she thought kids were a closed door. Surprise!
I don't remember either of them without some gray in their hair. Not even when I was a kid.
lines.note: though this is a story about their deaths, remembering his parents is a positive memory

lines.text: Mom went first. Caught a bad cold, never really got better. Dad and I were both with her at the bedside when she passed.
lines.note: This is the part that hurts; it's been some years but this memory sticks out

lines.text: When she was gone, I think the spirit just went out of Dad. She was the love of his life. He went a year later, in his sleep.
lines.note: The sadness really takes hold here; he's not on the edge of breaking down, but this is still hard to remember.

lines.text: Sorry. I'm all right. I still miss them.
lines.note: Pulling himself together here.

topics.prompt: Was it your mother who taught you to be a mechanic?

lines.text: Sure was! Mom was always happiest with a wrench in her hand and grease stains on her clothes.
Part of her keeping me out of trouble was putting me to work. Fixing generators, farm equipment, you know.
Most of our bonding time was over disassembled engines. I think she liked passing on the skill. Took pride in it.

topics.prompt: How was farm life?

lines.text: Quiet, mostly. Wasn't very big, just a patch big enough to grow some food and trade with the other folks in town for what we didn't have.
I stuck to the mechanical stuff, with Mom. Dad actually forbade me to help with the crops.
He said, "Del, I love you, but whatever the opposite of a green thumb is, you've got it.
lines.note: this is an amusing, happy memory

topics.prompt: Know anything about the Settlers?

lines.text: Oh, sure. Came into West Virginia with a group of them. The ones that are left ended up at Foundation.
I've met a few folks there. Good people! Tad and Gloria, the couple who work the stockroom, were really nice.

topics.prompt: Met any Raiders?

lines.text: Not unless you count dodging bullets they sent my way!
The really crazy ones, Blood Eagles - they're the bunch that hit the settlers I moved here with.
I hear the Raiders up at Crater aren't as crazy, but I'm not looking to test that.

topics.prompt: What can you tell me about the Responders?

lines.text: Oh! The folks at the Refuge? I stopped in there for a bit before I signed up with the Brotherhood.
Everyone's really kind there. I guess you have to be, to do what they're doing.
I hear Initiate Ellison is stationed there now. I wonder how he's doing?

topics.prompt: Where are you from?

lines.text: Virginia, originally. Not too far from here, but far enough it wasn't easy getting here.
Never saw too much of it, actually. The settlement I grew up in was pretty sheltered.
I never really went anywhere until after my parents died.

topics.prompt: Can I ask about your family?

lines.text: Sure thing! Anything in particular?

topics.prompt: How'd you end up with the Brotherhood?

lines.text: Well, after my parents passed, I didn't have a lot of reason to stick around anymore.
I'd been in one town my whole life, so I wanted to see what else was out there.
Joined up with some settlers moving into West Virginia. Seemed like as good a way to do it as any. Figured I'd help fix stuff, just like back home.
Well, we got here, lost people to Scorched, some to raiders, and we needed farmers more than mechanics.
I was as bad at that as Dad always said. Almost starved that first winter! Then the Brotherhood showed up, recruiting.
lines.note: this was a bad time for Del, but it's kind of funny now, and the memory of his father is a good one

lines.text: They needed people with technical skills, and I was just happy not to have to grow my own dinner!

topics.prompt: I want to talk about something else.

lines.text: You got it!
Please, man. Do NOT call me Elmer. Del's good.
I'd really appreciate it if you stuck with Del, sir.
I'd really appreciate it if you stuck with Del, ma'am.

topics.prompt: Is "Del" short for anything?

lines.text: Unfortunately, yeah.
lines.note: the thing he didn't want to be asked about

lines.text: My first name's Elmer. Named after my Mom's grandfather, apparently.
lines.note: Not happy about this

lines.text: Only fight my parents ever had, according to Dad. Mom won, of course.
lines.note: this story is still a fond memory of his parents, despite disliking his name; it amuses him

lines.text: Dad called me Del, and it stuck. Thank God.
lines.note: lighter tone - the story has a happy ending after all

lines.text: This might sound crazy, but... Aliens! Actual, real-life spacemen!
It was crazy. A flying saucer and everything, right over Charleston! I couldn't believe it!
There were these big machines pulsing with energy, and big-headed skinny green guys just popping in out of thin air everywhere!
I was under orders to guard our camp, so, uh... I didn't actually get that close. I saw everything, though!
Ever hear of the Grafton Monster? When I first joined the Brotherhood, some of the other Initiates told me stories.
Never believed them. A giant, headless monster that shoots acid from its back? Crazy. Figured it was just them hazing the new guy.
Until I saw it myself on patrol. You know Hemlock Holes, the old golf course past the dam?
We were south of there when this thing comes over a little rise. Had to be almost eight feet tall! No head!
I don't know how a headless giant can see you, but it saw us, that's for sure. The squad booked it out of there, double-time, believe me.
You know, to report back about it. You gotta report that kind of thing. Right?
Haven't seen it myself, but Initiate Hewsen swears there's a giant snapping turtle that walks on two legs, down around the Cranberry Bog.
I actually trust her on it. There's enough weird stuff in Appalachia that a giant turtle-man doesn't even rate anymore.
What is it about West Virginia? Every time I think I have the hang of things there's something else crazy happening here!
It is pretty exciting, though.
lines.note: contrasting the previous statement

lines.text: If you haven't already run into them, you probably want to steer clear of the Cult of the Mothman.
Raiders are one thing, but the cultists are always raving about the Mothman while they try to kill you. And they really like bones, for some reason.
A lot. I don't get it. Moths don't even have bones. Does the Mothman have bones? Does it eat bones?
Okay, so, maybe this isn't that weird, but... there's this old monorail pylon, north of Watoga? Still got a train up top.
Somebody built stairs to get up there and everything. Ran across it once and had to check it out, since it seemed abandoned.
Somebody was doing some weird science experiment up there, I think. They'd built a big ring onto the next pylon, like for the train to pass through.
Didn't get a chance to really check it out though. Spotted some Super Mutants in the area and had to make myself scarce, fast.
Still wonder what that was about, though.

topics.prompt: No problem, Del.

lines.text: Thank you! Even just saying "Elmer" feels weird.

topics.prompt: No can do, Elmer.

lines.text: Aw, c'mon, man. That's not funny.
Aw, c'mon, sir. That's not funny.
Aw, c'mon, ma'am. That's not funny.

topics.prompt: That won't be a problem, Initiate.

lines.text: Right! Yes! Protocol! Why would you ever need to call me by my first name? Forget I mentioned it.
lines.note: kind of embarrassed - he's asked a commanding officer something beneath their notice

topics.prompt: Why'd you join the Brotherhood?

lines.text: I might've already mentioned I was not cut out for farming. Can't keep a crop alive to, well, save my life.
Never going to be a Raider, and I don't like living alone. Could have stayed at Foundation, maybe, but when the Brotherhood came recruiting...
I don't know. I guess I've felt a little lost since my parents died. Joining the Brotherhood, things were simpler. Direction. Orders.
The uniform's pretty good, too, right?

topics.prompt: So, what's your role in the Brotherhood? Besides Initiate, I mean.

lines.text: Well, right now it's to organize this supply and maintenance outpost, like we discussed. Thanks again for permitting it, by the way!
You mean more generally though, right? Well, I do whatever the officers say, of course. Being an Initiate and all.
We're all training to become Knights one day. There were only three Brotherhood who came here from California, so they need to fill out the ranks.
It's funny, though - most of the time they've got me working for Scribe Valdez. I suppose she needs a lot of help, being the only Scribe.
I'm sure they'll put me through the more intensive combat training soon enough, though. Can't be a Knight without that!

topics.prompt: What is the Brotherhood of Steel?

lines.text: You don't know? Oh, man, I thought everybody knew about them by now. Us, I mean.
The Brotherhood is...kind of a military? We protect and secure technology to prevent its misuse. That's how it was explained to me, anyway.
I'm not really the person to ask about history, though. If you want to know more, you can always head to Fort Atlas.
It's a perfect location, and it looked like you had everything I could need to get up and running, so I was hoping we could help each other out.
You've got a great location and setup, perfect for the assignment. I was hoping we could join forces. Fellow Brotherhood, and all.
You've got everything I need to get things up and running already. Would you be willing to allow me to run the operation from here?

topics.prompt: Will your services be available to me?

lines.text: Hrm. My orders were to aid Brotherhood soldiers in the field; they didn't say anything about civilians.
But... if you're letting me stay and operate out of your property, I'm sure Command will understand. Probably.

topics.prompt: So, what, you're a mechanic?

lines.text: Among other things, yeah. I've been working with Scribe Valdez a lot, doing maintenance in the armory, that kind of thing.
If it's broke, I can fix it, and if I can't fix it, I've probably got something squirreled away that'll help anyway.
I've also managed to put together a decent supply of weapons, ammo, armor... even some schematics if you're into doing it yourself.
That's kind of why I'm here - you've got the storage space already!
I can also help out with any power armor you've got. Scribe Valdez says I've got a real knack with it.
Everything a Brotherhood soldier might need on patrol in the Wasteland! Let me show you.
All the materiel I could scrape together. I'm sure there's something you could use.
Weapons, ammo, and more. Take a look!
I've got options defensive, offensive, and recuperative. Just like I was ordered!
Anything I could find that fit the mission brief. I can guarantee everything's been fully refurbished.
First aid, armor, guns, even some schematics. Have a look!
Basically, they want me to stockpile stuff and do any maintenance required for Brotherhood soldiers that might pass through.
Until the falling out, anyway. Probably best not to talk about that right now.

topics.prompt: Supply and maintenance operation?

lines.text: Yep! My orders were to locate a suitable site and prepare a cache of goods and materiel to aid any Brotherhood field operations in the area.

topics.prompt: I could use a hand with my power armor.

lines.text: I'm sorry, but you've got to give me time to restock for more repairs.
Come check with me again later and I'll see what I can do.
You got it!
Right away, sir!
lines.condition: GetValue: Lawson_HasReceivedBuffBefore_AV, GetIsSex, GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst"

lines.text: Right away, ma'am!
lines.condition: GetValue: Lawson_HasReceivedBuffBefore_AV, GetIsSex, GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst"

topics.prompt: Actually, strike that. I'm all set for now.

lines.text: If you say so. I'll be here if you change your mind.
Anyway, if you want, I can give the whole suit a full tune up.
Top to bottom treatment. Check all the linkages, refurbish the servos, clean out the lines...
Knock out those dents that compromise armor efficacy. Total overhaul.
I can get you not just up and running again, but even a bit better than before.
For a while, anyway. Wear and tear is killer on power armor.
Just give me a tick...

topics.prompt: Permission to stay granted, Initiate.

lines.text: Sir! Thank you, sir!
Ma'am! Thank you, ma'am!

topics.prompt: Sure thing, Del. Always happy to help another Initiate.

lines.text: Great! Thank you! Really glad I ran into you out here. This is going to make things a lot easier.
If you need a hand with anything, let me know!
I just never expected to be working on this directly under a Knight! Knight-Errant! Sorry!

topics.prompt: Nothing for now, actually.

lines.text: All right, then! Let me know if you change your mind.

topics.prompt: I'm in need of your expertise.

lines.text: Absolutely! What do you need?
I'll get to work right away. You won't regret it!
What did you want to know, sir?
What did you want to know, ma'am?

topics.prompt: Have you seen much of Appalachia?

lines.text: Some. Not as much as I'd like! I hear a lot of stories, and I've met some folks out on patrol with the Brotherhood.
Anything in particular you wanted to know?

topics.prompt: I'd like to know more about you, Del.

lines.text: Me? Really? Well... Okay, what did you want to know?
Really? Wow. The officers don't usually take the time for casual chats.
I mean, uh, they're so busy! I'm sure they would if they had the time.
I just mean I appreciate you asking.

topics.prompt: What exactly is it you need?

lines.text: Nothing! Well, use of your facilities here, actually. Permission to stay and run the operation from your camp
I won't get in the way, I promise!
Super Mutants! Stumbled across some when Knight Shin took me on patrol.
Feral ghouls are one thing, but Super Mutants talk! Hard to treat them as just monsters when you hear them talking.
The whole "slaughtering and eating people" thing, though, makes it pretty easy to look past that, I guess.
Knight Shin didn't even bat an eye. "Just keep me loaded," he said. Cool as a cucumber! He ran through four belts of ammo before it was over.
A few of us were on a training patrol and we ran into a nest of feral ghouls!
Terrifying! They just run at you, tripping over themselves trying to grab you.
I only had a sidearm because I was humping a lot of our additional gear, and the others only had light rifles. We had to make a break for it.
I think I set a record for running the 100 meter sprint while hauling sixty pounds of equipment!
Mirelurk got its claws on my ankle once.
I was on a training exercise, busy setting up some monitoring equipment by the river. Very cool stuff!
Damn thing slipped up out of the water while I was focused on that, and SNAP! Before I even realized it was there.
Good thing the other two Initiates came back right then.
Took it out and got my leg bandaged up before that crab jerk left me lopsided
Now, the Scorched... they scare me. Seriously!
The crystals growing out of them? The creepy things they say! Scribe Valdez says they're a hive mind, which seems crazy.
I've managed to steer clear and avoid direct fights with them. Hope it stays that way.
A Yao Guai got the drop on Paladin Rahmani and some of us recruits one time.
She was leading a training exercise. Real basic stuff, you know, baby's first patrol. You really felt lucky to be learning directly from her.
Anyway, just a bunch of fresh recruits learning how to march without tripping over our own feet, and this huge thing comes barreling out of the trees.
The Paladin split its skull with her glaive faster than any of us could process the panic! Just amazing!

topics.prompt: Let's talk about something else.

lines.text: Whatever you need!

topics.prompt: Seen anything weird?

lines.text: Anything weird? Well...
Weird, sir? Well, now that you mention it...
lines.condition: GetValue: Lawson_AskedAboutTrouble_AV, GetIsSex, GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst"

lines.text: Weird, ma'am? Well, now that you mention it...
Let's see...

topics.prompt: Any other exciting stories?

lines.text: Hrm...

topics.prompt: Run into much trouble here?

lines.text: Not too much, besides the raiders when I first moved here. But there's been a few scrapes since then, on patrol with the Brotherhood.
Why do they keep assigning me maintenance duty? How am I going to make Knight without more combat rotations?
God, I hate Bloodbugs.
Nothing like the shine of freshly-polished armor.
Why'd I haul this stuff all the way out here? I haven't seen any other Brotherhood out this way. Oh, well. Orders are orders.
Crap. Did I spill something, or was that stain there already?
This is a pretty cushy posting, all things considered.
Wish the weather would clear up.
lines.condition: IsInWeather: NewWeatherRain_MTR, IsInWeather: NewWeatherRain, IsInWeather: NewWeatherMistyRainy, IsInWeather: NewWeatherMistyRainy_Bog, IsInWeather: NewWeatherMistyRainy_MTR, IsInWeather: NewWeatherMistyRainy_Swamp

lines.text: Another day, another chance to practice proper equipment maintenance.
I wonder if any of the other Initiates have made Knight while I've been gone?
When in doubt, use more tape.
Scribe Valdez says most problems are either something moves when it's not supposed to, or doesn't move when it is supposed to.
This is a nice place! Never was much of a builder, myself.
Hey, hey!
Hope I'm not in the way. Am I in the way?
Watch your step; I'm might've spilled some grease around here. Sorry about that!
How's it going?
Everything all right?
Whoa, are you okay? That looks like it hurts!
lines.note: sees player is injured

lines.text: Oh, crap, what happened? I've got some first aid supplies if you need them.
lines.note: sees player is injured

lines.text: You're looking pretty rough... You're going to want to get some RadAway in you, fast.
lines.note: player is suffering from radiation sickness

lines.text: Did I forget a holiday? That's quite an outfit.
lines.note: player is in a costume

lines.text: Sir!
Ma'am!
Now, that's what I'm talking about! You need a tune-up on that armor, let me know!
Hello!
Hey there!
What can I do for you?
Anything I can help you with?
Oh, hey! I've got some time, what's up?
Something you need, sir?
Something you need, ma'am?
Hey! Did you need something?
What's happening?
Always have time, if you wanted to chat.
Oh! Hello! You must be the owner of the place. Sorry about just showing up unannounced.
Oh! Initiate! I didn't realize this place was yours. Apologies for the intrusion!
lines.condition: GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst", GetValue: Lawson_IntroCompleted_AV, GetValue: BS01_AV_IsInitiate

lines.text: Knight-Errant! I didn't expect... I'm sorry! They didn't tell me you'd be out here.
lines.condition: GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst", GetValue: Lawson_IntroCompleted_AV, GetValue: BS01_AV_IsInitiate

topics.prompt: Okay, Del. You're welcome to stay.

lines.text: Fantastic! Thank you!
I'll try to stay out of your way, don't worry. If you need anything, just ask!
No! Well, you don't know me, but I've heard about you. Nothing but good things, don't worry!
Of course! As a member of the Brotherhood, you're exactly who I'm supposed to be helping out here!
Right! Yes! Of course!
I might've mentioned, I've spent a decent amount of time working with Scribe Valdez, helping maintain the power armor for the officers.
Yeah, absolutely! What about them?
Not sure what I can tell you that you don't already know. Anything specific?
Of course! You probably know more than me, sir, but I'll answer what I can.
lines.condition: GetIsSex, GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst", GetValue: BS01_AV_IsInitiate

lines.text: Of course! You probably know more than me, ma'am, but I'll answer what I can.
lines.condition: GetIsSex, GetQuestCompleted: BS02_MQ05_Catalyst "The Catalyst", GetValue: BS01_AV_IsInitiate

lines.text: All set! You're good to go.
Like Scribe Valdez says, regular maintenance is half the battle!

items.description: Meet Dottie, the ghoul with a theory for everything.
items.howToObtain: Can be purchased with certain bundles from the Atom Shop.

lines: Can be purchased with certain bundles from the Atom Shop.
Adds Energy Resistance, Increases Endurance, and Intelligence by 1.

lines.text: Hey you!
lines.note: Trying to get attention

lines.text: You're probably gonna meet a fate worse than death, you know. Like being trapped in the deep abyss. Or paying taxes.
You know this is a simulation right?
lines.note: Said in a very matter of fact manner

lines.text: Every now and again I think "I know you're listening" very loudly. Helps throw them off.
lines.note: Said like she's giving advice

lines.text: You don't need to be afraid... But you probably should be.
lines.note: Second line is said quietly. Almost as if whispering.

lines.text: We should have code words so we know if we're being watched. If I ever say "the", we need to prepare to leave the area immediately.
lines.note: Emphasize both instances of the word "the

lines.text: Oh, it's you. Hmm, or a very convincing clone.
lines.note: Starts normal. Becomes suspicious on the second line.

topics.prompt: Tell me about the Enclave.

lines.text: What's there to know? Secret underground society? Yeah right. Why do you think they have a logo? Not to communicate between members, but to distract.
lines.note: Dismissive of the idea.

lines.text: People looking for the shadow government find the Enclave and stop looking. But then they'll never know who's really pulling their strings.

topics.prompt: Tell me about Super Mutants.

lines.text: Obviously they're just the Government's plan for the next wave of soldiers. Strong, dumb, and easily manipulated. That's what the Government wants.
Thankfully they seem resilient to Government control. I'd hate to see them organized under one leader.

topics.prompt: Tell me about Vault-Tec.

lines.text: The only trustworthy American company. They promised vaults and we got them. What more could you say about reinforced holes in the ground?

topics.prompt: Tell me about the Mothman Cultists.

lines.text: Everyone knows Mothman was on the president's payroll. Think about it!
lines.note: Mothman is a local cryptid

lines.text: Mothman shows up, an entire bridge disappears but no one cares because they're busy looking for the man with the wings.
lines.note: Emphasis on "no one cares

lines.text: Why'd he do it you ask? That bridge was made of steel, and that would have gotten in the way of the upcoming fish neural network.
Anyone still worshipping him must have been indoctrinated by Government agents at a young age.

topics.prompt: Tell me about the Scorched.

lines.text: A failed communication network. Those crystals can transmit thoughts, but they also infect everyone.
Congratulations Mr. Government, you can communicate over long distances as long as you want to say "Not Us".
lines.note: Emphasis on "Mr. Government" Should drop to a mocking voice when saying "Not Us".

lines.text: Wait... maybe that's what they wanted. A system to identify people not under their control. I should write this down!

topics.prompt: Tell me about the aliens.

lines.text: You believe in aliens? Come on. Everyone knows that's just a partnership between Hollywood and the Government.
Mr. Wyeth says action, "Aliens" show up and everyone is so busy running away they don't notice that the Government is using that time to restock the fish!
lines.note: Pronounced Why-eth

topics.prompt: Tell me about Watoga.

lines.text: It's a town full of robots. Robots pulling off one heck of a performance.
You see those robots and think "wow, they're high-tech" but you would be wrong! Robots aren't that big!
lines.note: The quotation should be said sarcastically.

lines.text: What you see are actually vehicles being piloted by smaller robots. That way you underestimate how small and sneaky robots actually are.
They hide in the grass, and that's why I always stomp when I'm exploring.

topics.prompt: Did you know the Government made a vault filled with gold?

lines.text: I did not. Though I'm not surprised. Gold is very valuable.
After all, it's the main component in their mind reading devices. Hmm, it must be worth its weight in bottle caps.

topics.prompt: That's enough theories for now.

lines.text: I prefer "ignored truths" but sure.
lines.note: Can't believe the player called them "theories

topics.prompt: [Intelligence +8] For us to stand against the Government, I need to know what they already know.

lines.text: *Sigh* You're right. You need to know more to make sure I don't get swapped out by a near perfect replica.
lines.note: A bit defeated.

topics.prompt: [Charisma +8] Well, maybe you're a Government plant. Only way to prove you're not is to tell me more.

lines.text: I- you- argh! I hate that insinuation, but you make a good point. Fine! Ask your questions.
lines.note: Tripping over her words at the beginning. Emphasis on "hate

topics.prompt: You're right. The less I know, the better.

lines.text: Glad we're in agreement. Was there anything else?
*Deep breath* just know that names, locations, and events may be modified to protect... certain parties.
lines.note: Context: Disclaimer before talking about herself.

topics.prompt: Where are you from?

lines.text: Redacted, West Virginia.
Don't look at me like that. No one knows where I grew up, not even me. It was just "The Bunker" under "The House".
lines.note: Emphasis on quotations.

lines.text: Considering how it was when I left, it's probably now under "The Water". Darn conniving fish.
lines.note: Second sentence said almost to herself.

topics.prompt: Where did you learn all of this information?

lines.text: I was lucky that my parents were the smartest people I knew. Coincidently, they were the only people I knew.
There was a big "event" when I was young and my parents took me to a safe space where they taught me about the real world.
They started speaking in coded phrases and grunts before I left, but I guess they had to become more secretive since water started trickling in.
lines.note: Trying to justify their actions.

lines.text: Maybe I can find them again one day and they can teach me the solution to their cipher.

topics.prompt: How hard did you have to hit your head for all this to make sense?

lines.text: I'm very fortunate that this information comes to me naturally.
lines.note: Oblivious to the insult.

lines.text: I've met some... unfortunate souls that needed repeated percussive maintenance before they accepted the truth.

topics.prompt: Assuming you're right about everything, what's the plan here?

lines.text: Simple. Cut the strings that bind us to their whim. Let's see what they do with their cross brace when the puppets have left the stage.

topics.prompt: How did you become a ghoul?

lines.text: A what?
lines.note: Confused. No idea what the player is talking about.

topics.prompt: [Flirt] Since we're doing an under cover investigation, how about we investigate under some covers?

lines.text: O-o-oh, w-well I uh think-- OH! Oh-oh no.
lines.note: Realizes their meaning halfway through.

lines.text: I- I had heard reports about "love" being in the air. I didn't know it was weaponized already.
Hoo-boy. Let's NOT take some deep breaths and maybe this psychological warfare will pass.
lines.note: Letting them down gently.

lines.text: I'm going over here to... hahaha pretend this didn't happen. Let me know when... that is out of your system.

topics.prompt: Let's talk about something else.

lines.text: Yeah, let's talk about some actually important secrets.

topics.prompt: You're delusional! Do you even realize that nothing you've said is correct?

lines.text: Oh really? How do you know anything? A teacher told you? You find out for yourself?
Well guess what? You and me? We're exactly the same.
The only difference between us is I never took anything at face value. It also helps that my teachers weren't selected by the Government!
You don't want to accept the truth? Fine. I won't tell you.
But when you realize there's more to the world than you understand, I'll be right here, ready to explain it.

topics.prompt: You said something about setting up shop?

lines.text: DSSBNUD!
lines.note: She's reading an Acronym like it's a word. Pronounced Diss-Buh-Nud

lines.text: Everyone talks about solar panels and how they're "so helpful". Oh? Are they?
Or are they actually being used by the Government to absorb the power of the Sun so they can use it as a deadly sky laser?
You ever wonder why Nuka-Cola is so obsessed with making perfectly ice-cold beverages?
It's because they're going to freeze the executives so they can survive stock drops. Believe you me, they'll outlast us all.
Those Mirelurks you see running around? Paid actors. You see, it's propagated carcinization!
lines.note: Context: Mirelurks are giant crabs. Pronounced car-sin-i-zation

lines.text: The Government is keen to get people to evolve and crabs are the logical next step, so they have them walking around to inspire people to just evolve!
Did you know our brains have electricity? Y-you know what else does? Electronics.
That means everything you plug in has a mind of its own. That's why I don't use much aside from a lamp to jot down late night realizations.
Still I make sure to keep a loaded gun just in case that lamp gets any funny ideas!
Do you know why the Government wants you to give birth at hospitals? Because that's where they inject you with mind control chips.
Start walking where they don't want you to go? Suddenly you don't feel like exploring. That's why I removed mine.
Laws exist just so you don't ruin the Government's plans. You want examples? Murder? You might kill a sleeper agent.
Stealing? The Government wanted that thing first. Removing Mattress tags? That's where they put the device that controls your dreams.
There's no other explanation.
lines.note: Said to cap off a conspiracy theory rant

lines.text: It's just common sense.
lines.note: Said to cap off a conspiracy theory rant

lines.text: Everyone knows that.
lines.note: Said to cap off a conspiracy theory rant

lines.text: Now you can understand why the Government doesn't want you to know that.
lines.note: Said to cap off a conspiracy theory rant

lines.text: Nothing more to it. It just works.
lines.note: Said to cap off a conspiracy theory rant

lines.text: Think about it.
lines.note: Said to cap off a conspiracy theory rant

lines.text: Look, if you don't know these basic facts I may have my work cut out for me.
Tell you what. Let me know when you're mentally and physically ready, and I'll give you some more of these hard truths.
lines.note: She's making a deal with the player

lines.text: They'll fundamentally change you and give you a better understanding of the world. Just don't go spreading the information around.

topics.prompt: Even if that made sense, why would the Government give that information to Nuka-Cola?

lines.text: Because! That's how they're funding the research to turn their drinks into high explosives!
If war breaks out, you pop one open and suddenly you can "zap your thirst" and the entire city block!
lines.note: the quotations are her referencing the soda's tagline.

topics.prompt: You are absolutely right.

lines.text: Thank you. Seriously, does no one think it's weird that there's suddenly so many fish? The Government is building up to something...

topics.prompt: Are you even listening to yourself? Fish are not cameras!

lines.text: You're right! They're so much more! Cameras with listening devices installed!
Why do you think they're called a "school of fish"? Because they're always learning.

topics.prompt: See you later Dottie.

lines.text: Maybe. Maybe not.
lines.note: Uncertain if they will.

lines.text: You're starting to sound just like the Government.
Not if I see you first.

topics.prompt: Tell me about yourself.

lines.text: I feel like you fundamentally misunderstand our position if you're asking that.
lines.note: Concerned that the player is asking about her when she likes to keep to herself.

topics.prompt: I wanted to get your thoughts on something.

lines.text: I'll try to illuminate you however I can.

topics.prompt: I'm ready to start "learning".

lines.text: Whoa there! I already told you one of the secrets of the universe. Let that information sink in before you overload your brain.
lines.note: Context: Player has the buff active and is asking for more

lines.text: Already? That's mighty suspicious. Sounds like something a Government doppelganger would do to get all of my information quickly.
lines.note: Context: player has asked for the buff again but it's in cooldown

lines.text: If you want to prove you're not, then you'll need to wait. We all know the Government can't wait for anything.
Is that so? Hmm, let me see if I have any simple facts I can teach you about... Oh here's one!
lines.note: Context: Player has asked for a buff and can get one

topics.prompt: You said something about "staying away from the water". What did you mean by that?

lines.text: Shush! I was trying to be subtle when I said that.
Can't let those ominous ocular obscura learn too much.

topics.prompt: Let's see what you have for sale.

lines.text: Government secrets, ancient knowledge, and... other stuff.
lines.note: Other stuff should feel tacked on.

lines.text: These items may look disconnected, but I assure you they're pieces of a larger puzzle.
Who can put a price on the truth? Well, I guess I did.
Government Secrets. Secrets the Government doesn't even know they know. But if we leave these here they're gonna know that I know.
If they know what I know, then they also know that I know what they know, you know?
No, that's just the name of my shop! DSSBNUD, or Dottie's Stock of Significantly Benign Non-Confidential and Unrestricted Documents!
lines.note: Pronounced Diss-Buh-Nud

lines.text: I was going to call it "Dottie's Collection Of Universal Truths That Set You Free From The Shackles Of Lies" but DCOUTTSYFFTSOL is awkward to say.
lines.note: Pronounced "Dee-Cout-sift-soul

lines.text: My shop sells a variety of classified documents, items to reduce the amount of Government eyes watching, and... stuff that may be important later.
lines.note: Pause at the ellipses. Make the last part sound tacked on.

lines.text: Oh... I thought you had a base level of understanding... Okay. Let me try to get you up to speed. *Inhale*
lines.note: Surprised but trying to compose themselves.

lines.text: The fish are here to spy on us. You ever think about why they're spying on us with fish? Fish, live in water! People need water! Think about it.
lines.note: Really emphasize " Think about it

lines.text: Every time you drink water a fish takes a picture. That picture goes straight to Mr. Bradberton to let them know that's one less Nuka-Cola sale!
lines.note: Pronounced Brad-Bur-ton

lines.text: People here are really uneducated. You see, as you age your body goes through something known as puberty.
lines.note: Emphasis on "really" Context: she's confusing the effects of radiation with puberty.

lines.text: I don't remember the specifics but it involves your hair growing and/or falling out. It'll happen to you someday, don't worry.
lines.note: Trying to be supportive.

lines.text: Oh come on, don't be coy. You know what happened. You get to a certain age and then puberty happens.
lines.note: Context: she's confusing the effects of radiation with puberty.

lines.text: Hair stops growing, your baby nose falls out so the adult one can grow in. Still waiting on that last one.
Don't worry, it's completely natural, and it happens to everyone at some point. Some later than others.
In fact, it happened to my parents around the same time as me. Weird coincidence huh?
lines.note: Oblivious to how weird her logic is

lines.text: Sometime I trip on something and when I look, there's nothing there. What is the Government hoping to achieve with that?
I know you're listening.
Note to self: investigate further connections between trench coats and what mysterious power they may hold.
They didn't mean anything by it. How could they? I mean, it was the chemicals... Right?
lines.note: Context: Talking to herself, trying to explain why the player flirted with her.

lines.text: Keep your eyes peeled for Government trucks. They're starting to restock the fish.
Remember, tinfoil can only block some radio waves. To be truly safe, you need to stop thinking.
lines.condition: GetEquipped: ATX_Clothes_TinfoilSuit "Conspiracy Oufit", GetEquipped: ATX_Armor_Casual_Underarmor_TinfoilSuit "Conspiracy Suit Underarmor", GetEquipped: ATX_Headwear_TinfoilSuit "Conspiracy Hat", GetEquipped: Headwear_TinFoilHat "Tin Foil Hat", GetValue: Dottie_CompletedIntroduction
lines.note: Context: Player is wearing a tinfoil hat

lines.text: The Government wanted to see if they could remove a color without anyone noticing. That's why you don't see purple anymore.
Beep. Boop. Beep. Wait, you're not a robot. I'm not either.
lines.note: Context: Player is wearing power armor. She thinks they're a robot and tries to blend in

lines.text: They may look like stars, but I can assure you they're all satellite dishes. And they're all watching.
lines.note: Said at Night

lines.text: I've heard some people say that the missions to the Moon were faked. They're missing the big picture. The Moon itself is fake.
lines.note: Starts dismissive, ends confidently.

lines.text: I saw this crazy person yelling about impending doom. Pfft, what an idiot. Doesn't he know we've moved onto imminent doom?
lines.note: Like it's obvious.

lines.text: You've got a lot to learn, we should get started on your next lesson.
lines.note: Context: her buff is available

lines.text: I'm always happy to teach. Unless you're a spy. Or a robot. Or a figment of my imagination.
lines.note: Starts happy, gets more concerned with each sentence.

lines.text: Did you find the thing under the lake?
lines.note: A bit nervous. A bit curious.

lines.text: If your life flashes before you die, how do I know this isn't just my brain's final gasp for air?
I wonder why the sun keeps getting closer.
Keep your eyes open when exploring. If you ever see toilet paper backwards, that means it is close.
lines.note: Emphasis on "it

lines.text: Oh I see. Not wearing clothes to make sure you're not wearing a wire. Smart.
lines.condition: WornHasKeyword: isPowerArmorFrame, WornHasKeyword: ObjectTypeUnderarmor, WornHasKeyword: ObjectTypeClothing, GetValue: Dottie_CompletedIntroduction
lines.note: Context: player is walking around naked.

lines.text: Despite common beliefs, Government cameras will still film you while naked. So maybe you should put something on.
lines.condition: WornHasKeyword: isPowerArmorFrame, WornHasKeyword: ObjectTypeUnderarmor, WornHasKeyword: ObjectTypeClothing, GetValue: Dottie_CompletedIntroduction
lines.note: Context: Player is naked. Second line should be said a bit jokingly

lines.text: You ever wake up and think "Today is the day it reveals itself"? Well that's how I felt this morning.
lines.note: Confident. Emphasize "IT

lines.text: Good choice in apparel. Never let them guess your next move.
lines.note: Context: Player is wearing a costume.

lines.text: I see you shop for clothes from a trustworthy source.
lines.condition: GetEquipped: SCORE_S21_Clothes_ARMO_Outfit_DSSBNUD_T-shirtJeans "DSSBNUD T-shirt & Jeans Outfit", GetValue: Dottie_CompletedIntroduction
lines.note: Context: Player is wearing clothes with her shop's logo on it.

lines.text: Looks like you're armed and ready to take on those fishy... fish.
lines.condition: GetEquipped: DLC03_HarpoonGun "Harpoon Gun", GetEquipped: DLC03_PoleHook "Pole Hook", GetValue: Dottie_CompletedIntroduction
lines.note: Pause as if she's realizing she can't think of a different word for fish. Context: player is holding a fishing related weapon.

lines.text: Hey! Don't take pictures! These secrets are secret for a reason.
lines.condition: GetEquipped: Camera_SnapMatic "ProSnap Deluxe Camera", GetValue: Dottie_CompletedIntroduction
lines.note: Context: Player is holding a Camera

lines.text: Nice try Government agent, but I'm not talking to you.
lines.note: Context: Non-owning Player tries talking to them.

lines.text: I don't know you. You don't know me. Let's keep it that way.
lines.note: Context: Non Owning Player tries to talk to them

lines.text: Impressive. If I didn't know better I would have thought you were actually alive.
lines.note: Context: Non-Owning Player tries to talk to her

lines.text: We're getting distracted. Look, I'm going to set up shop here, literally in this case. But as payment, I'll make sure you learn a thing or two.
I'm going to unpack and get ready, so let me know when you're ready to unpack the truth.
Just... Stay away from the water in the meantime.
lines.note: Said like a word of warning.

topics.prompt: I'm actually part of the Enclave, which runs the government.

lines.text: You believe in the Enclave? Don't you see? They're a distraction! You find them and then you don't dig deeper into the REAL secret government.

topics.prompt: What the hell are you talking about?

lines.text: Shush, it's okay. It may not make sense now; it might not make sense later. But I promise, I'll keep talking until something makes sense.
lines.note: Almost condescending

topics.prompt: I am concerned about you.

lines.text: Is it concerning to have a belief? Hmm? Is it concerning to follow that belief?
Is it concerning to shave my fingerprints so I'm harder to track while chasing that belief? Exactly!
lines.note: Take a beat before "exactly". Said like she explained something really basic.

lines.text: My name is Dottie. Or Dot. Or "dash, dot, dot, wait; dash, dash, dash, wait; dash.
lines.note: Pause for a second after saying each "wait".

lines.text: If you hear anyone calling me Dorothy, they're a spy. That's my legal name, and the only people who know that are the Government. And now you.
But I'm not worried about you, you're not the Government. Huh, I've watched you for days and you've never once unhinged your jaw to moisten your eyeballs.
lines.note: She thinks Government people are Lizard people.

topics.prompt: Everything you say is more confusing than the last.

lines.text: Gotta be on the ball or they're gonna knock you off. Let's take a step back for a second.

topics.prompt: I know.

lines.text: Hmm. You're quick on the uptake. Good. Maybe I can teach you.
Where'd you find those boxes?

topics.prompt: Just found them. Why do you want to know?

lines.text: Firstly they're mine, but that's not even important right now.

topics.prompt: What's it to you?

lines.text: What's it to me? They're mine! But you're missing the big picture.

topics.prompt: [Lie] I don't have any boxes.

lines.text: Hahaha! Good answer! I like the initiative. Except they're my boxes, and I don't know if you understand their importance.
lines.note: Happy that the player knows enough to lie about it when asked.

lines.text: Those boxes are full of binders! Those binders are full of folders! Those folders? Full of papers. Those papers are filled with words!
Words that when put together unlock secrets, and here you are, flaunting the new library of Alexandria for the Government to know!

items.description: Welcome this sweet old lady to your C.A.M.P.!
items.howToObtain: Claim from the Fight for Freedom Scoreboard (Season 14)

lines: Claim from the Fight for Freedom Scoreboard (Season 14)

lines.text: Anata... Doesn't this remind you of our wedding day? Everyone celebrating while stuck under a couple of umbrellas.
lines.note: A-na-ta. Imagining talking to her husband, reminiscing about their wedding on a rainy day.

lines.text: Oi-dai, oi-dai. Aw, where did that little kitty go?
lines.note: Pronounced "Oi-Day". First part is said like trying to get the attention of a cat.

lines.text: Oh... my knees.
lines.note: Her knees are sore from old age.

lines.text: Kazuichi? Is that you dear? Oh... No... Of course not.
lines.note: Ka-Zu-EE-Chi. She thinks she sees her husband before sadly realizing it's not

lines.text: When will you come back to me? I don't want to be alone.
lines.note: Player asked about her painful past.

lines.text: I know he'll be here soon... I know it...
lines.note: Talking about her husband. Trying to reassure herself.

lines.text: Something must be wrong with the taps. I swear my clothes are dirtier after I washed them.
Maybe it's time we look into signing up for one of those Vault-things. Are they still doing those?
I wanted to peel some oranges for a healthy snack, but I'm having the darndest time finding any.
lines.note: Surprised Oranges are difficult to find

lines.text: Contrary to what she says, that new newscaster loves to talk about herself.
lines.note: Context: A character on the radio keeps talking about herself even after she says "I don't mean to talk about myself

lines.text: Watoga must really love their fireworks. I swear I see flashes of light over there all the time.
lines.note: Context: Near Watoga players regular launch nukes

lines.text: I swear... the bees are getting bigger every year.
<Quiet Sobbing>
lines.note: Remembered something really sad and can't repress it. Trying to not be too loud.

lines.text: Hello dearie!
Come here and tell Grandma Junko about your day.
You're nothing but skin and bones! Come here and let Grandma whip up a little something.
lines.note: Player can use the character's cooking buff.

lines.text: There you are! I just finished preparing a little dish. Eat. I don't want you being peckish later.
lines.note: Player can use the character's cooking buff.

lines.text: Are you trying to make Obaachan sad? Eat something!
lines.note: Pronounced O-Bah-Chan. Player can use the character's cooking buff and they're starving

lines.text: You've already eaten, but I'm sure you can make room for Obaachan's cooking.
lines.note: Pronounced O-Bah-Chan. Player can use the character's cooking buff but they are well fed

lines.text: I heard your stomach before I could see you. Eat something, you're still growing.
lines.note: Player can use the character's cooking buff.

lines.text: You're up early.
lines.note: Player is awake early

lines.text: Morning sweetie.
lines.note: Player is awake early

lines.text: I would have peeled you an orange to eat if I knew you'd be up this early.
Looks like someone is about to go on an adventure. You go have fun, but be back before dark.
lines.note: Second line said like a parent looking out for a child.

lines.text: Put on a scarf! It's going to be cold tonight.
lines.note: Grandmotherly concern

lines.text: Perfect weather for some tea.
lines.note: Weather is rainy.

lines.text: Are we playing make-believe today?
lines.note: Player is wearing a costume

lines.text: Aw, did someone dress themselves today? Remind me to have a talk with your mother about your wardrobe.
lines.note: Player is wearing a costume.

lines.text: Welcome back.
There you are! Come talk to Obaachan for a bit.
lines.note: Pronounced O-Bah-Chan

lines.text: You look like you're having fun.
Oh my dear sweet baby. Someone's got a fever. Drink some soup and get plenty of rest. Grandma's orders.
lines.note: Player is diseased.

lines.text: Oh my word.
Welcome back sweetie. I hope your day is as special as you are.
Always happy to talk to you.
Oh my! Please make yourself decent, for Grandma's sake.
lines.condition: WornHasKeyword: isPowerArmorFrame, WornHasKeyword: ObjectTypeUnderarmor, WornHasKeyword: ObjectTypeClothing
lines.note: Player is not wearing clothes.

lines.text: You must be in quite a rush if you're forgetting your clothes.
lines.condition: WornHasKeyword: isPowerArmorFrame, WornHasKeyword: ObjectTypeUnderarmor, WornHasKeyword: ObjectTypeClothing

lines.text: What's on your mind dearie?
Oh dearie... did you scrape your knee? Let me see if I can find a bandage for you.
lines.note: Player is highly damaged

lines.text: Tsk tsk tsk, did someone get in a fight with the neighbor again?
lines.note: Player is visibly damaged

lines.text: I always knew you were a bright youngster, but it almost seems like you're glowing!
lines.note: Player is highly irradiated

lines.text: Everything is high-tech these days. When I was your age, that robot costume you stepped into would have been made out of cardboard and bits of string.
lines.note: Player is wearing power armor

lines.text: I know you like your soda pop, but be careful not to rot your teeth out.
lines.note: Player has consumed a lot of soda

lines.text: I'm afraid I'm not ready to talk yet.
lines.note: Character just talked about a sensitive subject.

lines.text: I still need some time to... think about things.
lines.note: Character just talked about a sensitive subject.

lines.text: Please give me just a little bit more time.
lines.note: Character just talked about a sensitive subject.

lines.text: Well, would you look who it is.
lines.note: Player was Rude to the character and she's waiting for an apology

lines.text: Aw, thank you dearie.
Oh! So the cure is in Nuka-Cola? I'll get right on that sweetie.
lines.note: Playfully agreeing like being told a story by a child. Semi-sarcastically says the second line.

lines.text: Just don't drink too much medicine, you'll rot your teeth out.
I'd appreciate that. Yes, let's do that.
It's okay dearie. Let's pretend this never happened.
lines.note: Relieved to not be talking about this anymore.

lines.text: Why do you think I didn't want to talk about it?
lines.note: Cannot believe the player forced her to talk about it and then has the nerve to apologize. Annoyed Disbelief

lines.text: I need some time to think. To package that back up.
lines.note: Trying to handle her emotions.

lines.text: Please give me some space.
Oh my, where are my manners? My name is Junko, but please feel free to call me Grandma. Or Nana, or Bubba, or anything you want sweetie.
lines.note: Pronounced: June-Ko, na-na, bub-ah

lines.text: My grandchildren have given me many nicknames over the years.

topics.prompt: Why should I let you stay?

lines.text: You mean aside from being courteous?
lines.note: A bit surprised that the player isn't being nicer.

lines.text: Well, I am pretty handy in the kitchen, so I'm sure I can whip you up something if your tummy gets rumble-y.

topics.prompt: Stay as long as you need.

lines.text: Oh bless you. And don't you worry, I'll be sure to pull my weight while I'm here.
I don't mean to brag, but I do know my way around the kitchen, so I'm sure I can whip you up something if your tummy gets rumble-y.

topics.prompt: I know a fool's errand when I see one.

lines.text: Oh, there's no need to call yourself a fool, or to run an errand.
lines.note: Unintentionally being sassy

lines.text: And I don't need your help, dearie. Just a place to rest for a moment.

topics.prompt: Do you need something?

lines.text: Just a comfortable seat to rest these weary bones, and some time to get my bearings.

topics.prompt: Can I help you look for them?

lines.text: Oh, I appreciate the sentiment, but they know better than to talk to strangers.
All I need right now is some time to readjust to the surroundings.
You see, my dear, sweet grandchildren live in Appalachia.
My daughter, their mother, has never been good at updating little ol' me, but even so it feels like an age since she called.

topics.prompt: This isn't the seniors' home. Get lost, granny.

lines.text: Sorry dearie, my hearing isn't what it used to be. Did you ask if I'm lost? I certainly seem to be.

topics.prompt: What are you doing here?

lines.text: I was trying to find someone but it seems now I'm the one that's lost.

topics.prompt: Excuse me, are you okay?

lines.text: I'm afraid not. I thought I knew my way, but I seem to have gotten all turned around.
Appalachia seems to change every time I visit.
It seems my map is already out of date.

topics.prompt: [Let her continue]

lines.text: They kept getting delayed. Traffic or something. Where were they? I-I didn't know, but I did know to always had a meal ready.
Kazu-kun said something about "limited supplies", but I needed to be ready for my babies.
lines.note: Trying to explain her point of view.

lines.text: He left at one point to restock. He got food, but came back... different. Sick. Tired.
lines.note: Take a beat or moment before saying "Different" "Sick", and "tired".

lines.text: I tried to help, but I swear he's such a sleepyhead. I couldn't get him to stay awake. <Cries>
lines.note: Trying to play it off as him being sleepy, but she's destroyed. Emotional.

lines.text: I left a note saying I went to find our family. He'll come find me when he wakes up. I know it...
lines.note: Sad, emotional but trying to be confident.

lines.text: Yes. When he wakes up. I know Kazu-kun will find me.
lines.note: Emphasis on "When".

topics.prompt: I get the idea. You don't need to keep going.

lines.text: Oh good. <Sighs> Grandma needs to uh- to pack that back up.
lines.note: Trying to get a handle on her emotions again.

lines.text: I need some time by myself. To think about things.

topics.prompt: [Insist] I don't want secrets in my home.

lines.text: I... I didn't know what was happening. Kazu-kun told me it was time. We had to go.
lines.note: Emotional, she's opening up stuff she had locked away for a long time.

lines.text: He... he had a secret room prepared, and it was built under our house. He knew something big was coming. Probably heard something through work.
But the kids knew we had that room! They... they knew to come if ANYTHING happened!
lines.note: A bit hysterical.

lines.text: So we waited as long as we could, and they... didn't come. But they knew to come! We were waiting.
lines.note: Trying to reassure herself.

lines.text: The kids were going to come soon. I knew it! And they would be so hungry. So I- I uh... I made food for them.
lines.note: Emphasis on "I knew it

topics.prompt: [Strength 8+] Tell me or else!

lines.text: Please... Don't make me remember.
lines.note: Quietly pleading the player to stop.

lines.text: Don't make me go back!

topics.prompt: [Intelligence 8+] Sounds like radiation poisoning.

lines.text: I... it's uh... not that.
lines.note: Her lie is falling apart and she's getting closer to facing something she doesn't want to.

topics.prompt: I insist.

lines.text: Fine. If you must know, he's been a bit nauseous, and he's self-conscious about rapidly losing hair.

topics.prompt: That's terrible. What seems to be the issue?

lines.text: I'd really prefer to not discuss this. Medical issues are personal.

topics.prompt: But you said he was retired.

lines.text: Oh, silly me. I meant to say he hasn't been feeling well. It's a quick trip so I decided to pop over by myself.
lines.note: Trying to hide something. This is something she's not comfortable talking about.

topics.prompt: [Perception 8+] Why isn't your husband traveling with you?

lines.text: Oh... Uh, he's been incredibly busy with work, and he wants to save his few vacation days for when we're all together.
lines.note: Hiding something.

topics.prompt: You must miss them.

lines.text: Of course I do. But soon I'll find Sayoko and we can all go home together.
Don't fret, I'll still write. I hope you like New Year cards!
Just a simple spread. Onigiri, yakizakana, ohitashi, and an extra large serving of miso soup to wash it down.
lines.note: Pronounced "O-nee-gee-ree" "Ya-kee-za-ka-na" "O-hee-ta-she" "mee-sew

lines.text: Eh, had to make a couple of substitutions for ingredients I couldn't find, but it's all Obaachan approved.
I wasn't sure what you were in the mood for, so I made katsudon, gyuudon, oyakodon, and some hiyayakko.
lines.note: Pronounced "kat-su-don" "Gyu-don" "O-ya-ko-don" "Hee-ya-ya-ko

lines.text: Oh, you would not believe how difficult it was to get some of these ingredients, so eat up!
lines.note: Surprised by the difficulty by which it took to get the ingredients

lines.text: In case you want something sweet, Grandma has prepared some cake, a cobbler, cookies, and an apple pie!
At least I think those were apples. Hahaha.
lines.note: Quietly, almost to herself.

lines.text: Ah, got some nikujaga, karaage, and various pieces of tempura, all homemade and filled with love!
lines.note: Pronounced "nee-ku-ja-ga" "ka-ra-gei" "tem-pu-ra

lines.text: I had to improvise a bit, but it's still tasty, don't you worry.

topics.prompt: That's all I wanted.

lines.text: Oh. Was there anything else?

topics.prompt: Could you cook something for me?

lines.text: I knew I should have made a bigger batch, you're still growing after all.
lines.condition: HasMagicEffect: Junko_Cooking_FoodDrinkEffect "Fills Hunger and Thrist Meter", IsDailyCooldownExpired: LiteAlly_Junko_Cooldown
lines.note: Context: Player is currently buffed

lines.text: Obaachan's going to make it up to you tomorrow, okay sweetie?
lines.condition: HasMagicEffect: Junko_Cooking_FoodDrinkEffect "Fills Hunger and Thrist Meter", IsDailyCooldownExpired: LiteAlly_Junko_Cooldown

lines.text: You're going to eat me out of house and home.
lines.note: Context: Player has already been buffed, and the buff is in cooldown. Said playfully

lines.text: Tell you what, let Grandma grab some groceries, and I'll get you a nice big meal tomorrow.
Ha, I had a feeling you were going to ask so I prepared you a little something. Nothing too crazy.
lines.note: Emphasis on "too

topics.prompt: Let's see what you've got for sale.

lines.text: I hope you like knick-knacks and trinkets.
Oh, do you want to show me your bottle cap collection? Of course Sweetie.
Hmm, if you're too impatient to wait for your birthday, then I guess I can make an exception.

topics.prompt: I went to Flatwoods and learned how to cook.

lines.text: Is that what you call it? I'm so proud of you for trying.
lines.note: Emphasis on "that". Doesn't want to seem rude but is looking down on the player a bit.

lines.text: Let me see if I can't find some recipes for you to create something with... more flavor.
lines.note: Concerned in a caring manner

topics.prompt: Talk to you later.

lines.text: Don't talk to strangers!
Make sure you finish up your chores BEFORE you go off gallivanting with your friends.
lines.note: Pronounced "Ga-le-van-ting

lines.text: I want you home when the street lights turn on.
lines.note: Said in the morning.

lines.text: You should sleep soon. It's getting late and you need a full eight hours.

topics.prompt: I have stories from the Wasteland.

lines.text: Oh! Exciting! Please tell grandma all about your little "adventures".
lines.condition: GetNumTimesCompletedQuest: RSVP02_Quest "Second Helpings", GetNumTimesCompletedQuest: W05_MQ_101P "The New Arrivals", GetNumTimesCompletedQuest: MoM04 "The Mistress of Mystery", GetNumTimesCompletedQuest: W05_MQ_102P "Overseer, Overseen", GetNumTimesCompletedQuest: CB04_Mayor "Mayor for a Day", GetNumTimesCompletedQuest: BoS02 "Recruitment Blues"
lines.note: Excited like a grandmother being told a story by their grandchild.

topics.prompt: Tell me more about yourself.

lines.text: What would you like to know, dearie?

topics.prompt: I'm in need of your services.

lines.text: Of course dearie, what can Obaachan do for you?

topics.prompt: I'm in need of your services.

lines.text: Of course dearie. I didn't want to say anything that may affect your self esteem, but you're too skinny.
Come here and let Grandma Junko fill your heart and your stomach with some food made fresh with an extra serving of love.

topics.prompt: I want to go back to my earlier questions.

lines.text: Enough with memory lane for now.

topics.prompt: Tell me about your family.

lines.text: I have a beautiful family and I have told you about them in-depth last time.
We're done with that topic.

topics.prompt: Tell me about your family.

lines.text: Oh, my favorite subject!
Well there's Kazuichi, my darling husband. Quiet, but caring. He's just recently retired you know.
lines.note: Pronounced "Ka-zu-E-chi

lines.text: There's Sayoko, my brilliant and beautiful daughter. She lives in this neck of the woods with her husband, Manabu.
lines.note: Pronounced "Sa-yo-ko

lines.text: And of course I have 3 grandchildren. Asa-chan, Kei-kun, and Mako-chan. Ah, it's been too long since I've seen them.
lines.note: Grateful, but longing to see them. Pronounced "A-sa" "Kay" (as in the letter), and "Ma-ko

topics.prompt: Where are you from?

lines.text: A little bit of everywhere. My family comes from a small city known as Inzai over in Japan.
lines.note: Pronounced In-za-e

lines.text: We moved here when I was young, and I grew up mainly in small towns over on the west coast.
Once I got married, we moved around to various cities for my husband's work.
It was difficult leaving my friends, but we were together, and we were able to travel all over this beautiful country.

topics.prompt: Junk-o is a very unique name.

lines.text: It's pronounced "June-Ko". It means "pure child".
My father wasn't a very sentimental man, but he apparently picked that name the moment he first saw me.
lines.note: Reminiscing on her family.

lines.text: I don't have much to remember him by, but thinking of that makes me smile.

topics.prompt: What was your life like before the war?

lines.text: War? Wait, which war? How old do you think I am?
lines.note: Context, the last war she can think of was a very long time ago

topics.prompt: How are you still alive?

lines.text: What a rude question! If you must know, it's a combination of yoga, and eating well.
lines.note: Starts insulted, second sentence said very matter-of-fact

lines.text: Also a piece of chocolate to keep me feeling young.

topics.prompt: Have you met anyone interesting recently?

lines.text: Interesting is one way to put it. Who wears tires for fashion?
lines.note: Like some grandmotherly gossip

lines.text: And what are those green crystals people glue to themselves? Do they not see how irritated it is making their skin?
Oh my, I'm rambling. I meant, did you have anyone in particular?

topics.prompt: I helped create a cure for the Scorched Plague.

lines.text: Oh of course you did. I'm so proud of you. And where is this cure?
lines.note: Said like talking to a child. Not fully believing them

topics.prompt: I joined the Order of Mysteries and became trained in different types of combat.

lines.text: Oh is this one of those... Nandakke... Oh, one of those comic book things?
lines.note: Says "Nandakke" as she struggles to remember. Pause for a moment. Pronounced "Nan-Da-kay

lines.text: Just be careful with your playfighting. There's a reason my uncle walked with a limp.
lines.note: Said as a word of warning.

topics.prompt: I graduated VTU and became an Overseer.

lines.text: What? No! And you didn't invite me to the graduation? Tsk, tsk, I could have used a full page in the scrapbook.
Oh, you grow up so fast.

topics.prompt: I became mayor of a town of robots.

lines.text: You have such a vivid imagination. Don't let anyone take that from you.
lines.note: Said with love, but like she's talking to an overactive kid.

topics.prompt: I went to the Charleston Capitol building and fought through hoards of mindless creatures attacking me.

lines.text: Oh that's an adventure Obaachan has gone through more than once.
lines.note: Pronounced "Oh-bah-chan". Said as though she has been through this herself.

lines.text: Had to fight someone off with my cane last time. I've never seen someone so keen to steal a spot in line.
lines.note: In Disbelief at how disrespectful people could be.

topics.prompt: I want to go back to my earlier questions.
