Maybe just the obvious: a "run-they're-aggressive-and-going-to-shred-us" of Anglers would suffice.
Radio chatter indicated that a bunch of Anglers were spotted shredding some wildlife near this location recently.
Heard some radio chatter that Assaultrons are circling this location heavily. Unclear why, but they are definitely not there to welcome you.
Heard from a hunter buddy of mine that a bunch of Assaultrons were at this location just attacking anything that came in range.
Not sure why exactly, but there seem to be reports of Assaultrons gathering at this exact spot.
Heard from old Jimbo that there are a ton of bloatflies in this place. Could be worse. Could be better.
There used to be a nest of bloatflies here a while ago, but I bet you they've all hatched by now. They're probably starving, too.
Bloatflies. You know I hate 'em. But right now they're your problem my friend, because they're all over the place that you need to be.
I heard from a couple traders that this place is packed with bloodbugs. Probably a nest. Get there before more eggs hatch.
Heard from a few separate sources that this place is packed with bloodbugs.
Sounds like a bunch of bloodbugs recently hatched here. They're probably starved from feeding on each other by now.
Sounds like this is a Blood Eagle meeting of some kind. Expect trouble.
I heard there are a ton of Blood Eagles there, so... be on your toes.
I got confirmation that there's some sort of Blood Eagle shindig happening there. Be on your guard.
Ever see a nest of Cave Crickets? Their long stick-like legs just skittering around, tangled with each other in a writhing pile of crusty noodles...
If not, well, you're in for a treat! This place is currently bursting at the seams with them.
You should know that this place is packed with cave crickets. I wonder if there's one giant one in the middle, or just layers of regular ones.
I heard a while ago that this place had tons of mature cave cricket eggs. You know what that means: crunchy adult cave crickets will be there by now.
Could hear the deathclaws in this place from far away. Hard to say exactly how many, but be prepared for a nest.
Couple hunters got chased down by a pack of Deathclaws from this place. They barely made it out.
Radio chatter is convinced that this place is currently the beginning of a major Deathclaw nest. It's dangerous now, but could be a plague later.
Couple folks let me know that a bunch of eyebots are currently patrolling this place. Probably some old data. But they seem to be protective of it.
My friend Jimbo said that he saw some eyebots heading up to this place just recently. He said sometimes they do that, probably some old programming.
There was a strange radio message up there recently. Just a string of numbers. When I analyzed it a bit, seemed like coordinates to this place...
And the coordinates were intended for eyebots in particular. Not sure who sent it or when. Could be ancient orders for all I know.
I heard from some traders passing by that this place is absolutely teeming with feral ghouls.
Radio chatter indicated that this place is packed with ferals right about now.
Feral ghouls have been gathering at this place for a bit, it sounds like. You gotta wonder what they think about sometimes, or if they think at all.
I heard from some traders passing by that this place is absolutely teeming with Floaters. Freaks me out just thinking about it.
Heard there were a bunch of Floaters here. Doing what? I dunno. Do they... have a society? Is that real? Man these things weird me out.
This place is packed with Floaters. You know I hate 'em. So... watch out.
Heard that some fog crawlers started showing up there just a bit ago, then more arrived, and more, and more. Now it's packed.
This place is basically a fog crawler festival right now. Who knows why, really. You know how these things are, though: fast and brutal.
In a separate report, I heard this place was filled with fog crawlers recently.
Sounds like something in this place has attracted the attention of the Grafton Monster itself. Kind of exciting, right?
The message I saw said the place was occupied by the Grafton Monster.
Sometimes the Grafton Monster seems to get attached to particular locations. Sounds like this place is the winner for today.
Heard from a buddy that this place is currently host to a nest of gulpers.
Ever wonder what dozens of gulpers sound like at once? You just might get your chance. This place is apparently infested.
Heard this place is packed with gulpers. Never heard of those things before I got here. Kinda trying to pretend like they don't exist, to be honest.
Just so you know, there's definitely some Honey Beasts here. Heard you can taste the honey in the air from far away.
I heard that this place might be some sort of breeding or feeding ground for Honey Beasts, could be rough. Use caution.
This place seems to be often occupied by Honey Beasts pretty often, so I'd honestly expect to see them around when you get there.
By the way... this place is teeming with giant insects. Just swarms of them.
One can only hope they aren't developing language and worshipping a giant insect god, set to destroy us all someday.
Oh, one more thing - it's just full of giant insects. Heard the place was buzzing with the sound of dozens of skittering legs and crackly wings.
Just be aware that this place tends to attract giant insects of all kinds, so I'd expect to see them there.
Heard this place is attractingLiberators. I wonder why? Probably just a glitch in their data. Just don't let them swarm you.
You can hear the Liberators from a fair bit away. It's probably packed with them.
I've heard a few reports that the place is full of Liberators. Just be prepared for them and you'll be fine.
lines.note: warning player about enemies at mission location (you assume the player can handle themselves, but you want them prepared)

lines.text: A hunter buddy of mine tracked a Mega Sloth to this place. Granted, it's not particularly hard to track them on account of their speed, but still.
This place definitely has at least one Mega Sloth. Could be more. They're such majestic creatures, if you consider filth to be majesty -- and I do.
I heard on the radio chatter that there's at least one Mega Sloth there, so be warned. Though I think you'll see it before it sees you.
Heard from someone earlier that this place stinks like fish butt. That means only one thing: Mirelurks. Well, or fish butts. Two things, I guess.
This place tends to get stopped up with Mirelurks a lot. I bet it's some sort of breeding ground for them. Just be on the lookout.
I know for a fact that this place is crawling with Mirelurks. I know at least three traders who went there for meat and ended up getting swarmed.
I heard from a trader that this place is currently occupied by some Mole Miners. Be prepared.
I heard from Grahm that this place has a bunch of Mole Miners occupying it. He said they're more rowdy than usual, so take heed.
This place has mole miners more often than not, really. Part of me wonders why they protect it so much. Does it have meaning to them?
But, anyway... best not to worry about any potential for higher thought or signs of cultural complexity, just blast them away. Safety first, kid!
Heads up. This place stinks of molerats even from far off. Peat, rotten eggs, cilantro. People have been complaining on radio chatter for a while.
Every once in a while a small colony of molerats seems to take up residence here. I would bet they're back there again.
There are a couple places where molerats really like to infest, and this is one of them. I'd expect to see them here if I were you.
There's a ton of Mothman Cultists there, and I don't know why. No doubt some... you know. Cult business.
Some folks heard strange chanting coming from this place, so... I'd guess Mothman Cultists.
Heard from a few sources that a bunch of Mothman Cultists showed up there recently. I wonder if they have... holidays? Festivals? Huh.
What do you get when a bunch of Mr. Gutsies get together in one place? Your future. Good luck, kid!
Keep in mind, a lot of Mr. Gutsies have been seen in this area as recently as today. It's hard to predict when they'll split, so be ready for them.
Some Mr. Gutsies have decided that this place is worth defending. Could be corrupt data. Hard to say, but be on guard. They're not playing around.
Heard this place was full of mutations of all kinds. I dunno, might be rough. But maybe you can handle it.
My old friend Jimbo said this place was packed with various kinds of mutations. I dunno, someitmes he's full of it, but I believe him in this case.
Caution is in order. Mutations have taken up residence there.
lines.note: warning player about enemies at mission location (you assume the player can handle themselves, but you want them prepared)

lines.text: Have you ever wanted to see a place packed full of assorted mutations? Well, here's your chance. Good luck.
Heard from a buddy that this place is occupied by protectrons. Could hear them beeping and whirring from pretty far off, so there's a lot.
Couple of folks reported seeing tracks for a bunch of protectrons around this place. No scat though, turns out protectrons don't do that.
Sometimes protectrons get stuck around this place. Not sure why. Old algorithms, probably. Wouldn't be surprised if they were there again.
Heard a trader say he lost a pack animal in this place to some Rad Ants. Got absolutely swarmed and took down the beast. Be warned.
Just so you know, this place is teeming with ants. Big ones. Apparently their eggs started hatching recently and they're all starving.
I hate ants. Big ones, little ones, all of them. Well, lucky for me, I don't have to go to this place with you since it's teeming with them. Enjoy.
This place is utterly infested with rats, last I heard.
Spoke with a trader recently who specializes in dried rat meats, said he came up to this place and filled up in less than a minute. Totally overrun.
I heard there were tons of rat nests in the area, so it's probably breeding season or something. Be warned. It's probably infested.
You think radroaches are bad normally, right? Well this place is a radroach hotel. They're just breeding here until the place is overrun. Be warned.
This place is utterly infested with radroaches. Be warned.
I heard from a buddy that she didn't even need to get close to hear the skittering legs of radroaches there. The place is probably infested.
We aren't sure why, but there have been some scorpions spotted around this place in particular. Watch out.
A buddy of mine was walking by this place and heard some scorpion sounds. You know, clamping claws, skittering feet. Be warned. Could be a lot.
I've heard that some folks ran into some scorpions around this area before, so be on the lookout.
Heard radio chatter about a bunch of marauders in that area, so keep an eye out. They always expect a fight.
Heard a lot of reports that a bunch of rowdy marauders have taken up residence there. So be prepared for a fight.
I heard a marauder say on the open airwaves that his crew is holed up in this location, so there's no surprise for you. Expect them.
I heard this place is hopping with huge toads. Get it?! Hopping! Okay, scram kid.
Someone found a bunch of giant toad eggs around here a while back, I imagine they'd be full grown by now.
Sometimes giant toads swing by this place to spawn, I've heard. So keep an eye out.
Seems like a Robobrain has decided to patrol this exact spot. Be warned, it probably brought others with it.
Expect to encounter some Robobrains here. Got a report from a scout that their tracks were found in that area recently.
Last time I heard, there were some Robobrains in this area. They scared off the last group of folks who passed by pretty quickly.
Trader saw a conga line of robots heading towards this place. Not sure what their intention is, but I'd assume they're hostile.
Couple buddies of mine went in there lately thinking it was just abandoned, but nope. Robots. Loads of them.
Heard some robots were occupying this place for some reason. Always hard to know why robots do the things they do, but be warned.
Got a tip that some military robots are currently occupying this particular place, so be warned.
Military buddy of mine said he was followed by a bunch of military robots shouting orders at him.
He lost them in this place, but I bet you they're still there, waiting.
Heard on the radio that a bunch of military robots were patrolling right around this area, so stay on guard.
I asked a buddy if she had noticed anything near this place lately, and she said it was just full of the usual Scorched. Good to know though.
Haven't heard anything unusual about this particular place, but I would expect it to be full of Scorched. Kinda normal for this area.
Safe to assume this place is full of Scorched. It often is.
Heard there were Sentry Bots roaming in this place. Not sure what their deal is, but be warned.
I heard someone say they passed some Sentry Bots heading towards this place. Who knows why, but they're probably still there.
Sentry Bots have been spotted in this area, though not sure what they're trying to do. Just be warned.
Heard a bunch of Settlers did something... odd... and now they're kinda messed up. Majorly messed up. Watch out.
Sounds like a bunch of Settlers were working each other up into a frenzy. I don't know why. Settler drama, probably... Watch out.
Radio chatter says there are people here who might be Settlers... but they are messed up. Watch out. Sounds really bizarre to me.
Want to see the Sheepsquatch? Word is, this place has one. Maybe more, but at least one.
One of my hunter buddies tracked a Sheepsquatch to this place, but the beast is holed up there pretty safely. So be warned.
Friend of mine said the place reeks of Sheepsquatch stink. Be warned.
Sounds like there's Snally Gasters there. Hate those things.
I've heard a lot of chatter lately about this. From the sounds of it, I'd guess Snally Gasters.
From what I can gather, place has Snally Gasters. Don't get swallowed up.
My buddy Jimbo said last time he was nearby, he saw some Stingwing nests around this place. So watch out.
A hunter I know was chased from this general area by a pack of Stingwings. So be on the lookout.
I've heard that some Stingwings have been nesting around in this area, so keep an eye out.
You'll probably smell them first, but keep an eye out for the Super Mutants anyway.
Last I heard, the place was being used by a group of Super Mutants. Probably still the case, so use caution.
Heard someone say they heard a bunch of Super Mutant chatter going on near this place, so take heed.
Heads up: a couple of traders warned me that this place was covered in swamp creatures.
Try to stay safe, but keep an eye out for swamp creatures. I heard the place was pretty much flooded with them.
Got a report that the place is full of swamp creatures, so stay alert.
Heard this place was full of bloated, giant ticks. Just a giant nest of them skittering around with their tiny sucker mouths.
Be warned... this place is probably still crawling with Ticks. Last I heard, it was infested.
How much do you like to pop Ticks? Well, if your answer is: "It's my favorite thing ever!" then you're going to love this place.
If I said this place was overrun with packs of dogs, do you imagine tiny fluffy yippy dogs? I do! Unfortunately, these are mean, disease-ridden ones.
Couple of buddies ran into a pack of vicious dogs around here a while back. Could still be there.
Heard some folks spotted vicious dogs in that area. So, not too worrisome but be on the lookout.
Heard there were potentially several Wendigo here. Not sure why. Maybe it's a weird family reunion? I don't even know if that's a thing.
Word is, there are multiple Wendigos there. Watch out. Seriously, though.
Picked up some chatter about multiple Wendigos spotted there. Be on the lookout. It sounds dangerous.
Couple hunters said they found an enormous amount of wolf scat around this place. The hunters moved on to easier grounds. Expect trouble.
One thing about this place - seems to be used frequently by packs of wolves that are rather protective of their territory.
Howls can be heard around this place -- sounds like wolves though, not anything too worrisome.
A hunter buddy of mine said he was chased away from this place by a pack of snarling yao guai. Said it was definitely too much for him to handle.
I've heard a lot of chatter lately about this place. Sounds like there are tons of grunts and strange noises coming from this place.
Probably just yao guai. But could be rutting yao guai. Brace yourself.
Ever wanted a giant hug from a hostile and entirely deadly teddy bear covered in blood and scabs? If so, then this is your place.
I don't know what's there, exactly. Could be pretty much anything. I asked everybody I know, and nothing. Not a peep.
I asked everybody. Even Jimbo and Grahm, and nobody has been here lately. All reports are old. I'd assume the worst.
Honestly, I don't know what's at this spot. So many conflicting reports. I have heard that it's overrun by... something though.

topics.prompt: Got it. I'm on my way.

lines.text: Yeah! I knew you'd be interested.
lines.note: pleased the player is doing your favor/quest

lines.text: Thanks for looking into this.
Great. I figured this was something you'd be interested in.
Thanks for looking into this.
Great. I figured this was something you'd be interested in.
Yeah! I knew you'd be interested.
Thanks for looking into this.
Great. I figured this was something you'd be interested in.
Yeah! I knew you'd be interested.
lines.note: pleased the player is doing your favor/quest

lines.text: Thanks for looking into this.
Great. I figured this was something you'd be interested in.
Yeah! I knew you'd be interested.
lines.note: pleased the player is doing your favor/quest

lines.text: Thanks for looking into this.
Great. I figured this was something you'd be interested in.

topics.prompt: Where am I headed?

lines.text: I think I can tell you how to get there... but otherwise, you're on your own.
lines.note: sincere, trying to be helpful, but you really don't know much

lines.text: Sometimes even I come up a little short. I can give you the coordinates, but that's about as helpful as I can be.
lines.note: sincere, trying to be helpful, but you really don't know much

lines.text: I asked on the Network and they said... it could be in this Cabin because a trader heard some weird noises there lately. Worth checking.
You've got to search this Cabin. For sure. Jimbo said he noticed something weird when he was there last. One of his chem stashes is... was... there.
lines.note: He believes Jimbo

lines.text: This Cabin. That's where you need to go. I've heard nothing but bad news about this place.
The Psychic told me -- for free -- that this campsite is what we're looking for. I don't know why it was free information though.
lines.note: Suddenly suspicious

lines.text: You gotta search this whole camp. I didn't even have to ask on the radio, they were already talking about this place.
lines.note: Worried for you

lines.text: I heard some hunters use this camp once in a while. Last time they were there, they got scared off.
lines.note: We know why.

lines.text: Someone said they fell asleep in this cave and... well... they nearly died. I think it's exactly where you need to go. Er. That sounded bad.
You have to investigate this cave. Of course, I promised I would pass it along that if you did, in fact, go there that you would meet with your doom.
lines.note: Mockingly repeats what he was told to say.

lines.text: That's from the psychic, who isn't actually psychic. He just takes a ton of chems and likes to jump off tall objects. *sighs*
lines.note: Shaking his head

lines.text: Someone ran back to Crater recently saying that this Cave was nothing but trouble. So, that seems like exactly where you should be going.
lines.note: Warning, and a clue

lines.text: It's in a civic building. Don't ask me how I know. I have my sources.
Jimbo went to this civic building by himself one day. For his own reasons, I suppose. He said some things seemed unusual...
lines.note: Warning, and a clue

lines.text: I woke up in the middle of the night to someone repeating this location in radio chatter. Said a friend went in and didn't make it out.
lines.note: Warning, and a clue

lines.text: This old communications building seems promising... I've heard a bit about it on the radio, and I think it jives with what we're looking for.
lines.note: Warning, and a clue

lines.text: The psychic chem fiend I know said this old communications building is exactly the place to be. Seems... uh. Worth a shot. I guess.
lines.note: Warning, and a clue

lines.text: I had a list of over a dozen potential locations in this region, but it just has to be this communications operations station.
lines.note: Warning, and a clue

lines.text: This old compound just stands out like a sore thumb, doesn't it? I can't explain why though...
lines.note: Warning, and a clue

lines.text: Definitely need to check this compound. The only other possibility is really remote, so let's focus on the most likely option first.
lines.note: Warning, and a clue

lines.text: This old compound used to be used for... I dunno... military stuff? But lately it has had other purposes. And I think we should check into it.
lines.note: Warning, and a clue

lines.text: It took me an embarrassingly long time to figure out where this was stashed. I mean, he just replied, "Dam!" And I figured... well... anyway.
lines.note: Amused, joking

lines.text: The coded message I got just had a bunch of jokes in it. Then I realized the jokes had a theme... and well, you're going to a dam.
lines.note: Amused, joking

lines.text: Dam... you...
lines.note: Amused, joking

lines.text: No seriously. Go to this dam. Search it. And then I promise you won't hear another dam joke from me. For... a bit.
lines.note: Amused, joking

lines.text: I intercepted some radio output from the place we're looking for, and it's got machinery. Heavy machines from a factory, and I know just the one.
Jimbo said this factory has has some weird activity lately. He said he was gonna stash some chems there, but then he thought better of it.
It's in the factory. I can't say exactly how I know... I have to protect my sources sometimes. But trust me.
I heard through the grapevine that this farm definitely has something special there. That matches up with the radio chatter too.
I know a farmer who was going to take over this farm and try to fix it up, but something was just... off about it.
When I was a kid, I wanted to be a farmer. I wasn't in these parts back then. I always look at farms extra closely now, thinking about it...
Anyway, I asked a trader buddy from Crater to swing by this farm on her last trip. She said it was in no fit shape for people.
So... along with a couple other bits of info from the radio, I think we should check there first.
I heard someone repeating this house's address on the radio for a while. I didn't know why... but a hunter stopped there and confirmed it.
It's just a house. A simple, completely and definitely not haunted house. I was advised by the not-psychic Psychic that I had to warn you.
lines.note: Direct, amused

lines.text: You need to search this house. It won't take long. If it's a bust, I got three other places in mind. Just let me know.
I asked a hunter if he had checked out this lookout tower, but he said he just doesn't do heights. So let's just start there. We do heights. Right?
lines.note: Smirking a little

lines.text: I have absolutely squat in terms of good intel about this Lookout Tower. And... I've eliminated everywhere else. So I mean, it's gotta be there.
How do you feel about heights? I'm at least sixty percent sure that it's in this lookout tower.
One of my contacts sent this lead over because he doesn't do medical facilities. Says they're just creepy. And, well, he's not wrong.
Once I helped scavenge a medical facility on the way to Appalachia, and it was... it wasn't good. It had been used by a cult for years.
lines.note: Spooky story time

lines.text: They clearly sacrificed someone in the operating room. On the table. I never saw so much blood. I was just there looking for some spare chems...
I swore I'd never go back to one of those places alone. Anyway... so... I guess that's what I'm asking you to do now. Maybe you can bring a friend?
lines.note: He's sorry about it

lines.text: I tapped into this medical facility to just listen. Just in case. You never know, right? I heard... activity. It wasn't natural. Something is there.
Thing is... I am pretty sure I heard someone enter too. Maybe a scavenger. They... they didn't last long.
I asked for details on the radio network and got one reply, "Mine." I figured, that's fine -- I respect claims. That's how we work.
lines.note: Setup for a joke

lines.text: But then she clarified that we needed to search that mine. Ha. Anyway, she passed through it recently. Didn't want to detour for anything. All yours.
lines.note: Amusing, sort of a joke

lines.text: I feel so sure that there's a song about this. You need to go to this mine... and search it... and try not to lose your mind. I dunno.
lines.note: Trying to recall, as if there's a song.

lines.text: I heard about this place from a couple scavengers, seems like they were using it until it got too dangerous.
Jimbo said this mine is always busy. Lots of stashes, that kind of thing. But... lately it's been dangerous. A different sort of busy. You get me?
Someone on the radio network seemed to know exactly where we need to go. Said it was this power substation. And she didn't answer my questions...
From the radio chatter about this, I am moderately certain this power substation could be it.
Got confirmation from my buddy Jimbo that we should check this power substation for it. Don't ask me how Jimbo knows this stuff.
lines.note: Good old Jimbo

lines.text: I know it's at this park, and... you should be careful. The psychic I know said that parks are the gateway between civilization and nature.
But... in our world now, I think that line got blurred. Maybe there is no line at all? Maybe the parks are now a gateway for something else.
lines.note: Now he's just being a loon

lines.text: Anyway... I gotta... let you check this place out. I can't really go into it but... I think it's where you need to look.
lines.note: Scared a little

lines.text: Last time I was at the park I ran into a shadowy creature with long, spindly fingers. It was reaching for me... scraping its claws on my face.
It sounded like a thousand coughing voices quietly cackling in just a bit below what I could hear...
I fell down and hit my head against a rock. When I woke up, it was morning, and in front of me there was a giant, dead tree covered in dry leaves.
lines.note: The story contnues

lines.text: Was it real? I don't know. I don't. I was on chems a little, sure... but... I don't know.
lines.note: Scared, he thinks it was real.

lines.text: I don't wanna ever go back to a park though, I can tell you that. But... thankfully I have you to do that instead. Right?
Did I tell you about that time I went to the park? I just... I need you to search this place and see. It might be it.
lines.note: A little scared

lines.text: I heard in the old days that people would go to research facilities like this and summon spirits that would inhabit their bodies and... wait. Wait.
lines.note: Suddenly confused.

lines.text: I think I got that confused with the other place. The... drive-in? I think. Okay. I don't know what they researched here.
lines.note: Admitting a goof

lines.text: But... regardless. I think this is where you need to go. The uh. Research facility. Not the other thing.
According to the Network, you need to start at this research facility.
As much as I loathe to send you to a research facility, I think that's where you gotta start.
So, I asked my old buddy Jimbo, and he said to check out this resort. With the information I already picked up, it just seemed like the perfect spot.
lines.note: Why not?

lines.text: I don't really get the concept of a resort. You know? People back in the old days would just... go there and lie down or something? Why?
lines.note: He was born after the war

lines.text: I heard they would just drink and then sleep and not think of things. How weird is that? Why couldn't they do that where they lived? I do that here.
Anyway... go there, see if it's the right spot. I think it is. Maybe lie down? See if it makes you feel better?
lines.note: Not sure how resorts work

lines.text: Someone on the radio told me that we should start here. No context. Should we trust it? Probably not. But... heck. We're not push-overs.
lines.note: Pretending to be strong

lines.text: I heard that back in the old days, people would leave babies here until they knew everything and then they'd pick them up as adults.
lines.note: He says this like he knows

lines.text: It's very practical when you think about it, but definitely not the raider style. We always did on-the-job training. You know?
But here's the deal. You wanna search this place. Thoroughly. But don't stay there forever, you know? Don't like... learn stuff.
There's a school that matches the description of the location in the code, and I think that's our best bet.
I heard back in the old days you could either go to school or buy a house, but not both. But did you get to keep the whole school?
In any case, Jimbo said we should definitely check this place out first. See what we can find.
This old store has it all. Including what we need, right now. Hot dang that could have been a jingle!
From what I heard on the radio chatter, we need to check inside this store. Dunno which aisle, hah!
lines.note: explaining a mission/favor you are asking the player to do

lines.text: Jimbo said this store. Aisle 3. Or... maybe in Home Goods. I think he was just making up stuff though. But let's just check the store.
From the radio chatter, it seems like this is located in a town. I can't really get more specific than that.
I heard a woman's voice repeat locations all around this town on the radio. Just a long string of addresses. I think it might be the whole town.
lines.note: Weirded out

lines.text: She wouldn't stop or answer questions either. I think... I think we should just cross it off the list after a sweep. You know?
The message was cutting out on the radio, so I know it's in a town anyway...
I eliminated several possible locations except for the trainyard, so let's start there.
I asked a buddy who asked an old hunter friend, who asked a former solider she knows, who asked a farmer that just arrived from the east...
lines.note: Out of breath

lines.text: And the farmer said that she heard a trader say that he saw something unusual here at this train yard. So, that's what I got.
lines.note: out of breath

lines.text: My old hunting buddy Jimbo said it's definitely in the train yard. He knows because he loves trains and he... knows these things.
I've isolated the issue down to three possible locations. If I were hiding something, I'd pick the tunnel out of these options. So let's start there.
I picked up a simple encoded message. When I say simple, I mean it was literally a Bookl cipher. Adorable. It's in the tunnel, no question about it.
I didn't bother with this lead for a bit, but someone just asked about it on the radio, so you should probably check it out before they do.
I distinctly heard humming on the radio, and it reminded me of an old restaurant's jingle. So I think that's where you should go.
I was able to pull in a few favors on this one to narrow down the location, and I can tell you for sure that it's at this restaurant.
I have been slowly eliminating locations where this could be located for quite a while. Seems like the only thing that's left is this restaurant.
This was a hard one to pinpoint. I was able to eliminate a bunch of nearby locales... so I think it's going to be in the wilderness.
According to the radio chatter, this is just somewhere in the wilderness basically. But I have narrowed it down a bit for you at least.
I dug into this one quite a lot, and I've narrowed it down to a small tract of land in the wilderness.
I'll show you on your map, but beyond that, I have no idea.
lines.note: sincere, trying to be helpful, but you really don't know much

topics.prompt: What's my target here?

lines.text: Network is saying there's at least one known Angler there. Possibly entranced by some sort of cult nonsense.
lines.note: Or maybe not

lines.text: There's a rumor that the Mothman kept an Angler as a pet. Got it real mean, then released it. That Angler is here, now.
Heard there's an Angler here, but not just any Angler. This one was used in a Blood Eagle ceremony. Probably a mean one, probably enraged.
lines.note: Scared, a bit

lines.text: Network is saying that some Settler hacked an Assaultron and tripped its mega-assault subroutines. Now it's gone haywire.
I heard there's an Assaultron there, and it's possessed. I heard this from a reputable source -- sure, it involved chems. Why not?
Picked up a cryptid message on the network, couldn't make out much. Something about an Assaultron.
Every so often, a gnarly Bloatfly with a particularly mean streak hatches. If it isn't killed quickly, it breeds. That's what I heard.
lines.note: Warning, kill it

lines.text: Network said a farmer saw this Bloatfly fly out of her Brahmin's mouth, and the Brahmin collapsed like an old puppet.
I heard this Bloatfly can talk, but it only talks to you when you're on a mixture of chems. Make sure it doesn't breed, we don't need more!
lines.note: Warning, kill it

lines.text: I heard Bloodbugs are controlled by a cult that just wants to use our blood for rituals. This specific Bloodbug came from a cultist hideout recently.
lines.note: Warning, kill it

lines.text: Did you know Bloodbugs are now working with the Blood Eagles? Network said so. This one Bloodbug was seen following a gang of them like a pet.
lines.note: Warning, kill it

lines.text: Got a lead on a Bloodbug that took a bite out of everybody in a whole family, then they all died in a day. You have to get rid of it.
lines.note: Warning, kill it

lines.text: You need to take out this Blood Eagle before even more Diehards get sucked into that garbage. Pretty simple. Make it stop.
This one is personal. I... I think this is someone from my old gang. Now a Blood Eagle? Unreal. The things I've heard... it has to stop.
lines.note: Sad about it, but kill them

lines.text: Many Blood Eagle gangs have a leader, and the network thinks they're all up to something... unusual. Cultish. That's a reason to die already, right?
lines.note: Yeah, kill 'em!

lines.text: Get this. Radio is saying this Cave Cricket was used by a Cult and is now cursed. That makes it a cursed Cultish Cave Cricket.
lines.note: Tongue twister

lines.text: Heard there was a Cave Cricket that cannibalized a creche of eggs. That's right. A cannibalistic creche-killing Cave Cricket. Kill it.
lines.note: Tongue twister

lines.text: At the center of this place there's a Cave Cricket, and the network thinks it's controlled by something else. That it's a conduit. Maybe it is.
Network has been tracking this beast for a while. This Deathclaw is wildly aggressive and... remembers. Waits. It needs to be destroyed.
lines.note: Warning, kill this thing.

lines.text: I heard a chem junkie say she could see in this Deathclaw's mind while in a dream, and then it showed up for her the next day. Fiction? Maybe.
lines.note: Warning, kill this thing.

lines.text: Network wants this Deathclaw dead. Apparently it attacked Chally the Moo-Moo when Grahm was a ways off. Got a good bite in, too.
lines.note: Angry, everybody loves Chally (said like Charlie but without the R)

lines.text: I don't know if it's true, but someone on the radio network is convinced that this Eyebot at this location is used by the Mothman. Just destroy it?
lines.note: Warning, kill this thing. May as well.

lines.text: There were some mysterious murders lately, and this one Eyebot was noticed nearby for all of them. Let's just destroy it, okay? For safety.
lines.note: Warning, kill this thing. May as well.

lines.text: Heard this Eyebot was present at a few cult gatherings. Not sure why. Destroy it so they can't use it anymore, okay?
lines.note: Warning, kill this thing. May as well.

lines.text: The Network sent someone out looking for an ancient Fog Crawler and they never returned. But we think we know where the Fog Crawler is.
lines.note: Warning, kill this thing.

lines.text: Some chem junkie claimed this Fog Crawler terrorized him in his dreams. Can you just take care of it, just in case? The Fog Crawler, not the junkie.
lines.note: Warning, kill this thing.

lines.text: Everybody on the network knows that this Fog Crawler is rabid. Or... some equivalent. It's gone mad. Feral. Just put it down, okay?
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: Someone on this Network requested that this Feral Ghoul in particular gets put down. I think... they knew who it was, once. Maybe. Be kind.
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: Folks on the radio have reported seeing this Feral Ghoul acting odd. Maybe... leading some others? Can't be true. Let's just stop it for good.
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: This Feral Ghoul was released by one of the local Cults. Released. Why would they do that? Find it, kill it before... it does their bidding.
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: Ever hear of a Floater? Well. You're about to run right into one. Good luck, friend. You'll need it.
lines.note: Warning the player about a new monster.

lines.text: Floaters. That's what they're called. Weird things. Fortunately for you, I think there's only one. But the Network has been wrong before.
lines.note: Warning the player about a new monster.

lines.text: Heard it's a Floater. How do you even kill those things? They freak me out.
lines.note: Warning the player about a new monster.

lines.text: I deciphered a strange cryptogram that leads me to think that there a Grafton Monster at this spot.
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: One of the chem junkies that gets on the network sometimes is insisting that there's a Grafton Monster here. I don't know if I believe him.
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: Apparently there's a Grafton Monster there that was being toyed with by the Blood Eagles. Put it out of its misery, will you?
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: I deciphered a cryptogram left in my pocket somehow, indicated that there was a Gulper at this place. Did you... put that in my pocket? No? Ok. Uh..
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: Several eyewitnesses confirmed that there's a Gulper here, but at least some of them are chem junkies so. I dunno. Take it or leave it.
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: The cult nearby released this Gulper after a bunch of chanting was overheard. Dunno what it means, but that Gulper needs to die.
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: Received a coded message on the radio that seems to identify this particular Honey Beast as blessed by the cult. You know what that means.
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: Heard some science minded folks tracked down a cloud of pheromones to this one Honey Beast. Could be disrupting the whole area. So... kill it?
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: The network is convinced that this Honey Beast is actually from somewhere else and is going to corrupt our local Honey Beasts. May as well kill it.
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: I know two things: it's a giant friggin' Insect, and... someone on the radio network is convinced it has been stalking him. So... kill it?
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: I wasn't able to fully decipher this cryptogram. I know it's a Giant Insect, but I don't know what its problem is.
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: It's definitely a Giant Insect. I heard it was gathering a storm of other insects, but... how threatening is it? I can't say for sure.
lines.note: Warning, concerned. this could be a hard kill.

lines.text: This Liberator has been sending me corrupt cryptograms repeatedly. I've traced it down to this individual. Destroy it. I don't need any more of this.
lines.note: Warning, concerned. This has been so annoying.

lines.text: This Liberator in particular has been trying to access our network repeatedly. Find it. Destroy it.
lines.note: Warning, concerned. This has been so annoying.

lines.text: I thought I was tapping into the radio network a bit ago, but I was talking directly to this... this Liberator! You have to shut it down!
lines.note: Warning, concerned. This has been so annoying.

lines.text: I asked on the radio if anyone had been nearby lately, and someone said she saw a Megasloth there and left. So, I know there's that.
lines.note: Friendly warning

lines.text: A hunter popped on the radio channels asking for help with a Megasloth there, but I haven't heard anything since.
Turns out Megasloths are easy to track. Makes sense, right? Well, according to the radio chatter, one is there.
A trader got onto the radio specifically to tell us all that he thinks trapped a giant Mirelurk there. So... that's that.
There's a Mirelurk there. Might be a King or Queen... not sure exactly. The radio report was mostly screaming.
A hunter reported smelling a Mirelurk there, so it sounds like there's at least one big Mirelurk there, but could be more.
Radio chatter says there's one angry Mole Miner there. Usually when one shows up, others follow fast.
lines.note: Warning, he's seen this before

lines.text: Nobody knew anything about this place at all. Asked everybody --nothing. Except... the psychic. He said: "Mole Miner" - that's it.
But honestly? Last time he told me "Sugar Bombs." I still don't know how that fits in. So take it or leave it.
I don't know what's there now, but I know that a while ago there was just one angry, mean Mole Miner. Everyone avoided it. Could still be there.
Radio chatter is clear: there is a giant, aggressive Mole Rat here. They all said to avoid it, it's probably rutting.
According to the last hunter I talked to from Crater, there's a hyper aggressive Mole Rat here. You know what to expect...
That musty stinky smell. And a hyper aggressive Mole Rat, too.
lines.note: Joking, sorta.

lines.text: Heard a bunch of chem addicts from Crater went up there to hide for a bit, roll around in the hay, you know. They ran afoul with a giant Mole Rat!
Radio chatter is saying that there's a Mothman Cultist here, preparing for a ritual. They could hear the chanting a ways away.
Someone saw the Mothman here recently amidst chanting from within. The Mothman is gone, but the Cultist remains inside. Waiting. Preparing.
I intercepted a cryptic message on the radio recently about this place. One Mothman Cultist is claiming it for a new sanctuary.
Some trader mentioned she heard the buzzing from a Mr. Gutsy at this place recently. She said it sounded maniacal.
Heard a scavenger from Crater went in there looking for a famed Mr. Gutsy made of gold. I don't think that exists. Well, a regular Mr. Gutsy, sure.
There's a Mr. Gutsy there. For sure. You know how I know? The damn thing got on the radio channels, issuing threats. I admire its moxie in a way...
lines.note: Warning, amused

lines.text: Not even sure what you'll find here. The psychic wasn't even that... precise. Some sort of Mutation, that's all he could pull from it.
Radio chatter went silent when I asked. Last time that happened, it was a gnarly, aggressive Mutation of some kind.
This place is well known for its Mutation problem. Usually one shows up and does... whatever... and others follow suit.
There's a scavenger on the radio sometimes, older fellow. He said some Protectron lost him here once. He was hoping to pull some scrap from it.
Sounded like it was running some sort of defensive algorithm. I'd watch out if you go in after it.
Heard someone in Crater was tinkering around with a Protectron, flipped some switches, and the thing went haywire. Somehow ended up at this spot.
I know this trader who reprogrammed a Protectron to carry her supplies, but somehow when they got close to this location, something strange happened.
Maybe some old algorithm kicked in? I don't know, but it attacked her, and she barely made it back to Crater. I think it's still there, though.
Heard a trader stopped here to eat her lunch and watched as a Rad Ant came out of no where. She barely returned to Crater alive.
Radio chatter indicated that a lone Rad Ant was noticed here, huge and bloated. Might have been carrying eggs. Who knows if it's still alone.
I don't usually hear from Settlers, but one of them saw a herd of Brahmin head this way. But they got wrecked by a single, angry Rad Ant.
Who knows if it's still alone. The Settler was good enough or dumb enough to warn everybody on the radio though, at least. I guess.
lines.note: Doesn't like settlers

lines.text: Radio chatter claims there's a Radrat nest here. Who knows how many Radrats could be here now though.
Apparently a trader carrying some cheese barely escaped with his life as he went by this place. Was almost shredded by a massive Radrat.
I got a cryptic message about this place. I couldn't decipher it all. I know there's at least a big angry Radrat here. Could be more.
I hate the sound of Radroaches. You know what I mean? The crinkly thin wings. The snapping carapaces. No thanks.
lines.note: Grossed out

lines.text: The guy on the radio said there was at least one. But you know how this goes! There's probably more by now. Ugh.
lines.note: Grossed out

lines.text: It's a Radroach. The trader tried to claim there's just one there, but I certainly don't believe it.
lines.note: Grossed out

lines.text: I heard the Mothman Cultists grow a Radroach somewhere until it's bursting with eggs, then they sacrifice it under a full moon.
I don't know if that's true, but if it is, I bet the giant Radroach that my friend Jimbo saw here is being raised for that purpose.
lines.note: Grossed out

lines.text: Jimbo said he tracked a mean old Radscorpion down to around these parts. I bet you it's in there.
Grahm told me that he saw a Radscorpion head over to this place a bit ago. I bet it's still there.
lines.note: Warning indirectly from Grahm

lines.text: Picked up a conversation over the radio between a Radscorpion hunter and a farmer. Farmer said one chased her to this place recently.
Hunter was going to go set out some traps, but then disappeared. Maybe she got there, or maybe... she didn't.
I heard some Raider jerk who broke off from Crater -- not me, some other Raider jerk -- decided to hole up at this place and cause problems.
lines.note: Amused, they're both Raiders

lines.text: Heard from a friend back in Crater that one of their own killed someone and took off. And now that ex-Raider is trying to form a new gang.
lines.note: Emphasis on ex

lines.text: Crater expelled this Raider scumbag for hurting other Diehards. That's not how we do things. Apparently they took up residence at this place.
lines.note: The speaker is a Raider so they have venom for this person

lines.text: My old friend Jimbo said he saw one lonely Robobrain head into this place while he was on his way to Crater. Could be hostile by now.
Heard static on the radio comm for a while, then... a voice. A Robobrain warned us all not to go to this location. Said it was claimed.
I think there's more to it, though. I think it's guarding something for somebody. Something valuable. That's my guess.
lines.note: It might be something good.

lines.text: Radio chatter says there's a Robobrain at this place and it seems to be acting rather suspicious. Even for a robobrain.
I deciphered a message and... all I can say is, there's a robot there. At least one. I really can't figure out more info though.
Radio chatter said there was definite Robot activity here, maybe more than one unit. Could be military. Hard to say.
My old friend Jimbo swore he saw one Robot show up at this place and disappear. Could be hiding. Could be more there by now, too.
Someone watched Scorchbeasts fighting there. One survived and is now nesting, we think.
Jimbo went down to Whitespring for a classy date, and on his way back up he saw a Scorchbeast just shredding some poor Settlers at this spot.
Radio chatter indicated that Cultists had a ritual here, but a Scorchbeast arrived instead of their summon. Anyway... the Scorchbeast remains.
It isn't unusual for Scorched to be here, but Jimbo said there was one... one mean Scorched... who was shredding other Scorched. Weird, huh?
Heard there was a Scorched family here once. All of them were killed except one. I don't know if more arrived since.
Radio chatter indicated that one strange weird Scorched walked here from just outside of Crater. Isn't clear why, exactly...
Intercepted a code that was supposed to be sent to a Sentry Bot. Instructed it to go to this location. Not sure if it received the message.
I know this scavenger in Crater who loves Sentry Bots the most. Said she tracked one down to this spot, but then she lost it. Could be hiding there?
Jimbo said he saw some Sentry Bot tracks around this place. Probably just one, but could be more. He said it was hard to tell.
Some Settler just snapped and... well... yeah. You gotta just take care of it.
lines.note: Warning the player about a new monster.

lines.text: Heard some Settler just... snapped. Hurt a bunch of people. Not worth going into details about it, honestly. Just take care of it.
lines.note: Warning the player about a new monster.

lines.text: I've been telling people forever that Settlers are just as messed up as anyone else. Looks like we got someone who's proving me right. Take 'em out.
lines.note: Warning the player about a new monster.

lines.text: I know this Hunter who used to live in Beckley before the war, then left and came back recently. Exclusively tracks Cryptids now.
Said this place has one for sure. Said he has a hunch it's a Sheepsquatch. I trust him.
I was listening to people chat on the radio and heard a Sheepsquatch howl. Asked where that was from and somebody said this spot, then went silent.
Jimbo said a Sheepsquatch was sheepsquatting here. His words, not mine.
lines.note: Warning, humorous

lines.text: I picked up a cryptic message. Someone is tracking this Snallygaster, and they tracked it here. Who knows if they survived...
Heard from the radio chatter that a Snallygaster is nesting here. Or whatever they do. It's there. Could be more by now.
Someone in Foundation tried to keep a pet Snallygaster. Can you believe it? Anyway, they're dead. The Snallygaster ran away and is at this place.
lines.note: Warning, laughing, he hates settlers

lines.text: There's a Stingwing Lord here. A vicious, cruel Stingwing that dominates the others under its will. Destined to rule them all. Destined to fall.
What did you think? Was it mysterious enough? I was thinking about starting a radio show about all the things we do.
lines.note: Excited, eager

lines.text: Oh but... uh. There's a Stingwing there. Yeah. That part was real.
A trader saw Stingwing poo around this place, so could be one there. I asked on the radio what Stingwing poo looked like. They said "Gesundheit!
lines.note: friendly, sincere, sharing the intel you have with the player so they are informed about the favor/mission you are sending them on

lines.text: Where there's one Stingwing, there's many. Or just one. Honestly it isn't really a strong indicator of population. But anyway. There's one here.
Someone on the radio said they heard Super Mutant songs coming from this place. So I'd expect at least one to be there.
Heard there was a Super Mutant uh... shindig... here. Do you think that's what they're called? They killed some animals and burned something.
I wonder if they were celebrating something.... like a Super Mutant birthday maybe? Anyway, some might have left. I dunno. But some remain.
Apparently there's one angry Super Mutant at this place, shouting at anybody who passed. Didn't shoot, just yelled.
Someone reported it on the radio, said the Super Mutant was angry about squishies. That's all. Anyway, could be more now.
Radio chatter indicates that there's something odd here. Something... unusual. Something that smells like peat. Maybe a swamp... creature?
Cryptid hunter I know said she tracked down something wild to this spot. She wasn't sure what it was. Said it was... filthy. Smelled like the swamp.
There's a Cryptid Hunter who reports regularly on the radio. Sounded like she was pretty sure she trapped something here... not sure what.
I hate Ticks. There's one at this location. I don't want to get into the details. I just... I just wanted to let you know.
Jimbo said he trapped a big ole' Mama Tick here at this place. Could have laid a bunch of eggs by now. Eeeegh. I don't want to think about it.
lines.note: Grossed out

lines.text: If you could go kill every single Tick in the world, that would be great, thanks. You can start with the one at this place, okay?
Jimbo said one time he killed a RadToad then climbed inside its carcass. Why would he tell me this? Anyway, there's one here. Do... what you will.
There's a guy on the Network and every time he kills a RadToad he just says "Ribbit" on the comms with no commentary. I don't know why.
Anyway... there's a RadToad at this place. I know because he was going to go there and kill it, but... uh. I haven't heard a "ribbit" in a long time.
lines.note: Sadface, he dead

lines.text: Grahm told me there's a RadToad here, said he saw it from the road. Then he got sorta confused and called it a RoadTad.
lines.note: Awww cute

lines.text: Radio comms are saying that at least one big, mean dog has shredded everything at this location and is still there.
lines.note: Just fyi

lines.text: There's a Psychic who sometimes talks on the Radio Network and he said there's a vicious dog at this location. The dog used to be fine, he said.
lines.note: Dog story

lines.text: But he looked into the shadow realm and it's being ridden by an angry shadow demon lizard. Also, I should mention, this psychic is a chem fiend. So.
lines.note: Uhhhhh he's losing it

lines.text: Anyway. There might be a dog there. Also, I need to find out what chems cocktail that psychic was on. For... science... or... yeah.
lines.note: Yeah definitely for science and definitely not for later

lines.text: According to the radio network, there's a mean dog there. That's all. I don't know what the big deal is.
lines.note: He doesn't get it

lines.text: I asked on the radio if anybody knew anything about this place. Silence.
lines.note: Ominous. Mysterious.

lines.text: I asked again. Silence.
Then, in between static, I heard... "I am there.
lines.note: Ominous, creepy. "I am there" said in a wizened woman's voice. Impersonating a wendigo

lines.text: Pretty sure it was a friggin' Wendigo, friend. And she knows you're coming.
lines.note: In his voice: "Sucks to be you!

lines.text: You know what Wendigo do when they claim a nest? They pull their hair out and lay it in a giant circle, then they cover it with droppings and blood.
Then they whisper to whatever they believe in... or... themselves maybe? And they regurgitate their last meal and eat it once again.
And then they consider themselves bound to their lair, and will defend it to their death. That's what I heard from a Cryptid hunter anyway.
Oh! And relevant to you: there's one at this location.
lines.note: laughing a bit

lines.text: Jimbo went here once a while ago. Said he was going to stash some chems here. He got inside, did what he needed to do, and then turned around.
lines.note: Ominous, spooky

lines.text: And there she was. Thin as twigs, dry as leather, teeth lke needles. With that twisted smile. A Wendigo.
In a panic, he shoved a pile of chems right into her kisser and ran away! She might be there still... and she might be high as the sky this time!
Heard on the radio that there's just a Wolf here. A mean one, but just a wolf. I bet you there's more than one, but you never know.
A wolf was seen being chased into this place by a pack of rabid squirrels. I bet it's got some sort of pride issue, so... be careful.
lines.note: amused, jokingly

lines.text: I heard there was a pack of Wolves here recently, then some hunters picked them off until just one remained. But it was massive.
It chased off the hunters, took a couple down too. I bet it's going to rebuild its pack when it can. But now it has a taste for human blood.
Heard there was a Yao Guai that got chased in here by a pack of rabid squirrels. It could be there still. I dunno.
Jimbo said he knows for sure there's a Yao Guai there. Said he ran into it while he was stashing some chems. Said he dropped the chems there and ran!
lines.note: Oh, jimbo

lines.text: So... the Yao Guai could be you know. Opening its mind or... ripping its skin and coughing blood. Who knows.
There's only one thing worse than an angry Yao Guai.
lines.note: Pausing for you to guess.

lines.text: Getting stuck in an angry Yao Guai's lair.
lines.note: Heads up.

lines.text: So, be warned. There's one there, and it's angry. Don't let it catch you off guard.
I know one of those crazed Appalachian cults is behind this. I just know it.
lines.note: He doesn't really know it.

lines.text: There's gotta be more to it, but everybody's staying silent. You can't trust anything.
When I asked for more info, someone started chanting on the radio. Made my ears bleed. I couldn't shake it out of my mind for hours.
Did anything follow you back?
lines.note: Player just returned from a quest and is goign to return an item to the Raider Punk. Punk is excited to hear about new tales.

lines.text: Radio network said you were on your way back. Good.
lines.note: Player just returned from a quest and is goign to return an item to the Raider Punk. Punk is excited to hear about new tales.

lines.text: Friend-o! Good to see you survived another day in the wilds of Appalachia.
lines.note: Player just returned from a quest and is goign to return an item to the Raider Punk. Punk is excited to hear about new tales.

lines.text: You see anything... you know... weird out there?
lines.note: Player just returned from a quest and is goign to return an item to the Raider Punk. Punk is excited to hear about new tales.

lines.text: Aha, you're back. Talk to me.
lines.note: Player just returned from a quest and is goign to return an item to the Raider Punk. Punk is excited to hear about new tales.

lines.text: So... what happened? Did you uncover any secret truths?
lines.note: Player just returned from a quest and is goign to return an item to the Raider Punk. Punk is excited to hear about new tales.

lines.text: You find anything out there?
lines.note: Player just returned from a quest and is goign to return an item to the Raider Punk. Punk is excited to hear about new tales.

lines.text: I heard you were on your way back here...
lines.note: Player just returned from a quest and is goign to return an item to the Raider Punk. Punk is excited to hear about new tales.

lines.text: You gotta tell me everything you saw out there!
lines.note: Player just returned from a quest and is goign to return an item to the Raider Punk. Punk is excited to hear about new tales.

lines.text: I knew you'd make it back, champ.
lines.note: Player just returned from a quest and is goign to return an item to the Raider Punk. Punk is excited to hear about new tales.

lines.text: Whoa. Major deja vu here. Hey, friend...
lines.note: He heard the player approaching. This is a neutral hello that might be said a lot.

lines.text: I heard something... interesting on the radio, if you got a minute.
lines.note: He heard the player approaching.

lines.text: Hey. Wanna... hear something strange?
lines.note: He heard the player approaching. Is going to offer a quest from the radio network.

lines.text: Radio chatter has been so active lately.
lines.note: He heard the player approaching. Is going to offer a quest from the radio network. Confused and excited about the activity.

lines.text: Thought I heard something... and I was right!
lines.note: He heard the player approaching. Emphasis on the "Thought" part. I *thought* I heard something! and I was RIGHT! -- Excited.

lines.text: You wouldn't believe what I heard on the radio network earlier.
lines.note: He heard the player approaching. He always hears wild stuff on the radio. He's excited to tell the player.

lines.text: Radio chatter picked up on some odd happenings...
lines.note: He heard the player approaching. He always hears wild stuff on the radio. He's excited to tell the player.

lines.text: I was telling the radio network about you, they're impressed with your work.

topics.prompt: What do you know about this missing person?

lines.text: Well, I don't know if they're still alive but... there's a good chance. That's about all I've got in terms of details.
This sort of thing happens from time to time, but... it would be good if we could also stop it from time to time.
I've heard a bunch of wild rumors about this case... what's true? I think that's something you've got to find out for yourself.

topics.prompt: I'll be back later for another tip. Thanks, Punk.

lines.text: Good work there, friendo. Remember... mum's the word about the network. We're a selective group. Got it?
lines.note: Saying goodbye

topics.prompt: So... what's your name?

lines.text: Most of us don't use our real names once we join the network... my codename is Punk. That's good enough for me.
lines.note: Explaining why he doesn't have a name.

topics.prompt: What if I don't have time to investigate one of your leads?

lines.text: It's no sweat. Just let me know. I won't be mad or anything. I may be a Raider but I'm not a jerk. I got enough shit to worry about!
lines.note: Telling the player to return if anything messes up with their quest.

lines.text: If a different hunter picks up your lead, I'll just figure something else out for you to investigate. It's not a big deal.
lines.note: Informing the player that all is cool

topics.prompt: Will you always have some weird leads for me?

lines.text: Probably. I investigate a few things on my own in addition to the network's sources... and I have a couple contacts who stop by from time to time.
lines.note: Explaining more about the information gathering

lines.text: So... you know, give me some time in between visits but I should be able to scrounge up something pretty regularly. Probably every day.
lines.note: Confident in his ability to offer daily quests.

topics.prompt: When will you have something else for me to check out?

lines.text: Maybe a day or so? Doubt it would be much longer than that.
lines.note: Informing the player how this works.

lines.text: So... I think that's really all the proof I need. You can handle at least some stuff. I can work with that.
lines.note: Impressed with the player's ability.

lines.text: Tell ya what. I've been monitoring the radio chatter, and I'm going to find something else for you. Might take a bit of time though.
lines.note: informing the player that another quest will be on its way.

lines.text: Good luck out there, friendo. If you can't do it right now then just swing by another time, I'll keep tabs on it for ya.
lines.note: Telling the player to return to him if anything goes wrong with the quest.

topics.prompt: Why can't your "network" take care of this themselves?

lines.text: There aren't a lot of us and Appalachia is full of bizarre, weird stuff... dunno if you noticed.
lines.note: Leaning in to explain, a little embarrassed that they can't handle it all themselves.

lines.text: And, well, a lot of our network members just report what they uncover. They leave the dangerous investigations to the wild punks like us.
lines.note: Proud that he's a wild punk. The player is a wild punk too, by insinuation.

topics.prompt: What am I looking for, exactly?

lines.text: One of the hunters who reports to the network said there's a broken cryptid monitor at this place. We might be able to fix it up and use it.
Of course... it might be junk or some misidentified gadget. But... it's worth checking out.
lines.note: Excited about the prospect but he knows it could be a crap lead.

topics.prompt: Anything dangerous at this place?

lines.text: I'll be honest with you, friend. I heard some sort of infested corpse pile birthed a ton of insects...
lines.note: Shivering. He hates these things.

lines.text: Really grotesque shit, my friend. Probably nothing left by now, either... except the stink and a ton of Blood Bugs or Ticks or something.
lines.note: Warning the player that there are insects at this location.

lines.text: So... I dunno. Bring a giant fly swatter? Flames? Run quickly in and out before they get you too?
lines.note: Shrugging, not sure what to suggest the player.

topics.prompt: Just give me a location and I'm good to go.

lines.text: Swell! Once you've dealt with that, I'll start giving you regular tips from the network. Should be pretty rad.
lines.note: A promise of future quests

lines.text: There's apparently a broken device out there that could be helpful for the network if we can fix it up.
lines.note: This is the quest pitch.

lines.text: I know where it is. I just need you to pick it up.
lines.note: Second part is a bit of a muttered addendum.

topics.prompt: So what's today's hot tip?

lines.text: I picked this one up from the network before leaving Crater, thought it would be a good one for you to chomp down on first.
lines.note: Eyebrow raised, offering a quest with a challenge.

topics.prompt: How does the "network" work, exactly?

lines.text: Our team is all over the place. They report odd things, sometimes on the radio, or in encoded notes, and sometimes direct from... psychics.
lines.note: He gets more conspiracy-like the longer he talks.

topics.prompt: What's in it for me?

lines.text: Aside from expanding your mind and understanding the true Appalachia, you mean?
lines.note: He's pretty serious about it, but also a tiny bit amused by the question.

lines.text: I mean... sometimes you can find some valuable stuff there because people have avoided these places for a while.
lines.note: Shrugging and admitting that there's value to the chore.

topics.prompt: What info should I expect from the "network"?

lines.text: I get tips about strange creatures and unusual items in Appalachia. This place is crawling with cryptids, you know.
lines.note: Leaning in closer at the end, trying to be all top secret about elusive theories.

topics.prompt: Can I join this "network"?

lines.text: No way. Sorry, friend. It's a selective group of like-minded individuals and it takes years to build up their trust.
lines.note: He's genuinely sorry about it, but it's absolutely a non-starter. And it would be risky for him too.

lines.text: But first... let me explain what I can do for you, since I'm staying here and all. I'm going to let you in on the real Appalachia, my friend.
lines.note: Intro to this character as a weirdo conspiracy type NPC.

lines.text: You lucked out because... I'm part of a secret network that monitors unusual things and we track them down.
lines.note: This is the introduction to the character for the player. He's a cryptid hunter. He is whispering towards the end because this is secret.

lines.text: And I'm going to slide some of that information your way.
lines.note: He's saying what his role will be. He's really proud of his contribution, and is bragging a bit that he can do this for the player.

topics.prompt: You can stay at my place for 50 caps a day.

lines.text: Oh uh. Geez. Dang it. I don't have that much... but... hey, tell you what. I know people who know things.
lines.note: Bummed out

lines.text: I can... I can tell you where to find valuables, find missing people or maybe kill things... those things have bounties sometimes.
I can definitely find you at least something every day. Something worth your time. Is that... is that okay? Please say yes.
lines.note: Really excited.

topics.prompt: You can set up your radio at my place. Okay?

lines.text: Seriously? Whoa. That's out of this world. You got space for me there? I don't need much. I just need open airwaves, baby.
lines.note: He's so excited and naive

lines.text: Here... here... take my radio. Set it up at your place. I gotta make some plans. Tell some buddies. Tell my mom. Oh yeah, my mom...
lines.note: He's a bit derpy

lines.text: This is the best day! Oh man! I'll see you soon!
Always gotta be ready to go on recon.
lines.note: Quietly, muttering

lines.text: The radio network is gonna be so jazzed when they hear about this.
lines.note: Kinda excited!

lines.text: Can't wait to tell the rest of the gang!
lines.note: Kinda excited!

lines.text: A whole new world is opening up!
lines.note: Kinda excited!

lines.text: I just need to get out on my own one of these days, you know?
This place is too crowded for me.
I need to set up my radio someplace where I can talk freely. Openly.
The radio network is growing every day. But I'm no use to them where I am now.
Face to face communication isn't my thing. It never was.
Got some family here. Gotta make sure they're okay.
lines.note: Quietly, muttering

lines.text: I wonder if they'll let me set up my radio around here.
Crater is just too crowded these days.
I need some fresh air, that's all.
There's just too many people around all the time.
If I could live out in the wilderness, out away from all this, I would. I just don't have it in me.
lines.note: Depressed, annoyed that he's not good enough

lines.text: Four sightings in the past week. That's gotta be a record.
lines.note: Excited, he loves cryptic stuff

lines.text: I never heard of anything so scary before in my life. I better radio it out to the gang.
lines.note: Excited, he loves cryptic stuff

lines.text: I heard the mothman steals your dreams.
lines.note: Excited, he loves cryptic stuff

lines.text: I never saw any ghosts, but I once saw giant turtle with two heads.
Someone on the radio said there was a headless beast ripping people apart near the lake. How exciting is that, man?!
lines.note: Excited, he loves cryptic stuff

topics.prompt: You're too weird for me, man. Bye.

lines.text: I get that a lot. Like a lot. It's okay... I got plenty of friends here. And I know people... on the radio. They know me too!
lines.note: Grumbling, embarrassed

topics.prompt: Give me your radio, say your byes and meet me at my camp.

lines.text: Yes! My life is really turning around. Everybody on the radio is gonna be so impressed!
lines.note: Super excited

topics.prompt: You're too weird for me, man. Bye.

lines.text: I get that a lot. Like a lot. It's okay... I got plenty of friends here. And I know people... on the radio. They know me too!

topics.prompt: [Raider Reputation Cooperative+] Meg's great and all, but Crater isn't for everyone, right?

lines.text: I hear you. I really do. It's just too crowded, you know? It's okay sometimes but... not always.
lines.note: Agreed completely

lines.text: I got friends in Crater, and I like being nearby, but I don't like being there all the time. That's all. You feel me?
lines.note: Looking for approval

lines.text: Look. I got this dream, it eats me up inside. I've been traveling with this crowd for a while, and well... I need to get away. You feel me?
lines.note: Talking about the raiders

lines.text: They're well, don't get me wrong. I still wanna stop by and hang out with them, see the sights, but I need quiet, calm... I need to hear the world.
lines.note: He's a little weird

lines.text: I got a radio, I know some people. Got a buddy here in Crater, a hunter pal out in Foundation, know some people all over. I know people, man.
lines.note: Emphasis on the last part, quietly, as if nobody else can hear

topics.prompt: Uh, good luck with all that stuff.

lines.text: Huh? Why you still standing here? I've gotta find someone on the horn. Someone who can take me in... yeah, that's it.

topics.prompt: Why don't you set up your radio at my place?

lines.text: Because... because... I don't know you? Get lost, weirdo.
lines.note: Seriously though, he thinks the player is a creeper

topics.prompt: [Level 50+] I've been around, kid. I've seen things.

lines.text: You... you have? I bet you didn't see stuff while just hanging out in town, did you? No... you went out there in the world, you did stuff!
lines.note: Flailing, getting angsty

topics.prompt: [Perception 5+] You act like a caged animal.

lines.text: I *feel* like a caged animal, man. I need to get out of this place. I need... I need the open air. You get me?
lines.note: A little anxiety

topics.prompt: [Luck 8+] A wild guess here... do you think the Mothman steals our dreams?

lines.text: Oh man, oh man. I was just thinking that the other day. How... how did you know that?
lines.note: Freaking out, man

lines.text: Wait. I don't want to know. I want to find out for myself. I need to get out of this dump.
lines.note: Anxiety + Weird

lines.text: All I wanna do is get out of this place, get my radio set up somewhere and talk about the world, how it is now. You get me?
You hear of anything weird happening lately or what?
lines.note: Conspiracy guy

lines.text: Weird stuff just follows me around.
You gotta make more noise when you walk, friend.
Sssshhh. Did you... hear something? Smell something? Anything?
Not here. Too public.

lines: You can repair weapons, armor and Power Armor to 130% of normal maximum condition.
The weight of all junk items is reduced by 50%.
