lines.text: The Brotherhood can be a little intense to be around all day. Enjoying the solitude out here keeps me balanced.
lines.note: Genuine appreciation

lines.text: Hey there. You have a second? I was hoping to talk to you about something.
lines.note: Friendly, trustworthy. He is not pulling a fast one, he thinks what he's going to offer the player is in their best interests.

topics.prompt: Actually, that's okay.

lines.text: Alright. Did you want to talk about something else?

topics.prompt: I understand. Can I ask something else?

lines.text: Of course. What else did you want to know?

topics.prompt: Sounds like a load of bullshit.

lines.text: Doesn't make much of a difference to me, to be honest.
lines.note: Trying to make light of an insult

lines.text: But, next time you're bleeding out the ears from some swamp fungus... I just might charge extra.
lines.note: Being cheeky

topics.prompt: Thanks for sharing, Solomon.

lines.text: Thanks for listening.
But my medic survived, I flew out to the Capital to get a few honors pinned on my chest, and then my CO pushed for me to be enrolled into OCS.
lines.note: Matter of fact, definitely doesn't want to sound heroic

lines.text: Spent a few years on the track to an M.D. when a certain apocalyptic occurrence brought it to a premature end.
lines.note: Turning friendly again

topics.prompt: So... you just learned surgery in the middle of a battle?

lines.text: Well, I wouldn't go that far. Having two doctors as parents will teach you a few of the basics.
lines.note: Trying to ground the story into reality a little more.

lines.text: It's not like I performed open heart surgery on the spot. A piece of shrapnel hit her in the thigh. Was causing heavy blood loss.
lines.note: Matter of fact

topics.prompt: Sounds like life had a plan for you.

lines.text: I don't see myself that way. Nothing so grand.
lines.note: Doesn't really want to see himself as someone special

lines.text: First time in active combat, me and a few guys from my unit got separated from the group...
lines.note: Going from friendly to a darker tone

lines.text: Artillery fire brought a whole cliff side down between us and our base.
About twenty minutes later, when I found myself stitching up our medic, the calling finally caught up to me.
lines.note: Matter of fact. "The calling" highlighted as being special

lines.text: Maybe it was in my blood, maybe saving lives just felt more rewarding than taking them, but that experience changed things for me.

topics.prompt: Thanks. Let's change subjects.

lines.text: Fine by me.

topics.prompt: Should I be worried that my doctor "couldn't make the grades?

lines.text: Well, hold on, that's not the whole story.
lines.note: Laughter at the beginning

topics.prompt: And how did that work out for you?

lines.text: Well... Not the way I would have guessed.

topics.prompt: Hold on, who said I wasn't charging rent?

lines.text: Would you look at the time? I've got a very, uh, sick patient.
lines.note: Joking around

lines.text: Going to need to review these charts here for a few hours. Maybe the next day or two.
lines.note: Joking around

topics.prompt: Top brass? Is it someone I know? Dish out the details, doc!

lines.text: I don't think breaking doctor-patient confidentiality is in my best interest. But you should talk to them yourself.
lines.note: Friendly, but not joking around

lines.text: I couldn't tell you much about the members back in California, but the folk that came over with Paladin Rahmani are good people.
I tell ya, they've got some stories.
lines.note: Chuckle to self a bit

topics.prompt: What kind of things do the Brotherhood of Steel need to talk about?

lines.text: Under that armor, they're just normal people like you or me. They've got aspirations and anxieties.
lines.note: Serious, but lighter tone

lines.text: They worry if they're doing enough, if they're doing too much, or if they should be doing anything at all.
Their determination might seem steel-clad -- uh, pardon the pun -- but they are very human at heart.
lines.note: Light tone, jokey in the middle

topics.prompt: Wait, "getting your M.D.?" So you're not actually a doctor?

lines.text: Well, if you're asking if I was able to get a piece of paper and a title before the world turned sideways? Nuh-uh.
lines.note: Friendly in tone, but serious about the subject

lines.text: Time wasn't on my side there.
lines.note: Friendly still.

lines.text: But the world has changed a lot since then, and you could fill a library with the sort of nonsense ailments that our wonderful Wasteland can produce.
lines.note: Getting more serious

lines.text: So am I a "Dr.?" No. But am I a doctor? You better believe it.
lines.note: Dead serious about this. "am I doctor? No. But am I a DOCTOR? You better believe it

topics.prompt: Thanks. I was curious about something else.

lines.text: Oh? Like what?

topics.prompt: You mentioned being the "occasional therapist." What's that about?

lines.text: I guess it's a side effect to having a good bedside manner.
Patients tend to open up to me... They just need someone to talk to.
lines.note: Getting a little more serious. Maybe remembering some tough things he heard.

lines.text: From rookies to top brass, everyone just needs a chance to be vulnerable.
Since even the most routine check-ups can leave you buck-naked save for a flimsy gown, cultivating vulnerability is already my forte.
lines.note: Turning into a joke now

topics.prompt: Solomon is quite the name.

lines.text: Heh, tell me about it. My parents helped run the chapel at their hospital.
The runner-up for my name was Ichabod, so... I think I got off pretty lucky with Solomon.
lines.note: Feeling sentimental, but still joking around a bit

lines.text: I like it, though. Makes me feel wise. Maybe a little wiser than I actually am.
lines.note: Sentimental, but jokey

topics.prompt: You said you used to be in the Army?

lines.text: Truth is, I come from a long, long line of doctors... but growing up, it never stuck. Lost interest in school, couldn't make the grades.
lines.note: A bit sentimental, but not too heavy

lines.text: The Army felt like a place where I could make a difference, so I enlisted right out of high school.

topics.prompt: Where are you from?

lines.text: My family goes back generations in Detroit, but my path has led me all over. I can thank the Army for that one.
lines.note: Straight forward, not really too sentimental

lines.text: When the bombs hit, I was about a year from getting my M.D. at a university well away from home.
lines.note: Again, not really getting sentimental, just stating the facts

lines.text: I traveled all around after that. Before bumping into Paladin Rahmani's group, that is.
lines.note: Warming up a bit, he likes this part of the story

topics.prompt: Cure my diseases. [10 Caps]

lines.text: Open wide, and take a big gulp.
Alright. You should start feeling better soon. Anything else you wanted looked at?

topics.prompt: Cure my rads [20 Caps]

lines.text: If you start to feel light-headed, that means it's working.
And... Great. Clean as a whistle. Well, closer to it, anyway. What else did you need?

topics.prompt: Heal me, doc. [10 Caps]

lines.text: Hold still, this might sting a little.
lines.note: Not too concerned

lines.text: And... okay. You'll survive. Anything else?
lines.note: Friendly, dismissive

topics.prompt: Have you gotten the inoculation to the Scorched Plague?

lines.text: You mean that ingenious use of America's finest soft drink? Of course!
lines.note: Really jazzed about this

lines.text: I haven't had the chance to thank your Overseer -- or the Vault Dweller that provided the sample -- but we owe them our lives.
That look on your face... You're not telling me... that was you?
lines.note: Coming to realize who he's talking to

topics.prompt: I'm feeling a little sick. I think I may have come down with something.

lines.text: Yikes, uh... Did you always have something leaking out of your eyes? Well... no problem, I've got a little something for everything.
lines.note: Grossed out

topics.prompt: I think I've taken too many Rads. Can you help?

lines.text: Sure, I can bring those levels down if you want. Fair warning, unless you've got some extra resilient DNA, you're likely to lose any mutations you have.

topics.prompt: I'm bleeding all over. Think you can patch me up?

lines.text: Yep, you're dying alright. I can piece you back together. I just need to charge for cost value. What do you say?
lines.note: Joking around, but the player is actually hurt

lines.text: That little scratch? I wouldn't waste your caps treating it. Come back when I can see out the other side.
lines.note: Making light of injuries -- the player isn't too bad

topics.prompt: I had another question about the Brotherhood.

lines.text: Okay, what's up?

topics.prompt: Maxson and the others back in California.

lines.text: Can't say. Not that I won't say. Just can't; never met any.
lines.note: Matter of fact

lines.text: The group found me on their journey across the country. I only know what they've told me.
lines.note: Still matter of fact

lines.text: Probably better you ask them yourself, though. I wouldn't want to misrepresent anyone's opinions. It can be a touchy subject.

topics.prompt: Scribe Valdez.

lines.text: She's damn smart. A little naive. Great company to have on the road, and in a pinch, a reliable assistant for surgery in the field.
lines.note: Thinks of her a bit like a daughter, or younger sister, that he adores

lines.text: But, I feel bad for her being stuck between Paladin "Rock" and Knight "Hard Place" when the arguments get going.
lines.note: nicknames for Rahmani and Shin, cheeky

topics.prompt: Knight Shin.

lines.text: I'd have to look up what the prognosis is on having a "stick up your butt.
lines.note: Joking around, but still kind of annoyed sounding

lines.text: I kid. He's got a solid head on his shoulders... and I know he's got everyone's best interests in mind.
lines.note: Kind of feels bad for that last rib on him

lines.text: Just wish the guy would cut himself -- and us -- a little slack sometimes.
lines.note: A little annoyed again

topics.prompt: Paladin Rahmani.

lines.text: Leila, er... Paladin Rahmani is a force to be reckoned with.
lines.note: They are friend, but corrects himself to keep professional. Lay-la Rah-MAH-nee

lines.text: She thinks from her gut, and let's her heart guide her.
lines.note: Straightforward, NOT with admiration, matter-of-fact

lines.text: Now, my medical experience could tell you that the brain is the preferred organ for decision making, but...
lines.note: Getting cheeky. Emphasis on BRAIN

lines.text: Well, she manages... Most of the time.
lines.note: Cheeky. He likes Rahmani, despite that concern.

topics.prompt: Are you okay with their methods of "reclaiming" technology?

lines.text: Well, that... I don't have a lot of thoughts to share on that.
lines.note: Very hesitant

lines.text: Or at least, I'm cautious about sharing what thoughts I do have.
lines.note: With a smirk, emphasis on DO

lines.text: I just know this: I joined this group because it was the best way I could help people across the country.
lines.note: Getting serious, determined

lines.text: Taking away a few plasma rifles here and there? I can sleep at night if that's the cost.
lines.note: Slight hesitation, but landing on determination

topics.prompt: Almost sounds like you're talking about mutiny.

lines.text: Mutiny? Whoa, don't be putting words in my mouth.
lines.note: Chuckle, trying to laugh it off -- could get real serious if he words this poorly. "Whoa" like to a horse, NOT like "whoa dude

lines.text: I don't think it's that serious, but I do think the folk out here take good advantage of the autonomy that the distance provides.
lines.note: Getting a little cheeky, gossipy

topics.prompt: Things are run differently in California? How so?

lines.text: Now, I only know what I've read. Initiates like me have never actually been a part of the California Brotherhood. We were picked up along the way.
lines.note: Slightly hushed, wants to be clear that he's not really gossiping, but the information is a little sensitive

lines.text: But, from what I gather, there's a lot more talk about hoarding technology than helping folk.
lines.note: hoarding technology sounds kind of dumb to him

lines.text: How did that holotape put it... "Help protect people from themselves?" Something like that.
lines.note: Clearly not buying into the ideals

lines.text: I can appreciate where they're coming from, but my obligations are to help people by, well... helping people.
lines.note: Trying to remained focused on his goals

topics.prompt: That's great information. Thanks, Solomon.

lines.text: Any time. Just, uh... don't make me regret sharing what I did.
lines.note: Starts friendly, then second guesses himself

lines.text: Not everyone is as keen on discussing the way things are done.
lines.note: More serious in tone

topics.prompt: So that's it? Just a group that can keep you safe?

lines.text: Knowing the people around you have your back means everything these days.
lines.note: Stern. Security isn't a joke to him.

lines.text: I don't think a single member of the Brotherhood would disagree with me on that. Ideology aside.

topics.prompt: And what about as an organization?

lines.text: What, you mean like their ideals and methods? There's some elements I can wholeheartedly get behind, that's for sure.
lines.note: Still beating around the bush a bit

lines.text: Teamwork, structure, discipline. Just like my Army days.
There's some other elements that worry me, if I'm being honest. I'm comfortable with how this group here thinks but...
lines.note: Showing his hand a bit, but still resisting getting too serious. Emphasis on THIS, referring to the local members

lines.text: Well, from the "literature" I've gotten my hands on, it seems like things are run a little differently in California.
lines.note: Speaking a little more cautiously

lines.text: I think the metaphorical chain of command is getting awfully taut. If you catch my meaning.
lines.note: Still speaking cautiously, but a tad gossipy, even a little jokingly

topics.prompt: On second thought, let's talk about something else.

lines.text: Fine by me. What else did you need?
lines.note: Chuckle a bit, Relieved, didn't really want to talk Brotherhood

topics.prompt: What are your thoughts on the members that came from California?

lines.text: Digging up dirt on the top dogs? Who were you interested in hearing about?
lines.note: Cheeky. Chuckle after "top dogs

topics.prompt: Why did you join up?

lines.text: I had spent the last two decades wandering to every burnt out settlement and smoking crater in the ground I could find.
lines.note: Starting friendly -- isn't getting too emotional about it

lines.text: The world was in need of healing, and I had the skills to do it... But, I could only do so much alone.
lines.note: Starting lighter, but the memories start to weigh on him in the latter half

lines.text: I'd hear about a community with some sick kids, or someone with a chronic illness... If I went to help, I would be turned away.
lines.note: Painful to recall the memory

lines.text: They didn't want to risk letting some stranger into their mix. And I don't blame them, really. It's a rough world out there.
lines.note: A little resentful, but resigns to the reality of the situation.

lines.text: But when I saw the Brotherhood roll in? People were not -- could not -- turn them away.
lines.note: Building awe, pride

lines.text: Reminded me of my time in the Army. Where we went, there was a sense of safety, security.
lines.note: Pride, reminiscent

lines.text: I wanted to take advantage of that. Help people on the road. Sure enough, they lead me to plenty of people in need.
lines.note: Snap back to the here and now, direct answer

topics.prompt: What do you think about the Brotherhood?

lines.text: As a community, I think they're fine company. As a team, I don't think I've ever felt safer.
lines.note: Friendly, but kind of beating around the bush

topics.prompt: Actually, never mind.

lines.text: Alright, then. Be seeing you.

topics.prompt: I want to know more about you.

lines.text: Want to get personal? That's fine, that's fine... I'm not paying rent, after all.
lines.note: Ever so slightly flirty

lines.text: Okay. Couldn't hurt to answer a few questions. Ask away.
lines.note: Almost as if he's answering this for himself... "Would it hurt? No.

topics.prompt: I wanted to talk about the Brotherhood of Steel.

lines.text: Sure. I don't know if I'm a model member, but I can try and fill you in as much as I can. It's the least I can do.
lines.note: Joking... sorta

lines.text: You mean you want to talk shop? Sure. Anything that'll make it easier for you to assist us.
lines.note: The player is also a member

lines.text: Ha, at this point you might be able to tell ME a thing or two about the Brotherhood. But, sure, what did you want to know?
lines.note: The player is now a much more important member than Solomon

topics.prompt: Let's talk about your medical services.

lines.text: Of course. Just tell me where it hurts.
lines.note: Bit of a chuckle.

topics.prompt: Just keep your head down and stay out of my way.

lines.text: Listen, I can leave if you want, but I'm doing this for the people out there that need my help.
lines.note: Slightly annoyed, but trying to not get hostile

lines.text: If this ends up being too much of a problem, let me know. Until then, I hope you can see some value in what I offer.
lines.note: Annoyed but trying to reassure the player

topics.prompt: [Brotherhood] Welcome aboard, Initiate. Ad Victoriam!

lines.text: Affirmative -- wait a minute... You're THAT vault dweller? The one who's been helping us out?
lines.note: Snaps into military mode, then realizes who he's talking to

lines.text: Well that's perfect! It's great to meet you -- even better to get to work together. Ad Victoriam!
lines.note: Relieved, pretty honored

lines.text: I'm looking forward to working together. Ad Victoriam!
I just need a small spot for myself. I'll stay out of your way, and I'll be around if you need any assistance.
lines.note: Friendly, feels like he's sealed the deal

lines.text: Do we have a deal?

topics.prompt: Or I could just steal all your supplies right here, right now.

lines.text: You could. Sure. It wouldn't be my first time fending off a would-be bandit, though.
lines.note: Taking this in stride. It's not the first time someone has pulled this, and he still wants to butter the player up a bit.

lines.text: You'd also have the whole Brotherhood knocking your doors down. I, uh, wouldn't recommend that.
lines.note: Still keeping it light-hearted. Doesn't honestly expect escalation.

topics.prompt: How do I know you're not just lying to me?

lines.text: Well, I don't really have much proof, but I'm not really asking for a handout or anything.
lines.note: Has nothing to hide

lines.text: Hopefully my services can speak for themselves.
lines.note: Steering it back to a friendly tone

topics.prompt: A "low cost?" You mean you'd still charge, even if I give you a place to stay?

lines.text: Believe me, I wish I could give it all away, but I need to be able to buy more supplies myself.
lines.note: Sympathetic. Genuinely doesn't WANT your money, but needs it.

lines.text: At the prices I can offer, I'm already at risk for paying out of pocket.
lines.note: Sorry about it

topics.prompt: Sounds like a noble cause.

lines.text: I suppose so. It's just the right thing to do. I've got the training and people need my help.
lines.note: He doesn't put himself on a pedestal like that. He doesn't see this as flattery.

lines.text: I appreciate the sentiment, though.
lines.note: Trying to not be a snob about it, though

lines.text: See, I signed up with the Brotherhood for a chance to help people across the country.
lines.note: This is not an answer to a question, this is a continuation of his previous explanation.

lines.text: But, now that we're stationed in Atlas Observatory, my ability to reach patients has been limited.
lines.note: Trying to get a little more friendly

lines.text: I'm looking for a safe and relatively clean place to store supplies and catch my breath while on the road.
lines.note: Friendly, trying to come off as easy going

lines.text: If you're willing to let me spend time here, I can offer surplus supplies and some medical services for as low a cost as I can afford.
lines.note: Not scheming, genuinely trying to make a deal he believes is a good one.

topics.prompt: Proposition? This some kind of get-rich scheme? 'Cause if so, I'm in.

lines.text: No, I'm afraid not. There isn't much money to be made in my profession anymore.
lines.note: Start with a chuckle. Doctors aren't rich anymore.

topics.prompt: Tell me why I shouldn't just blast you away right now.

lines.text: Because I might just blast back.
lines.note: Serious in tone, maybe slightly annoyed. Cold response.

lines.text: (sigh) I'm sorry, I think we got off on the wrong foot here. Let me explain.
lines.note: Genuine remorse, calming tone

topics.prompt: How can I help, Dr. Hardy?

lines.text: Please, just "Solomon" is fine.
lines.note: Slightly embarrassed (he's not actually a licensed doctor)

topics.prompt: [Brotherhood] Ad Victoriam, Initiate. How can I be of service?

lines.text: Oh, you're... You're that vault dweller that's been helping us out! Ad Victoriam! I guess I'm in luck.
lines.note: Realizing who the player is, then feeling relieved, lowers tension.

lines.text: I'm Solomon Hardy. I'm a doctor and Initiate with the Brotherhood of Steel. I've got a proposition for you.

topics.prompt: Who me? Couldn't be.

lines.text: Mhmm. Okay, well I could see why the creator of "Nuka-Cola: My Blood's In It" might want to remain anonymous.
lines.note: Coy - he knows the player is this person

lines.text: Tact for branding aside, Appalachia wouldn't be around today if it wasn't for them.
lines.note: Sincere thanks, but obviously knows the player is "them.

lines.text: Alright, have your secrets, then. Appalachia, hell the whole world, owes that person -- whoever they are -- a great deal of thanks.
lines.note: Knows it was the player. Playful at first, but genuine thanks

topics.prompt: I'm just glad I could help.

lines.text: Wow, you saved a lot of lives, you know.
Remind me to buy you an ice-cold Nuka-Cola. This time, without your antibodies in it.
lines.note: Back to cheeky

items.description: Welcome Brother Steven into your C.A.M.P. and may the blessings of the Mothman be upon you.
items.howToObtain: Claim from the Rip Daring and the Cryptid Hunt Scoreboard (Season 12)

lines: Claim from the Rip Daring and the Cryptid Hunt Scoreboard (Season 12)

topics.prompt: How did you not get shot on your way in?

lines.text: I must have someone up above looking out for me.
lines.note: Very said very "matter-of-fact" as he believe Mothman is above and watching out for him.

topics.prompt: [Charisma 4+] Finally! But I do seem to be running low on albino blood at the moment.

lines.text: Ah, isn't that always the case? Perhaps I can help you replenish your stock.
lines.note: Context: Albino blood is very hard to find.

lines.text: I must say, it is reassuring to meet a fellow Follower of the Winged One.
Another who peers into the shadow to witness the gaze of His truth!
lines.note: Extremely excited to meet the player as he thinks they also worship Mothman and will help him summon them

lines.text: You prepare the albino blood. I'll ignite this area in a purifying pyre!
lines.note: Context: both are needed for the summoning of Mothman

topics.prompt: Don't you dare light a fire in my C.A.M.P.!

lines.text: But... then why did you build a ritualistic totem here?
lines.note: Very confused by the players actions. Why else would they build a totem if not to summon Mothman?

lines.text: Do you mean to tell me that you showcase Mothman imagery, yet do not follow the flutter of His wings?
At last!
lines.note: Excited to find another person interested in Mothman

lines.text: Ah, I see you have returned.
Have you been blessed with a vision of Him today?
lines.note: Questioning but hopeful

lines.text: I see you have come to appreciate fine vestments.
lines.condition: GetEquipped: Clothes_CultistAdept "Cultist Adept Robe", GetEquipped: Clothes_CultistElder "Cultist Elder Robe", GetEquipped: Clothes_CultistNeophyte_Robe "Cultist Neophyte Robe"
lines.note: Player is wearing Mothman Cultist clothes

lines.text: Good choice in apparel. Though be careful with where you adorn the twigs. They can... irritate.
lines.condition: GetEquipped: Clothes_CultistAdept "Cultist Adept Robe", GetEquipped: Clothes_CultistElder "Cultist Elder Robe", GetEquipped: Clothes_CultistNeophyte_Robe "Cultist Neophyte Robe"
lines.note: Player is wearing Mothman Cultist clothes. These clothes typically have sticks and twigs sticking out of them.

lines.text: Looking worse for wear my friend. Hypothetically if you were to pass, then could I use this C.A.M.P. as a ceremonial pyre?
lines.note: Initially concerned, but realizes they can possibly use it to summon Mothman

lines.text: I don't fully understand why we can't use glowing blood. You would think the glow and the blood would be more alluring to Him.
I hope you're only wearing that because your other clothes are dirty with Albino Radstag Blood.
lines.note: Player is wearing the clothes of the rival Mothman Cult

lines.text: I appreciate your enthusiasm for Mothman, but you're going about it all wrong.
lines.note: Player is wearing the clothes of the rival Mothman Cult

lines.text: I hope you are having a blessed Mothman Equinox.
lines.note: Mothman Equinox is a holy celebration of Mothman

lines.text: What a blessed time! The Holy Mothman Equinox. Let me know if you catch His gaze!
How many followers would it take to carve His likeness into a cliff face... Oh sorry. Just thinking out loud.
lines.note: Begins as questioning but shifts to downplaying what he was saying.

lines.text: Welcome back to His Altar. I mean your altar. I mean your C.A.M.P. thing.
lines.note: Initially happy but fumbles as he goes on

lines.text: Still gathering that Albino Radstag blood. I'll let you know when I can get a barrel that hasn't fully congealed.
lines.note: He needs blood for the Mothman Summoning. He's apologetic that it's difficult to collect.

lines.text: My faith flickers, but I still try to keep it protected from the world, as you said.
lines.note: Player had given them advice to keep their faith protected like a candle from the wind. Steven is grateful for the advice.

lines.text: I continue to steel myself against the temptations of the False Gods and lying shepherds.
lines.note: Proud that he is not being drawn away by False Gods

lines.text: Ah my test returns. Tell me have you finally seen the Light of the Righteous and Holy Mothman?
lines.note: Confident that he can convince the Player of the beauty of the Holy Mothman. Context is that he sees the player as a test of his faith.

lines.text: You are absolutely glowing. Would you mind climbing something tall and jumping around? I think that might attract Him.
lines.note: Player is highly irradiated.

topics.prompt: Of course! You are welcome here brother!

lines.text: Bless you! I'll be sure to help you to walk in His light!
I shall also protect this area against unwanted guests so that you may rest easy!
Oh where are my manners? My name is Brother Steven. Steven Scarberry.
lines.note: Pronounced Scar-Berry

lines.text: Brother Scarberry if you want to be formal, Brother Stevie if you don't.
lines.note: Pronounced Scar-Berry.

topics.prompt: Are you included under "unwelcome guests"?

lines.text: Haha no. I have no plans to set myself on fire.
lines.note: Joking and laughing it off.

lines.text: Although He is drawn to light... Hmm... perhaps...no. No, now's not the time.
lines.note: Seriously considers it. Wavers a bit between doing it and not doing it, before settling on not setting himself on fire.

topics.prompt: I guess you can stay. Just don't set my C.A.M.P. on fire.

lines.text: Set unwelcome guests on fire, but not your C.A.M.P., got it.
Oh, and rest easy. I know how to deal with unwelcome guests.
You know of Him, but do not worship Him? This has given me something new to ponder.
I can teach you many things. Help you walk within His blessed light.
It seems as though they are trying to disguise their ramblings as proper teachings.

lines.text: Only those close enough to Him are permitted to directly read from the scripture.

lines.text: You have? I must know more! How did a non-believer learn and successfully accomplish the ritual?
lines.note: Impressed by the player's abilities and curious with how they did it.

lines.text: Would you mind if I stayed a while and collect my thoughts?

topics.prompt: No. I just liked the statue.

lines.text: You know of Him, but do not worship Him? This has given me something new to ponder.

topics.prompt: Interpreter Clarence walked me through the steps of the ritual.

lines.text: Oh, my apologies, I didn't realize that we were discussing the false prophet.
lines.note: Mildly annoyed his dreams of Mothman were dashed away. Slightly sarcastic

lines.text: When people say "Mothman" I assume they're talking about the "Holy Mothman", not that purple liar.
But please, do go on. Tell me of the the stories of their glorified butterfly.
lines.note: Sarcastic and a bit rude towards the Enlightened. Insulting the Rival cult and their beliefs

topics.prompt: There was some "Moth Dust" and then I remember fighting some weird glowing cultists.

lines.text: Ha. I hope you were not fooled by such a "display". It's obvious that was merely some kind of mind-altering substance.
Why would the True Followers need to invade Point Pleasant, their home? Exactly. They wouldn't.

topics.prompt: There was an abundance of Albino Radstags.

lines.text: I wonder how they were able to find them. Usually I need to...
lines.note: Last word trails off as he realizes something

lines.text: Wait, do you mean to tell me that they have left the Light but still use His teachings for rituals?
It seems that there is the need for another Crusade of Light.
lines.note: Threatening the Enlightened Mothman Cult

topics.prompt: Say what you want, but they were able to summon Mothman.

lines.text: Should I be impressed that they summoned the wrong thing?
I can summon a stray dog with a piece of meat. That does not make it a Holy being.

topics.prompt: Why are there books by The Enlightened in the Point Pleasant church?

lines.text: What? Do these books have His mark on them? Bound in red?

topics.prompt: I do not know.

lines.text: Then I am unsure of the intent. Possibly kept as a trophy by the Followers of the Winged One? Or perhaps they keep them for a good laugh?
Specifically any experience you have with the Winged One. Or False Gods, I guess.

topics.prompt: [The Lowe-Down] I investigated the disappearance of a man who was apparently eaten by a Sheepsquatch.

lines.text: Ah yes. I've seen posters telling the power of these "Squatches". What did you find?
lines.note: Context: There are posters around the gameworld talking about how a Sheepsquatch killed someone's brother

topics.prompt: [Over and Out] I've actually come across a Mothman while exploring an underground bunker.

lines.text: You have? Tell me more! Have you seen the secrets of his gaze?
lines.note: Very Excited

topics.prompt: [Death and Taxidermy] Have you heard of the Beast of Beckley? It's another cryptid in the region.

lines.text: It is not in the book of False Gods. Do tell.
lines.note: Amused and curious to hear more

topics.prompt: I want to go back to my earlier questions.

lines.text: And we shall.

topics.prompt: He created a robot that thought it was a sheep. I think it killed him.

lines.text: Ah hubris. We have a story about a moth that flew too close to the sun and burned their wings. It seems he had the same outcome with False Gods.
lines.note: Similar to the story of Icarus. Not surprised that the person got injured with the False Gods

topics.prompt: Taxidermy, a secret room, lots of blood, but no body. Seems the Sheepsquatch took him somewhere.

lines.text: I would have expected as much. It may be a False God, but its power should not be understated.

topics.prompt: The Sheepsquatch is very real. And it can shoot lasers from its eyes.

lines.text: Really? I must update the teachings. It seems the False Gods are growing in strength to further tempt us wandering souls.
lines.note: Intrigued by the possibility that the False Gods are getting stronger.

topics.prompt: [Lie]  Met the Sheepsquatch. Cool guy. Had a couple of beers.

lines.text: ...Noted. False Gods are alcoholics.
lines.note: Believing their friend, but they have their doubts.

topics.prompt: It seemed to have been infected with some form of the Scorched Virus. I had to put it down.

lines.text: Sick? Oh no no no. The dust from the Mothman's wings prevents sickness and extends the life of those it blesses.
lines.note: Trying desperately to rationalize why the Mothman cannot get sick.

lines.text: This must have been some form of mutated Butterfly-Man.
lines.note: Trying to justify his beliefs in Mothman's healing properties.

topics.prompt: It looked like it had been burned, and it had these bright green eyes

lines.text: The Pretender has purple eyes. The Holy one has red. What could this one be? Another false one?
I must pray for more answers.

topics.prompt: A group of Cryptid hunters were brutally killed by a large white wolf.

lines.text: That's borderline blasphemy. There's no way an albino wolf is anywhere near the same pantheon as His Holiness.
lines.note: Insulted by the mention that this wolf could even be a False God.

lines.text: That said, Brother Ryan had made mention of a "White Fox". Perhaps this is what he was alluding to.
lines.note: Reflecting on what Brother Ryan said and what it could mean.

lines.text: I must investigate. Maybe this blood could serve as an alternative to the Albino Radstags?
Like a flame burns in my soul, share the blaze of your Light with this hatchling.
lines.note: Words of a prayer

lines.text: Another wanders in darkness. Guide them to you.
Light up their life as you have for so many of your blessed children.
Trail the moth dust so their soul can find you eternally.

topics.prompt: Can I get Mothman's Blessing?

lines.text: As tempting as it may be to forever in the light's embrace, the brevity is what makes it special.
Hold onto it while you can. We can pray again tomorrow.
It seems as though a false shepherd has led you astray. Unfortunately I do not have the means to get you under His light currently.
lines.condition: HasMagicEffect: crXPBonusEffect "Apply XP Bonus", IsDailyCooldownExpired: LiteAlly_Scarberry_Cooldown
lines.note: Sad and worried that his friend may have fallen in with the wrong crowd.

lines.text: I'll be able to pray for you again tomorrow. Until then I can do nothing but hope that you learn to avoid the lies of the purple one.
lines.condition: HasMagicEffect: crXPBonusEffect "Apply XP Bonus", IsDailyCooldownExpired: LiteAlly_Scarberry_Cooldown
lines.note: Worried that his friend is falling from Mothman's Favor

lines.text: His light may have worn off, but do not think that He is not watching.
I shall prepare the ritual so you may walk under His light when tomorrow's light shines.
Oh Holy Mothman...
lines.note: The beginning of a prayer.

lines.text: Of course. I sense some lilac deception on your soul. I pray that I can cleanse all of it.
lines.condition: IsDailyCooldownExpired: LiteAlly_Scarberry_Cooldown, HasMagicEffect: crXPBonusEffect "Apply XP Bonus"

lines.text: Oh Kind and Forgiving Mothman...
lines.condition: IsDailyCooldownExpired: LiteAlly_Scarberry_Cooldown, HasMagicEffect: crXPBonusEffect "Apply XP Bonus"
lines.note: The beginning of a prayer to his god to ask for help for their friend.

lines.text: Let this larva be welcomed back into the fold and be purged of their purple corruption.
lines.condition: IsDailyCooldownExpired: LiteAlly_Scarberry_Cooldown, HasMagicEffect: crXPBonusEffect "Apply XP Bonus"
lines.note: Trying to pray away the corruption of the false Mothman. Sound be Righteous

topics.prompt: That's all I wanted.

lines.text: Was there something else you wished to discuss?

topics.prompt: Let's see what you've got for sale.

lines.text: I was going to offer these to Him but... I guess you can have first pick.
None of these appeased Him, so go ahead.
Here you go.
Give me the word and I shall make an offering. Appeased, He will open your mind for a time.
Though my supply of viable offerings is limited, I shall share with you what I can.

topics.prompt: Radiation has already helped me grow quite a bit.

lines.text: Yes... Think of His Light in a similar way, though it expands your mind, your heart, and your soul.

topics.prompt: Finally! Long have I waited for Him to notice me.

lines.text: Then this was fate, my friend. He guided us together so we may both walk the Light!

topics.prompt: My Pip-Boy has a built-in light source.

lines.text: But does it cleanse your soul? I think not.
An Elder once implied that the one behind RobCo was lacking in the soul.
But fear not! Regardless of your technology, you will find guidance.

topics.prompt: I'm confused. You're giving me a light of some kind?

lines.text: Not "a" light, "the" light. His Light.
Like the moths within our souls, we are drawn to the Light. When we follow it, we can clearly see the path before us.

topics.prompt: So you say a prayer and that is supposed to do something?

lines.text: Yes a prayer. Along with a blood sacrifice upon the altar. The latter is usually the part that helps.

topics.prompt: See you around, Brother Stevie.

lines.text: May you walk within His light.

topics.prompt: I have stories from the Wasteland.

lines.text: Yes, please regale me with stories of your exploits.

topics.prompt: Tell me more about yourself.

lines.text: I shall try to impart on you what wisdom I can.

topics.prompt: I'm in need of your services.

lines.text: Ah, it's time for me to take you under my wing... Metaphorically speaking.
Let me know when you are in need of guidance and I can share His blessing.
With His light you will find your way in the darkness, and your experiences will help you grow.

topics.prompt: I'm in need of your services.

lines.text: But of course! How may I help you through the darkness?

topics.prompt: What exactly is "The Interloper"?

lines.text: I- I know not of who you speak.
lines.note: Nervous, concerned they are asking. Obviously lying.

lines.text: That said... It is in your best interest to drop this line of inquiry.
lines.note: Trying to protect their friend.

lines.text: Please. I beg of you.
The response will not answer your questions. It only adds more.

topics.prompt: Do the followers realize that you're all cultists in a cryptid cult?

lines.text: What? No! We're not a cryptid cult... club... thing. We're a... What's the word?
lines.note: Awkward laugh. trying to play it off as joke as he doesn't want to admit/recognize he's in a cult.

lines.text: Family. That's it! A family in eternal unwavering support of the Holy Mothman.
lines.note: Desperate to sound like he isn't in a cult. Doesn't realize he's describing a cult.

lines.text: As you can see, it's very different from a cult.
lines.note: He feel confident in his ability to convince the player that they're not in a cult.

topics.prompt: Why can't you finish your pilgrimage?

lines.text: I uh... I still have not found Mothman. I have in my mind, and in my soul, but not on this mortal plane.
lines.note: Embarrassed to admit he hasn't seen Mothman.

lines.text: My pilgrimage ends when I look into His eyes and finally understand His Truth.
lines.note: A bit of hope as he visualizes his goal

lines.text: But... it has been many months with no sign.
I remain with Him, but like a candle, my faith flickers in the uncaring wind.

topics.prompt: I want to go back to my earlier questions.

lines.text: As you wish.

topics.prompt: Is that how everyone joins?

lines.text: Goodness no. I don't know much about the other members as I was sheltered away from most of them.
You see, since I was selected by Mothman Himself, I am seen as a Beacon. A source of His Light!
I could not risk being corrupted by false shepherds.
There was also the incident in the ritual preparation room.
lines.note: Trying to make it sound like it wasn't a big deal.

lines.text: But that was not my fault. The Elder told me such.
lines.note: Emphasis on "that

topics.prompt: Then too, like a candle, you must guard it from the outside. Protect it.

lines.text: I... You're right. Thank you. I now realize that this must be some form of test.
I've received so much simply by being "chosen". I must learn to persevere even when His blessings are withheld from me.
lines.note: Inspired to be the best Mothman believer he can be.

topics.prompt: Perhaps you are on the right path but wrong direction. Have you considered the Sheepsquatch?

lines.text: I have not, but you have a point... Wait. Now it makes sense.
lines.note: Starts sad but picks up as he realizes

lines.text: This is why they are False Gods! They make themselves known to distract me from my path!
Cursed false shepherds attempting to lead me astray!
lines.note: Angry at the False Gods and himself for being tempted, if even for a moment.

lines.text: Until I prove myself immune to them, I can never find Him!
lines.note: He's figured out his path forward in life.

topics.prompt: You're talking about a fucking bug. Pull yourself together.

lines.text: Wait... I know what this is!
You're attempting to pull me from His faith!
lines.note: Annoyed at the player

lines.text: That's why I met you and not Him. You're a test!
lines.note: Slowly piecing it together.

lines.text: Until I convince you of His glory, I cannot witness it myself.
Despite your intentions you have led me to the truth.
lines.note: Proud of himself

topics.prompt: Don't Mothman fanatics usually travel in groups? Why are you alone?

lines.text: I'm on a pilgrimage of sorts. To learn of His glory directly from the source.
My mind has been fed by the knowledge of our tomes. My soul blessed by His love.
I have been given a final task before I may become a priest to my kin. A beacon if you will.
I must trek to the Holy Lands of Appalachia, find His Holiness, and learn all he has to teach.
Though I can't finish my pilgrimage quite yet.
lines.note: Emphasis on "quite

topics.prompt: Any luck with finding Him?

lines.text: Not yet. But I did see something strange.
It's difficult to stay on the correct path when so many False Gods have made themselves known to me.
But I remain steadfast thanks to you.
lines.note: Grateful to the Player for helping them realize

topics.prompt: [Intelligence 8+] You do realize that Mothman left you there as food for his children.

lines.text: Don't be ridiculous! We are all His Children, and we would never resort to cannibalism.
Unless you mean food for thought, in which case yes! I aim to feed the minds of my kin.
lines.note: He's desperately trying to make it sound better and turn into a positive.

lines.text: What an interesting way of phrasing it!

topics.prompt: That's enough of that for now.

lines.text: Of course.

topics.prompt: How does one join Mothman's Followers?

lines.text: I would not know for you see, I did not join, I was chosen. Specifically selected by the Holy one himself!
lines.note: Proud and Grateful

lines.text: You see my flesh and blood, the birth-givers; were found and selected by the magnificent Mothman.
lines.note: Proud and Grateful

lines.text: They were deemed ready, so He freed them from their flesh prisons to ascend to His light.
lines.note: Proud and Grateful

lines.text: I was yet a larva and not yet ready to join them. He took me under His wing, placing me safely amount the eggs of future harbingers.
lines.note: Grateful, reminiscing on this great honor

lines.text: It was there that I was discovered by His flock. They saw His blessing upon me and accepted me as one of His children.
lines.note: Proud and grateful. This is the moment that made him special.

lines.text: I heard the majestic sound of wings flapping in the night. But then I saw the red, winged creature and there was screaming.
lines.note: Remembering a previous adventure.

lines.text: From both of us, but mainly them. A strange attack I think.
I saw a light fall from the sky. I hoped for Him, but instead found metal, smoke, and debris.
Nothing else except for a fuzzy painting of a man in a blue shirt.
A very friendly man. While his personality was cold, he could not shake his smile.
lines.note: Remembering a previous adventure

lines.text: I feel as though we were looking for similar things.
Have you heard of a man with a sickle going around removing heads?
Seems someone lost their mind and is seeking to take it from another.
In the think of a forest I heard a high-pitched jabbering close by.
lines.note: Remembering an adventure.

lines.text: As I approached, some tall foliage appeared to reach out and grab a settler. Be wary of strange trees, friend.
Towards the Whitesprings I could faintly see a woman in need of help.
lines.note: Remembering an old adventure

lines.text: She ran unobstructed through the trees before I lost sight of her near an old cemetery.

topics.prompt: Flesh Prisons?

lines.text: Apologies. We know that these vessels are merely a means to worship His Holiness.
lines.note: Talking as if this is a commonly accepted fact

lines.text: Once the pupa is ready, they will shed their mortal cocoon and be welcomed into His eternal Light!
lines.note: Talking as if this is a commonly accepted fact.

lines.text: Wise and Holy Mothman. Look upon me with your divine Light!
lines.note: A sort of prayer for himself.

lines.text: Gather sticks under new moon. Check.� Bind them with entrails. Check. Cleanse tools with incense... Should that say "Insects"?
lines.note: Sounds like he is reading from a to-do list.

lines.text: Oh Bright One, I call upon thee! Find my sacred flame with your watchful eyes.
lines.note: A sort of prayer for himself

lines.text: Now where can I find enough fireflies to appease Him?
lines.note: He wants to use the fireflies as a light to attract Mothman

lines.text: If only there were a dance I could perform to appease Him.
*Gasp* Is that the warm glow of the Holy Mothman!? *Sigh* Alas no, just more radiation.
lines.note: Starts excited, gets dejected

lines.text: I wonder if Brother Moncrief was able to find the physical light of the Mothman that he theorized about.
lines.note: Pronounced "maan kreef". Context: Moncrief is a Mothman follower who tried to use a lighthouse to summon Mothman

lines.text: Perfect timing. This sky will be perfect for welcoming the Winged One into our lives!
lines.note: Said during the Night.

lines.text: I read that some pre-war fools thought the Holy Mothman was an Owl. How could you confuse Him with one of those flightless creatures?
lines.note: Annoyed by the mere suggestion. Owls have lost their flight due to radiation.

lines.text: There's a Mothman... I wonder if there's a Mothwoman? Another question for Him... or Her.
lines.note: The "Or Her" should be delayed as he realizes that he should be inclusive in case Mothman is a woman.

lines.text: I just can't shake these nightmares. Floating in darkness forever... What if I cannot find His Light?
lines.note: Sad that he still has not met Mothman

lines.text: How will I know when there are enough candles? I'll get more just in case.
lines.note: Context: his shrine already has a lot of candles.

lines.text: I had heard about an inhaler that would "make me see God", but I only saw small insects crawling on my skin.
lines.note: He's talking about a powerful hallucinogenic drug

lines.text: Why would they adorn a town with His likeness if He was not meant to be worshipped?
lines.note: Context: Point Pleasant has a Mothman statue

lines.text: Red Eyes to witness the future. Purple to see the lies. But Orange? Green? That remains to be seen.
lines.note: Context: Steven follows the Red-eyed Mothman, and hates the Purple-eyed Mothman. There are also green and orange-eyed Mothmen

lines.text: I thought I had witnessed Him, but it was those damned berries again!
lines.note: Context: there are berries that glow red at night and look similar to Mothman's eyes

lines.text: How much of this C.A.M.P. could I burn before they notice- Oh hello friend. Did not see you there.
lines.note: Starts like they're planning something. Changes to friendly when they are caught

lines.text: Maybe one day I will become a child of the wood. I just need to... Oh, hello. Don't mind me. Just... ruminating.
lines.note: Starts like he's plotting before realizing the Player is nearby and becoming friendly

lines.text: I once saw a dark purple glow of the false prophet. He who is without wings and floats by a false lilac flames. How could one fall for his lies?
lines.note: Annoyed that people can worship the false Mothman

lines.text: I am taunted. I saw a pale being of great stature. Perhaps the strength of the Holy one? No! Lies! It had no eyes with which to see our fate.
lines.note: Starts saddened, changes to annoyed at "No

lines.text: The Mothman Cometh to save the children from the train and their flesh prisons. Why the screams? Dumb pre-war books.
lines.note: He's annoyed at an old pulp book about a Mothman attack

lines.text: I figured out the need for wood armor! We must approach His light, and wood is flammable... Let me write this down.
lines.note: Very excited

lines.text: So a disciple with a cigarette walks up to the Mothman Priest and says "have you got the Light?" *Laughs* See? We can have fun.
lines.note: Telling a bad joke and then laughing at his own joke. Trying to show that the cultists can be fun

lines.text: Is the Mothman named after the moths, or are moths named after Him?
I wish I could meet the first ones to witness His beauty. I'm sure we would have a lot in common.
I can see the Light!... Oh wait. That's the sun... Unless...
lines.note: Starts confident. Gets dejected. Starts to become confident again with "Unless

lines.text: Greetings fellow Follower of the Winged One!
Greetings friend!
Hello there.
This is not a "good" morning. The sun is a sign that He did not appear.
lines.note: Emphasis on "good" Context: Mothman only appears at night, so daytime means he did not show up.

lines.text: Another morning, another chance to see Him ruined.
lines.note: Context: Mothman only appears at night, so daytime means he did not show up.

lines.text: Afternoon.
Good evening. Are you preparing to seek Him out?
lines.note: Context: Mothman only appears at night.

lines.text: I hope His visions of the future prepared Him for this weather.
lines.note: Said during bad weather. For context, Mothman can see the future

lines.text: I see that your day is lacking His Light. Shall I help you fix that?
lines.note: Offering to pray for the player.

lines.text: When I look at you I see... Darkness. Would you like me to light up your way?
lines.note: Offering to Pray to Mothman for the player

lines.text: You walk, but not under His wings. Let me assist you with that.
lines.note: Offering to Pray to Mothman for the player

lines.text: What... Is this? A lilac glow? Surely you are not walking under the light of the false prophet.
lines.note: Player has the glow of what Steven believes to be an evil Mothman.
